blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/
blocks.zh: 当一个视觉语言模型描述一个图像时,它一次命名一个物体,很少重复自己,然而模型是如何规划这个顺序的远不明显. 我们描述一个甚高频用于在它看起来之前决定向何处看的机制。 该机制有四个主要部分。 首先,绑定头会将相关的文本符号与图像相匹配,并将其解为指向匹配图像区域的指针. 第二,相同的绑定头将每个书面答复绑在它来自的区域,模型将它变成进步信号:光标,列表被写入的图像中的位置. 第三,选定步骤选择光标后最近的未写区域,或停止。 最后,凝视头执行所选择的指针并返回一个在那里所绘制的概念,哪个语言头和后期的MLP会变成问题语言中的一个单词. 我们在合成视觉检索任务上通过Qune3-VL模型中的因果补丁验证这个机制的每个部分,并对照其他假设来测试我们的机制. 我们进一步显示,这一机制具有各种输入格式、自然照片和语言,其约束、中继和凝视头出现在2B至32B的每个模型大小上。 这部作品使我们能够调查一个VLM如何将一个问题和图像变成一个答案的序列,逐层地层地层地层地层地物地物地物地物地. 更广泛地说,它为研究模型如何规划长期推出的复杂多步骤任务开辟了道路。 我们的项目可查阅https://plan.baulab.info/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: How does a vision-language model decide which part of an image to describe next? Unlike pure language models, VLMs take two modalities of input, with an inherent mismatch between them. Nothing in a two-dimensional image imposes a one-dimensional order on its contents. Somewhere inside the model, a plan must turn the image into a sequence of words. When a VLM describes an image, it names several objects one after another and rarely names any of them twice, so this plan must both choose what comes next and keep track of what has been said. In this work, we characterize the mechanism inside a VLM that makes this plan, in a controlled task where each step can be tested causally.
blocks.zh: 一个视觉语言模型如何决定一个图像的哪一部分来描述下一个? 与纯语言模型不同,VLMs采用两种输入方式,它们之间有着内在的不匹配. 二维图像中的任何内容都会对其内容施加一维顺序. 在模型的某个地方,一个计划必须把图像变成一个词的序列. 当一个VLM描述一个图像时,它将几个对象逐个命名,很少将其中任何一个命名两次,所以这个计划既必须选择接下来的事物,又要跟踪所说的话. 在这项工作中,我们描述的是使这一计划成为一项控制任务,其中每个步骤都可以因果地测试的VLM机制。

blocks.en: Prior work uncovered parts of this mechanism through the lens of binding. In language models, an entity can be retrieved in two ways. First, through an abstract positional code: each entity in a prompt is tagged with a positional code, and the model later follows that code to retrieve the entity ( Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ; Prakash et al., 2026 ) . Second, through content: filter heads ( Sen Sharma et al., 2026 ) attend to the items of a list that match a rule carried in their query vectors. Similar mechanisms were discovered in VLMs: when they process the words of a prompt, they build spatial indexes to the matching image regions ( Assouel et al., 2026 ) , and a small set of Gaze Heads attends to the region being described, so that redirecting them redirects the description ( Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) . Together, these works explain how a model finds a region in the image that answers a question.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作通过捆绑的视角发现了这一机制的部分内容。 在语言模型中,一个实体可以通过两种方式检索. 首先,通过一个抽象的位置代码:一个提示中的每个实体都会被一个位置代码标记,模型后来会遵循该代码来回收实体(冯和史泰因哈特,2024;普拉卡什等人,2026). 第二,通过内容:过滤头(Sen Sharma等人,2026年)处理列表中与其查询矢量中的规则相匹配的项目. 在VLM中也发现了类似的机制:当它们处理一个即时的词时,它们会构建空间指数到匹配的图像区域(Assouel等人,2026年),还有一组小的Gaze Heads关注被描述的区域,从而重新引导它们重定向描述(Gandikota和Bau,2026年). 这些作品共同解释了一个模型如何在图像中找到一个能够回答一个问题的区域.

blocks.en: It is still unclear how the model solves a task with multiple answers corresponding to several image regions. This requires keeping track of the regions it has already described. In an autoregressive transformer, this progress cannot be kept as a running state that is updated after each answer. What one token computes at layer l l reaches later tokens only at layer l + 1 l+1 or above, so a state handed from answer to answer would soon run out of layers. The model must instead recalculate its progress at every token, using the previously generated tokens. Our work discovers how progress is computed and shows how the prior mechanisms play a part in solving the task.
blocks.zh: 目前尚不清楚该模型如何用多个图像区域对应的多个答案解决一个任务. 这需要跟踪它已经描述的区域。 在自动递归变压器中,这个进度不能作为运行状态,在每个答案后更新. 哪个符号在Ll层中计算出来 只有在L+1+1或以上层中才能达到后期的符号, 所以从回答到回答的状态很快会耗尽。 相反,该模型必须利用以前产生的符号,在每一个符号上重新计算其进度。 我们的工作发现如何计算进展,并表明先前的机制如何在解决这项任务方面发挥作用。

blocks.en: An open-ended description is difficult to study causally since it is hard to control which objects the model describes or in what order. To find the plan, we instead design a simple synthetic retrieval task (Fig. 1 a) that lets us control each part of the mechanism on its own and see what changes. We then test how much of the mechanism carries over to other layouts, other prompt wordings, and list questions on natural photographs (App. G.3 ). Each image is a strip of panels, where each panel holds a shape and a letter. We query the model to output the letter inside a named shape (“ What is the letter inside the star? ”). We then design causal patching experiments with paired source and target runs, where patching activations that causally carry different information produces different answers in the target run. The target output therefore tells us exactly what the patched state carried.
blocks.zh: 由于难以控制模型描述的对象或排列顺序,因此难以对因果关系进行研究。 为了找到这个计划,我们设计了一个简单的合成检索任务(图1a),让我们能够独自控制机制的每个部分,看看有什么变化. 然后,我们测试这一机制在多大程度上延伸到其他布局、其他迅速的措辞以及自然照片的问题(App.G.3)。 每个图像都是条形面板,每个面板都持有一个形状和一个字母. 我们查询模型,以便在一个命名形状内输出字母(“ 恒星内部的字母是什么?”). 然后,我们设计了配对源和目标运行的因果补丁实验,在这些实验中,因果地携带不同信息的补丁激活在目标运行中产生不同的答案. 因此,目标产出告诉我们补丁状态所携带的确切内容。

blocks.en: We find a structured planning mechanism inside VLMs that also connects several of the prior mechanisms (Fig. 1 b). First, at the shape token in the user prompt, a few binding heads match the requested shape against the image and resolve a pointer to every matching region. The model largely reuses the same heads to track progress: when it writes an answer, the binding heads bind that answer to the image region it came from, and the comma token turns this region into a cursor, the place in the image up to which the list has been written. Next, relay heads carry the pointers to the token where the answer is being generated, and the model selects the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Then gaze heads execute the selected pointer, following it back to its region, and bring the visual information. Finally, a few language heads in the late layers identify the language of the prompt and inform the last MLP layers, which translate the visual information into the language of the user prompt.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,在VLMs内部有一个结构化的规划机制,它也连接了几个先前的机制(图1b)。 首先,在用户提示的形状符上,几个绑定头与请求的形状相对应,并解决每个匹配区域的指针. 该模型基本上重用相同的头来跟踪进度:当它写出一个答案时,绑定头将答案绑在它来自的图像区域上,而逗号将这个区域变成光标,即列表被写入的图像中的位置. 接下来,中继头将指针带到生成答案的符号,模型在光标后选择最近的未写区域,或者停止. 然后凝视头执行所选的指针,跟随它返回其区域,并带来视觉信息. 最后,后层的几个语言头识别出即时语言,并告知最后的MLP层,这些层将视觉信息翻译为用户即时语言.

blocks.en: In addition to finding new mechanisms, our work connects several previously discovered mechanisms, found in different models and tasks, into a single plan. We show that the same components solve more complex tasks than the ones they were found on. We also find that the model rebuilds its plan at every token from the tokens it has already generated: we can read the plan and edit it. This view may help explain why long descriptions repeat or skip objects, and it opens a way to study how models track progress in long, multi-step tasks.
blocks.zh: 除了寻找新的机制外,我们的工作还把以前发现的、在不同模式和任务中发现的几个机制连成一个单一的计划。 我们显示,同样的组件解决的任务比发现的复杂。 我们还发现,模型从它已经生成的符号中,在每一个字节上重建其计划:我们可以读取计划并编辑计划. 这种观点可能有助于解释为什么长篇描述重复或跳过对象,它开辟了研究模型如何跟踪长篇,多步骤任务中的进展的方法.

blocks.en: Figure 1: (a) Task setup: We provide an image strip with each panel containing a shape and a letter. We ask the model to retrieve the label of the panel that contains the queried shape. (b) The mechanism, with tokens across and layers down. The model solves the task early, at the shape token star , well before it answers: (1) binding heads match the request against the image and resolve a pointer to the matching panel. (2) Relay heads carry that pointer to the “ : ” token, where the answer has to be produced, and (3) gaze heads execute it to retrieve the letter from that panel. (4) Once T is written, binding heads bind it to its panel, and the model calculates its progress and (5) selects what answer to mention next (by repeating steps 3-5) or to stop if none is left.
blocks.zh: 图1: (a) 任务设置: 我们提供一个图像条 每个面板包含一个形状和一个字母。 我们要求模型取回包含被询问形状的面板的标签. (b) 机制,标志横跨和分层。 模型很早就解决了任务,在形状符号星上,早在它回答之前: (1)绑头与请求相对应,并解决一个指向匹配面板. (2) 中继头将指针背到必须给出答案的“:”符号,(3) 视头执行,从面板上取回信件。 (4)一旦 T 被写入,绑定头将它绑在它的面板上,模型会计算它的进展,(5) 选择接下来要提到的答案(通过重复步骤 3-5),或者在没有留下的情况下停止.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: When a prompt introduces several entities, language models tag each one with an abstract code tied to the order of mention, and a later attention step follows that code back to the entity it needs ( Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ; Dai et al., 2024 ; Prakash et al., 2026 ; Prakash et al., 2024 ) . LLMs also contain filter heads that carry, in their queries, the rule that selects the matching items ( Sen Sharma et al., 2026 ) . VLMs often fail to keep the features of several objects apart ( Campbell et al., 2024 ) . Image information reaches the answer either through the question tokens ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Basu et al., 2024 ) or directly from the image tokens ( Neo et al., 2025 ; Kaduri et al., 2025 ; Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) , and the route depends on the task ( Salazar et al., 2026 ) . On a synthetic task, several works have found that attention heads retrieve a pointer through binding, which is later used by another set of heads to retrieve the information ( Saravanan et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Wang and Xu, 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Assouel et al., 2026 ) . Cui et al. (2026) show that VLMs bind objects to their spatial relations through two routes: content-independent spatial codes in the middle layers of the language backbone, and a stronger spatial signal from the vision encoder that the backbone uses directly. We find similar binding mechanisms, and extend this study to how a VLM keeps track of its answers and how it chooses the next object when the question matches several regions.
blocks.zh: 当一个提示引入多个实体时,语言模型将每个实体都标注一个抽象代码,与引用顺序挂钩,之后的注意步骤会跟随该代码回到它所需要的实体(Feng and Steinhardt, 2024; Dai等人, 2024; Prakash等人, 2026; Prakash等人, 2024). LLMS还包含过滤头,在查询中带有选择匹配项目的规则(Sen Sharma等人,2026年). VLMs常常无法将几个物体的特征分开(Campbell等人,2024年). 图像信息要么通过问号(张等,2025b;巴苏等,2024),要么直接从图像信号(Neo等,2025;Kaduri等,2025;Gandikota和Bau,2026)得到答案,路线取决于任务(Salazar等,2026). 在一项合成任务上,有几部作品发现注意头通过捆绑检索到一个指针,后来被另一组头用来检索信息(Saravanan等人,2025年;Kang等人,2026年;Wang and Xu,2026年;Cui等人,2026年;Assouel等人,2026年). Cui等人(2026年)表明,VLMs通过两种途径将物体绑定在空间关系上:语言主干线中层的内容独立空间代码,以及主干线直接使用的视觉编码器发出的更强空间信号. 我们发现类似的约束机制,并将这一研究扩大到VLM如何跟踪其答案,以及当问题与几个区域匹配时如何选择下一个对象.

blocks.en: Language models plan beyond the next token ( Pal et al., 2023 ; Lindsey et al., 2025 ; Hanna and Ameisen, 2026 ) and keep a running state of their own output: a character count ( Gurnee et al., 2025 ) , a count of list items at the separators ( Hasani et al., 2026 ) , and the suppression of answers already given ( Yan and Jia, 2025 ; Merullo et al., 2024 ) . VLMs seem to work serially only through the text they generate ( Budny et al., 2025 ) and judge when to stop by comparing that text with the image ( Yue et al., 2024 ) . They list the objects of a grid in raster order ( Assouel et al., 2026 ) . A VLM trained to point keeps an internal record of the objects it has counted ( Haputhanthri et al., 2026 ) . We find such a record in a general VLM that writes only letters. It is neither a count nor a set of the letters written, but a place in the image, rebuilt from the written answers, from which the next region is chosen.
blocks.zh: 语言模型计划超越下一个符号(Pal等人,2023年;Lindsey等人,2025年;Hanna和Ameisen,2026年),并保持其自身产出的运行状态:字符计数(Gurnee等人,2025年),分离器列表项数(Hasani等人,2026年),以及压制已经给出的答案(Yan和Jia,2025年;Merullo等人,2024年). VLM似乎只是通过它们生成的文本(Budny等人,2025年)进行连续工作,通过将该文本与图像进行比较来判断何时停止(Yue等人,2024年)。 它们按光栅顺序列出网格对象(Assouel等人,2026年). 训练有素的VLM对其所统计的物体进行内部记录(Haputhanthri等人,2026年)。 我们从只写信的普通VLM中找到这样的记录. 它既不是计数,也不是所写字母的一组,而是图像中的一个位置,从书面答复中重建,从中选择下一个区域.

blocks.en: Several studies find small sets of heads that attend from the text to the relevant part of the image. Some select heads by where they look ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) , while others rank heads by their causal effect ( Golovanevsky et al., 2025 ; Schaumlöffel et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . OCR heads read the text written in an image ( Baek et al., 2025 ) , and Feucht et al. (2026) find that heads needed for OCR also read out the meaning of image regions without text, such as “feathers” at a bird’s wing. We find that heads chosen by causal effect read the pointer better than heads chosen by attention and are more causally sufficient.
blocks.zh: 一些研究发现,从文字到图像的相关部分,都有少量头像。 有些人按其外观选择头部(Kang等人,2025年;Gandikota和Bau,2026年),而另一些人则按其因果关系对头部进行排序(Golovanevsky等人,2025年;Schaumlöffel等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年b). OCR头部阅读了用形象书写的文字(Baek等人,2025年),Feucht等人(2026年)发现OCR所需要的头部也读出了没有文字的图像区域的含义,如鸟翼的"feathers". 我们发现,通过因果效应选择的头比通过注意选择的头更能读出指针,并且更能因果性.

blocks.en: Multilingual language models hold concepts in their middle layers in a form close to their dominant language, often English ( Wendler et al., 2024 ; Schut et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Concept and output language can be patched apart ( Dumas et al., 2025 ) with a small set of attention heads ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Lasnier et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . We find that when the concept comes from an image, the heads that read the image return a concept that does not depend on the question’s language, and separate heads and the last MLPs translate it into that language.
blocks.zh: 多语种语言模型在中层以接近其主语的形式持有概念,常为英语(Wendler等人,2024年;Schut等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年). 概念语言和输出语言可以分开(Dumas等人,2025年),并有少量关注头(Zhang等人,2025年a;Lasnier等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年a). 我们发现,当这个概念来自一个图像时,读到图像的头部会返回一个不依赖于问题语言的概念,并且将头部和最后的MLPs分别翻译为那个语言.

blocks.en: 3 Setup and Notation
blocks.zh: 3 设置和标记

blocks.en: We primarily study the language backbone of the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Its language backbone has 36 layers with 32 attention heads per layer. We do not intervene on the vision encoder; the image inputs are encoded once and cached. We test other model sizes and model families in Appendices G.1 and G.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们主要研究Quen3-VL-8B-指导模型(Bai等人,2025年)的语言骨干. 它的语言骨干有36层,每层有32个注意力头. 我们不干预视觉编码器;图像输入被编码一次并缓存. 我们在附录G.1和G.2中测试其他模型大小和模型家庭。

blocks.en: We build a synthetic visual retrieval task where each image is a strip of blank panels. Each panel consists of a shape and a letter label, R T P K , as shown in Figure 1 a. The user input contains the image followed by the prompt “ Answer with the letter only. What is the letter inside the star? ”. We prefill the assistant turn with “ Answer: ” to force the next generated token to be the answer token, T . In this setup, four types of tokens are relevant to our experiments. The shape token is the word that names the shape (e.g. star ). The answer token is the letter the model generates. The colon token and comma token are where the LLM generates the answer token. Throughout the paper, we use the notation R T P K , star to define the input image and prompt. The shapes are placed randomly on a panel with the letters center-aligned inside them. The question asks for a letter based on a shape instead of a panel number. We do this to separate the binding signal from knowledge of panel numbers. The 8B model answers our synthetic task correctly in 98.9% of questions (Appendix A.7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一个合成的视觉检索任务,每个图像都是一块空白的面板。 每个面板由一个形状和一个字母标签R T P K组成,如图1 a所示. 用户输入的图像后面是“只用字母回答”。 恒星内部的信是什么?” 我们预先给助手填上“回答:”的字母,以迫使下一个生成的符号成为回答符号,T。 在这个设定中,四种符号与我们的实验相关. 形状符是命名形状(如恒星)的词. 答号是模型生成的字母. 结肠符和逗号是 LLM 生成答案符的地方. 整个论文中,我们用注R T P K,恒星来定义输入图像和即时. 形状被随机地放在一个面板上,里面的字母是中间对齐的. 问题要求一个基于形状而不是面板号码的字母. 我们这样做是为了将绑定的信号与对面板号码的了解分开. 8B模式在98.9%的问题中正确回答了我们的合成任务(附录A.7).

blocks.en: Every experiment pairs two runs that differ in both the image and the question:
blocks.zh: 每个实验对两个在图像和问题上都不一样的运行:

blocks.en: Source: G C Z D , heart prefilled “ Answer: ” → \to D Target: R T P K , star prefilled “ Answer: ” → \to T

To answer “ What is the letter inside the star? ”, prior work ( Assouel et al., 2026 ) suggests that the model must do two things. First, it must resolve a pointer by matching the requested shape against the layout of the image to decide which panel holds the answer. Then, it must execute the pointer by reading the letter in that panel. To separate these steps, we record the internal activations of the source run and copy them into the target run, one component at a time, a method known as activation patching ( Meng et al., 2022 ) . We build each pair such that every kind of information a patch could move leads the target to a different answer token: • T , no effect: the patch changed nothing. • D , shallow copy: the patch copied the source’s answer. • K , resolved pointer: the patch moved the pointer resolved in the source. • P , request: the patch moved the source’s request, which was resolved on the target’s layout. • R , layout: the patch moved the source’s layout, on which the target’s request was resolved. In the K , P , and R cases the resolved pointer is still executed on the target’s image.
blocks.zh: 在回答“恒星内部的字母是什么?” 之前的工作(Assouel等人,2026年)表明,模型必须做两件事。 首先,它必须通过将所请求的形状与图像的布局相匹配来解决指针,以决定哪个面板持有答案. 然后,它必须通过读取那个面板中的信来执行指针. 为了分离这些步骤,我们记录源运行的内部激活,并将其复制到目标运行,一次一个组件,一种称为激活补丁的方法(Meng等人,2022年). 我们构建每个对子,这样一个补丁可以移动的每一种信息都会导致目标得到不同的答案符号: —— T,没有效果:补丁没有改变任何东西. · D,浅拷贝:补丁复制了消息来源的回答。 K, 解析指针:补丁移动了源中解析的指针. · P,请求:补丁移动了源请求,在目标布局上得到了解决. ^ R,布局:补丁移动了源的布局,根据该布局解决了目标的请求. 在 K、P 和 R 中, 解析的指针仍然被执行在目标图像上。

blocks.en: T , no effect: the patch changed nothing.
blocks.zh: T,无效果:补丁没有改变任何东西.

blocks.en: D , shallow copy: the patch copied the source’s answer.
blocks.zh: D, 浅拷贝:补丁复制了来源的答案.

blocks.en: K , resolved pointer: the patch moved the pointer resolved in the source.
blocks.zh: K, 解析指针:补丁移动了源中解析的指针.

blocks.en: P , request: the patch moved the source’s request, which was resolved on the target’s layout.
blocks.zh: P,请求:补丁移动了源请求,在目标布局上得到了解决.

blocks.en: R , layout: the patch moved the source’s layout, on which the target’s request was resolved.
blocks.zh: R,布局:补丁移动了源的布局,对此目标的请求得到了解决.

blocks.en: Every patch replaces one activation of the target run with that of the source run, at one token and one layer, and leaves everything else in the target run unchanged. We patch at three activation levels: the whole residual vector at a layer, the output of an MLP, and the output of an attention head. For attention heads, we also patch the queries, the keys, and the values separately: a query patch changes what the head looks for, a key patch lets it read the source’s image keys, and a value patch changes what it brings back from the tokens it attends to. Instead of aiming to identify a single head, we search for the top- K K heads. To find them, we start by patching one head at a time, for all 1,152 heads, on 200 discovery pairs, and rank the heads by how much the patch raises the logit of the expected letter over the target’s own letter. We then patch the top K K heads together for K K in 1, 2, 4, …, 128 on 100 validation pairs to choose K K , and report every result on 500 held-out pairs that played no part in either choice, against the same number of random heads from the same layers (Appendix A ). App. A.5 lists every experiment of the paper with the token it is applied at, the activation it replaces, and the answer it predicts.
blocks.zh: 每个补丁都用源运行的激活器替换一个目标运行的激活器,一个符号和一个层,使目标中的其他一切运行不变. 我们在三个激活级别上补丁:一层的整个剩余矢量,一个MLP的输出,以及一个注意力头的输出. 对于注意头,我们也将查询,密钥和值分别补齐:一个查询补丁会改变头部所寻找的东西,一个密钥补丁会让它读取源头的图像密钥,一个值补丁会改变它从它所处理的符件中带回的东西. 我们不是想找出一个头,而是寻找KK头 为了找到它们,我们首先在200个发现对上一次补上一个头,所有1 152个头,并按补丁在目标自己的信上提高预期信的登录量对头进行排序。 然后在1,2,4,...,128对100个验证对中将KK顶端的头部加在一起,选择KK,然后报告500对在两个选择中都没有发挥作用的悬浮对的每个结果,而同一层的随机头数目相同(附录A )。 App. A.5 列出了纸张的每个实验, 上面的符号, 它的激活, 它预测的答案。

blocks.en: In our dataset, some inputs have one answer and some have a list. In the list task the asked shape sits in multiple panels. We ask “ What is the letter inside each {shape}? ”, and the model lists the letters from left to right, for example E M U V P A , heart → \to E, U, P, A . We use the list task to study how the model tracks its progress through the list and selects the next panel.
blocks.zh: 在我们的数据集中,有些输入有一个答案,有些则有一个列表. 在列表任务中,被请求的形状坐落在多个面板中. 我们问“每个{形状}里面的字母是什么? ” ,模型列出了从左到右的字母,例如E M U V P A, 心脏 ~\ 至 E, U, P, A。 我们利用列表任务来研究模型如何通过列表跟踪其进展,并选择下一个面板.

blocks.en: 4 Binding: VLMs Resolve Pointers to Solve a Task
blocks.zh: 4 绑定: VLMs 解决任务

blocks.en: Similar to language models ( Prakash et al., 2024 ; Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ; Dai et al., 2024 ; Prakash et al., 2026 ) , we find that vision-language models first resolve a pointer ( Assouel et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) to the image region containing the answer and later execute that pointer to read the answer. To show this, we use the source and target pair setup from Section 3 . We start by patching the entire residual vector at the colon token from the source into the target, one layer at a time, and track the logits of the five candidate letters from Section 3 in the patched target run (Figure 2 a). Up to layer 20 the target’s answer is unchanged in 99.6% of cases or more. From layers 23-29 the target answers with K : the patch transfers the resolved pointer from the source run, but the execution is still done in the target run. From layer 30 on, the patch is a shallow copy of the source’s answer token, D , in 95% of cases or more. The request P and the layout R appear in at most 6.2% of cases at any layer. This shows that the colon token at layers 23-29 holds a resolved pointer. The model then executes this pointer to retrieve the letter from the image, and writes the final answer into the residual stream after these layers. In this section, we investigate where and how this pointer is resolved.
blocks.zh: 与语言模型类似(Prakash等人,2024年;Feng和Steinhardt,2024年). 2024; Dai et al., 2024; Prakash et al., 2026),我们发现,视觉语言模型首先解决了指针(Assouel et al., 2026;Cui et al., 2026)到包含答案的图像区域,后来执行该指针读取答案. 为了显示这一点,我们使用来源 和目标对设置 从第3节。 我们首先将整个在结肠符上的剩余矢量从源头补入目标,一次一层,并在补丁目标运行(图2 a)中跟踪第3节五个候选字母的对数. 到第20层为止,目标答案在99.6%或更多情况下保持不变。 从第23-29层中,目标答案与K:补丁从源运行中传输解析的指针,但执行仍然在目标运行中完成. 从第30层开始,该补丁是来源解答符号D的浅显副本,95%或更多。 请求 P 和布局 R 出现在任何层的最多6.2%的病例中. 这表明第23-29层的结肠符上有一个解析的指针. 模型然后执行这个指针从图像中取回字母,并在这些层后将最后的答案写入剩余流中. 在本节中,我们调查如何解决这个指针。

blocks.en: Figure 2: The pointer is resolved at the shape token by a few attention heads. (a) Patching the source’s residual at the colon token into the target, one layer at a time. Up to layer 20 the target keeps its own letter T ; from layers 23-29 it answers K , the target’s letter at the source’s answer location, so the colon token holds a pointer to a panel; from layer 30 it copies the source’s letter D . (b) The same patch at every text token and every layer, tracking the logit of K : the pointer appears only at the shape token, around layer 20, and at the colon token, from layer 23. (c) The output of one attention head at the shape token replaced with the source’s, for every head; each cell is the mean gain of K over T , and the 16 heads selected by the search sit in layers 15-21 and are outlined.
blocks.zh: 图 2:指针在形状符号上由几个注意头解决. (a) 将来源的残留物在结号上补入目标,每层一层。 到第20层,目标保留自己的字母T;从第23-29层,目标在来源的答案位置上回答K,因此,结肠符号持有一个指针到一个面板;从第30层,它复制来源的字母D。 (b) 在每个文本符号和每层都有一个相同的补丁,跟踪 K 的对数:指针只出现在形状符号,20层周围,和标号,从23层。 (c) 将一个注意头输出在形状符号上,换成源头;每个单元格是K胜T的平均收益,搜索选定的16个头坐落在15-21层,并被概述。

blocks.en: 4.1 Pointers Are Resolved as Early as the User Prompt Tokens
blocks.zh: 4.1 早在用户提示键时就解决了指针

blocks.en: To localize the token where the pointer is resolved, we patch the residual vector at every token in the user prompt and the assistant prompt, at every layer, and track the logit of K in Figure 2 b. In addition to the colon token “ : ” causally carrying the pointer at layers 23-29, we find that the shape token also carries the pointer, although weakly, at the earlier layers 16-20 (App. B.1 ). Since no other earlier token causally carries the pointer, we investigate whether the shape token is where the model resolves the pointer.
blocks.zh: 要定位解析指针的符号,我们在用户提示的每个符号和助手提示的每个符号上补齐残余矢量,并在图2b中跟踪K的对数. 除了结号符号“:......”在23-29层因果地携带指针外,我们发现,在16-20层(App.B.1.),形状指针虽然很弱,但也携带指针。 由于没有其他早期的符号因果地携带指针,我们调查形状符号是否是模型解决指针的地方.

blocks.en: We start by patching the output of one attention head at a time at the shape token. We rank the heads by how much each patch raises the logit of K . We find that the top 16 attention heads, at layers 15-21, causally resolve the pointer (Figure 2 c). Patching the outputs of these 16 heads moves the target to K in 85.9% of cases, while the same number of random heads from the same layers does so in at most 0.1%. When the task is changed from shape-based querying to color-based querying (App. B.5 ), the same heads resolve the pointer. We call them binding heads . No single MLP at the shape token carries the pointer signal (App. B.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先在形状符号上一次补补一个注意力头的输出. 我们按每个补丁 提高K的登录量来排序 我们发现,最高的16个注意力头,在15-21层,因果地解决了指针(图2 c). 将这16个头的输出补丁将目标移动到85.9%的病例中K,而同一层的随机头数最多为0.1%。 当任务从基于形状的查询改为基于颜色的查询(App. B.5)时,相同的头解决指针. 我们称它们为捆绑的头 形状符号上没有单个的MLP携带指针信号(App. B.3 .

blocks.en: We further dissect how attention heads are used by the model to resolve the pointer by patching the queries and the keys of all the attention heads at the shape token separately (Appendix Figure 7 ). We then rank the heads based on the logit differences across the five candidate letters from Section 3 . The queried request is carried through the queries of the attention heads: patching the queries of the top 8 query heads makes the target answer with P , the letter inside its own heart, in 81.0% of cases. The layout is carried through the image keys being read at the shape token: letting the top 8 key heads read the source’s image keys makes the target answer with R in 83.1% of cases, where the pointer is resolved with the target’s request for the star but with the source’s layout. Patching both the queries and the keys of these heads together moves the pointer itself, K , in 95.0% of cases. In other words, the queries act as a proxy for the language instruction “I need to look for stars”, and the keys of the image tokens act like “I am the panel with the star”. Most of the query and key heads we find separately are binding heads (App. B.2 ). When the binding heads read the source’s image values instead, the target’s answer is unchanged in 95.4% of cases (Appendix B.4 ): the queries and keys still select the target’s panel, and the patched values carry only the location, which is the same in both images. The letter is still read from the target’s own image. So the pointer resolved at the shape token is executed later, at the colon token. How does it get there?
blocks.zh: 我们进一步解析模型如何使用注意头来通过将询问和所有注意头的钥匙在形状符号上分别补齐来解析指针(附录图7 ). 然后,我们根据来自第3节的5个候选信的逻辑差异对负责人进行排序。 被询问请求通过关注头的询问进行:将前8位询问头的询问补齐,使目标答案与P,即自己内心的字母,在81.0%的情况下. 该布局通过在形状符号上读取的图像密钥进行:让前8名密钥头读取来源的图像密钥,使得目标答案在83.1%的案例中与R,即指针通过目标对恒星的要求解决,但以来源的布局解决. 在95.0%的案例中,将询问和这些头的键组合起来移动指针,K。 换句话说,查询充当了语言指令“我需要寻找星星”的代名词,图像符号的键像“我是与星星在一起的面板”。 我们单独发现的大多数查询和关键头是绑定头(App. B.2 .). 当绑定头读取源的图像值时,目标答案在95.4%的案例中(附录B.4)没有变化:询问和键仍然选择目标面板,补丁值只携带位置,这在两个图像中都是相同的. 信件仍然从目标自己的形象读取. 因此,在形状符号上解开的指针在以后执行,在结肠符号上执行. 它怎么会到那里?

blocks.en: 4.2 Relay Heads Carry the Resolved Pointer to the Colon Token
blocks.zh: 4.2 中继头 将决断的指针带往科隆托肯

blocks.en: The pointer is resolved at the shape token but executed at the colon token. Since attention is the only component that moves information between tokens, some heads at the colon token must fetch the pointer from the shape token (Figure 3 a). We start by patching the values that each head at the colon token reads from each of the previous tokens, one head at a time, while its query and keys remain unchanged. We rank the heads by how much each patch raises the logit of K . We find that the top 16 attention heads, mostly in layers 19-23, carry the resolved pointer from the shape token to the colon token: patching their values moves the target to K in 87.5% of cases (Appendix Figure 10 a). We call them relay heads .
blocks.zh: 指针在形状符上解决,但在结号符上执行. 由于注意是将信息移动到符之间的唯一组件,一些在结肠符上的头必须从形状符中获取指针(图3 a). 我们首先补齐每个在结号符上头读到的每个前号符的值,一次一个头,而其查询和密钥不变. 我们按每个补丁 提高K的登录量来排序 我们发现,最高的16个注意头,主要是在19-23层,将解开的指针从形状符号带到结肠符号:在87.5%的案例中,将其值补丁将目标移动到K(附录图10 a). 我们叫他们中继头

blocks.en: To localize the token the relay heads bring the pointer from, we now patch the values that all 16 relay heads at the colon token read, one token at a time (Figure 3 a). Reading the shape token alone moves the target to K in 47.3% of cases, against 9.9% for the question mark after it and at most 0.2% for any other token (App. C.1 ). The relay heads read the resolved pointer mostly from the shape token, where the binding heads wrote it.
blocks.zh: 要将继电器头带来的指针定位,我们现在补上所有16个继电器头在结号上读取的值,一次一个指针(图3 a). 在47.3%的案例中,单读形状符号就可以将目标移动到K,而之后的问号为9.9%,其他任何符号最多为0.2%(App.C.1)。 中继头读解指针多从形状符号,装订头写出.

blocks.en: To show that the relay heads carry the pointer resolved by the binding heads at the shape token to the colon token, we test whether they are necessary and sufficient. First, when we block the relay heads’ attention from the colon token to the text tokens, the target keeps its own answer in only 7.8% of cases, against 99.8% when the same number of random heads from the same layers is blocked (App. C.3 ). Second, we take the binding head patching experiment of Section 4.1 , which patches the source’s resolved pointer into the target at the shape token, but let only the relay heads at the colon token of an unedited target read the values from the shape token of this patched run. Here nothing else of the patched run reaches the target, not even its residual vectors, yet the target answers K in 89.0% of cases, as often as in the binding experiment. Conversely, if we keep the binding patch but let the relay heads read the target’s original values, the target’s answer T comes back in 99.8% of cases (App. C.1 ). These collectively show that the binding heads resolve the pointer at the shape token, and the relay heads alone carry it to the colon token, where the model executes it to read the letter from the image.
blocks.zh: 为了显示中继头携带着在形状符号上由绑定头解决的指针到结肠符号,我们测试它们是否必要和足够. 首先,当我们把中继头的注意力从结肠符上阻断到文本符上时,目标只保留了7.8%的答案,而当同一层的相同随机头数被阻断时则保留了99.8%(App.C.3). 第二,我们将第4.1节的绑定头补丁实验,该实验将源的解析指针补到形状符号的目标上,但只让未经编辑的目标的结肠符号的中继头读取这个补丁运行的形状符号的值. 在这里,补丁运行中没有任何其他的到达目标,甚至没有它的剩余向量,然而目标在89.0%的案例中回答了K,就像在绑定实验中一样频繁. 相反,如果我们保留绑定的补丁,但让中继头读取目标原值,则目标T的答案回溯到99.8%的病例(App. C.1 ). 这些集合显示,绑定头在形状符号上解决指针,继电器头单独携带到结肠符号上,模型在那里执行,从图像上读取字母.

blocks.en: Figure 3: (a) Relay heads transfer the pointer from the shape token to the colon. When each relay head may read only one token at a time, the pointer is transferred mostly when the relay heads at the colon token read the shape token. Each cell is the mean gain of K over T on 500 held-out pairs. (b) A copied comma state skips a written panel at layers 20-21 . When patching the source’s comma-token residual into the target’s colon-token residual, one layer at a time: at layer 20 the target skips to its next candidate, T , in 91.0 ± \pm 2.4% of pairs, and in 70.0 ± \pm 3.9% at layer 21. From layers 22-28 it takes the source’s next panel pointer, W , and from layer 30 the source’s letter, A . (c) A copied comma state says where the list goes on . With a more targeted setup, we find at layers 20 and 21 the model answers with the first candidate “after panel 4”, W , in 98.4 ± \pm 1.1% and 97.6 ± \pm 1.3% of pairs. The shaded band marks layers 20-21.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) 中继头将指针从形状符号转移到结肠。 当每个继电器头一次可能只读一个令牌时,指针大多在结号令牌的继电器头读出形状令牌时被转移. 每个细胞是K在500个被搁置的对子上超过T的平均收益. (b) 复制的逗号状态跳过一层20-21的写面板。 当将源的逗号残基补入目标结肠残基时,一个层一个层:在第20层,目标跳到下一个候选人T,在91.0±\pm 2.4%的对中,在700.0±\pm3.9%的21层. 从第22-28层看,它需要源的下一个面板指针W,从第30层看,源的字母A.(c) 一个复制的逗号状态说,列表在哪里。 有了更有针对性的设置,我们在第20层和第21层发现模型答案,第一位候选人是“第4小组之后”,W,98.4±\pm 1.1%和97.6±\pm 1.3%的对。 阴影带标记20-21层.

blocks.en: 5 Progress: VLMs Keep a Cursor to Plan the Next Answer
blocks.zh: 5 进度: VLMs 保留一个光标来规划下一个答案

blocks.en: In Section 4 , we find that the binding heads resolve a pointer at the shape token, and the relay heads carry it to the colon token, where the model executes it to read the letter from the image. We now ask how the model solves the same task when several panels are correct and it has to answer all of them. After each answer, the model has to keep track of how far it has come, which we call progress , and pick the next panel, which we call select . Interestingly, we find that progress is a pointer in the image, “done up to panel 4”, which we call the cursor . The same binding heads bind each written answer to the panel it came from, the comma token turns that panel into the cursor, and the model selects the nearest unwritten panel after it, or stops.
blocks.zh: 在第4节中,我们发现绑定头在形状符号上解决一个指针,中继头将它携带到结肠符号,模型在那里执行它从图像上读取字母. 我们现在问,当几个小组正确,必须回答所有问题时,模型如何解决同样的任务。 在每一个答案之后,模型必须跟踪它已经走了多远,我们称之为进步,并选择下一个面板,我们称之为选择。 有趣的是,我们发现,进步是图像的指针,“跳到第4小组”,我们称之为光标。 相同的绑定头将每个书面回答绑在它来自的面板上,逗号符号将面板转换成光标,模型在它之后选择最近的未写面板,或者停止.

blocks.en: 5.1 The Comma Token Holds Progress at Layers 20-21
blocks.zh: 5.1 逗号控制了20-21层的进展

blocks.en: Since the language backbone is autoregressive, only the tokens after the first answer can carry progress: the answer and comma tokens. To localize progress, we patch the residual vector of the source’s comma token into the target’s colon token, one layer at a time. The source has written one letter and the target none, so the target has no answer token of its own to read, and anything it skips it learned from the patched state. The two runs ask for different shapes and share no letter. They share only the panel the source has just answered from, which is also the target’s first panel: Source: M P X U V A , star prefilled “ Answer: X, ” Target: R S Y T E W , heart prefilled “ Answer: ” With no patch, the target answers Y . If the patch carries progress past the first answer, the target moves on to its second answer, T . If it carries the source’s resolved pointer to its next answer, the target answers with its own letter at panel 6, W . If it is a shallow copy of the source’s next answer, the target answers A , the source’s letter at panel 6. Figure 3 b shows the four outcomes at every layer. Up to layer 17 the target mostly keeps Y . At layer 20 it answers T in 91.0% of cases, and in 70.0% at layer 21. The target skips a panel it never answered from, because a source run with a different shape and different letters answered from it. From layer 22 the source’s next pointer W takes over, and from layer 30 the patch is a shallow copy of A . This shows that the comma token at layers 20-21 holds progress, before it holds the next pointer, and that progress is about a panel, not about a shape or a letter. What form does this progress take?
blocks.zh: 由于语言主干线是自动递归的,只有第一个答案后的符号才能携带进度:答案和逗号符号. 为了将进展本地化,我们将源的逗号符号的剩余矢量补到目标的结号符号中,一个层次地补上. 源头写了一个字母,目标没有,所以目标没有自己的回答符号可以读,任何它跳过它从补丁状态学到的东西. 两者运行要求不同的形状,并共享没有字母. 他们只分享来源刚刚回答的小组, 资料来源:M P X U V A ,恒星预填“回答:X,”目标:R S Y T E W,心脏预填“回答:”没有补丁,目标回答Y。 如果补丁携带进度超过第一个答案,则目标转到第二个答案T. 如果将源的解答指向它的下一个答案,目标用自己的信在6号面板W回答. 如果它是源的下一个答案的浅版,目标回答A, 源的字母在面板上 6. 图3b显示每一层的四个结果。 到第17层 目标大多保持Y。 第20层的回答是91.0%的病例中T,第21层的回答是70.0%。 目标跳过它从未回答过的面板,因为一个源运行的形状不同,不同字母从中回答. 从第22层,来源的下一个指针W接手,从第30层,补丁是A的浅拷贝。 这表明,第20-21层的逗号在持有下一个指针之前就持有进步,而进步则是一个面板,而不是形状或字母. 这种进展采取何种形式?

blocks.en: 5.2 Progress Is an Ordinal Position: “Done up to Here”
blocks.zh: 5.2 进步是一种正式立场:“在此提出”

blocks.en: Progress could be a count (“two answers done”), a set of panels (“panels 2 and 4 done”), or an ordinal position (“done up to panel 4”). To tell them apart, we build a pair in which each form predicts a different answer. The source has written two letters, from panels 2 and 4, and its next answer is at panel 5. The target has hearts in panels 1, 2, 3, and 6, so its own first answer, panel 1, is not a panel the source has answered from: Source: M X U V P A , star prefilled “ Answer: X, V, ” Target: Y T E R S W , heart prefilled “ Answer: ” We patch the source’s comma token into the target’s colon token as before. If progress is a count, “two answers done”, the target skips two hearts and answers E . If it is a set of panels, “panels 2 and 4 done”, the target answers with the first heart in neither panel, its own Y . If it is an ordinal position, “done up to panel 4”, the target answers with the first heart after panel 4, W . Figure 3 c shows the target’s answer at every layer. Up to layer 7 the target answers T in 92.4 to 98.4% of cases: a comma token by itself says “one letter was written”, before it has read anything (App. D.2 ). At layers 13-18 it answers E in 77.8 to 90.8% of cases, so by layer 13 the comma token has counted the written letters. At layer 20 the target answers W in 98.4% of cases, and in 97.6% at layer 21. It keeps its own answer Y , which a set of panels would predict, in at most 1.2% of cases at these layers. So at the layers where the comma token holds progress, progress is an ordinal position: the list is done up to panel 4. We call this position the cursor . Where does the cursor come from?
blocks.zh: 进展可以是计数(“两个答复已完成”),一组小组(“第二组和第四组已完成”),也可以是固定立场(“直到第四组为止”)。 把他们分开,我们造出一对, 每种形式都预言不同的答案。 来文方写了两封信,分别来自第2和第4小组,其下一个答复是在第5小组。 目标在1,2,3和6面板上有心,所以它自己的第一个答案,即1面板,不是来源回答的面板: 资料来源:MX U V P A,明星预填 " 答:X,V, " 目标:Y T E R S W,心脏预填 " 答: " 我们像以前一样将来源的逗号符号补入目标的结号符号中。 如果进展是一个计数,“两个答案完成”,目标跳过两个心脏,回答E。 如果这是一组面板,“第2和第4组完成”,目标用两个面板中的第一个心脏即自己的Y来回答。 如果它是一个平面姿势,“跳到第4面板”,目标用第4面板之后的第一颗心脏回答。 图3c显示目标在每个层次的答案。 目标回答T在92.4%至98.4%的病例中高达第7层:一个逗号本身就写着“写了一封信”,然后才读完(App.D.2)。 在第13-18层,它回答E在77.8%到90.8%的案例中,所以按第13层,逗号符号已经计算出书面字母. 在第20层,目标回答W的98.4%,在第21层,目标回答W的97.6%。 它保持了自己的答案Y, 一组面板可以预测, 在这些层次上,最多有1.2%。 因此,在逗号持有进步的层次上,进步是一个平面位置:列表是按面板完成的 4. 我们称这个位置为光标。 光标从何而来?

blocks.en: 5.3 Binding Heads Set the Cursor at the Last Answer Token
blocks.zh: 5.3 绑定头将光标设置在最后一个答题

blocks.en: The answer tokens are the first tokens that know what has been written. To test whether an answer token sets the cursor, we take a target that has written two letters, and a source image in which the last written letter sits one panel further to the right: Source image: Y M E T R W , heart Target: Y M T E R W , heart prefilled “ Answer: Y, T, ” → \to E The source image is the target’s image with the letters of panels 3 and 4 swapped, so the shapes, the matching panels, and the written letters are unchanged, and only the panel holding T has moved. We let the binding heads at the last answer token, T , read the source’s keys, while their queries and everything else stay the same. If the binding heads bind the written letter to its panel, the cursor moves from panel 3 to panel 4, and the target skips panel 4 and answers W . This happens in 84.2% of cases with the 16 binding heads, and in 0.0% with the same number of random heads from the same layers. The 32 heads that move the cursor the most at the answer token do so in 88.0% of cases, and they sit in the layers of the binding heads (App. D.3 ). The target repeats a written letter in at most 2.4% of cases (App. Figure 14 ). The same patch at the first answer token, with Y moved to panel 4, leaves the answer at E in 96.4 to 98.8% of cases. So the cursor is set at the last answer token.
blocks.zh: 答号是知所写之物的第一符. 为了测试一个答录符是否设置光标,我们取一个写了两个字母的目标,以及一个源图像,其中最后一个书面信件坐落在一个面板上,再往右走: 来源图像:Y M E T R W, 心脏目标:Y M T E R W,心脏预填 "Answer: Y, T," →\to E 来源图像是目标图像,与3号和4号面板的字母互换,因此形状,匹配面板,以及书面字母不变,只有持有T的面板移动了. 我们让最后的回答符号T的绑定头读取源的密钥,而他们的询问和其他一切则保持不变。 如果绑定头将书面字母绑定在它的面板上,光标从面板3移动到面板4,目标跳过面板4并回答W. 这发生在有16个捆绑头的84.2%的病例中,在有相同层随机头数的0.0 %. 将光标移动最多的32个头在88.0%的案例中这样做,它们坐落在绑定头的层中(App.D.3). 目标在最多2.4%的案件中重复了书面信件(同上图14)。 同一个补丁在第一个答案符,Y移动到第4面板,在96.4%到98.8%的案例中留下E的答案. 因此,光标被设置在最后一个答案符号上.

blocks.en: The comma token needs this answer token. When we block the attention from the last comma token to the last answer token, the model writes the same letter again in 67.8% of cases, while blocking its attention to the colon token leaves 99.8% of answers unchanged (App. D.4 ). The cursor marks a panel, not a letter: when the next matching panel holds the letter just written, the model writes that letter again in 95.8% of lists (App. D.3 ). In other words, binding happens twice, largely through the same heads. At the shape token they bind the requested shape to its panels, and at an answer token they bind the letter just written to the panel it came from. By layer 21 the comma token has turned that panel into the cursor. The 8B and 32B hold this cursor cleanly (App. G.1 ).
blocks.zh: 逗号符号需要这个答案符号. 当我们阻止注意从最后一个逗号符号到最后一个回答符号时,模型在67.8%的案例中再次写下同一个字母,同时阻止注意结号符号则留下99.8%的答案不变(App. D.4). 光标标记一个面板,而不是一个字母:当下一个匹配面板持有刚刚写的字母时,模型在95.8%的列表(App. D.3 )中再次写下该字母. 换句话说,捆绑发生两次,主要通过相同的头. 在形状符号上,它们将所请求的形状绑在它的面板上,在回答符号上,它们绑在刚写给面板的信上。 按第21层,逗号使面板变成了光标。 8B和32B保持光标干净(App.G.1)。

blocks.en: 5.4 Select: The Nearest Unwritten Panel After the Cursor, or Stop
blocks.zh: 5.4 选择: 光标之后最接近的未写面板, 或停止

blocks.en: With the matching panels and the cursor both at the comma token, we can read the choice from the model without any patch, by prefilling the letters out of order (Appendix Figure 15 ). With only the second heart written, the model answers with the third in 92.8% of lists and goes back to the first in 2.6%. With only the third written, it answers with the fourth in 64.4% and goes back to the second in 34.4%. With the third and then the first written, it answers with the second in 95.6%. So select starts at the cursor and takes the nearest unwritten panel, preferring the right, and goes back when nothing is left to the right. The written panels also count as done: with the second and then the first written, the model answers with the third in 87.2% of lists, and when the last comma token cannot attend to the second letter, it writes that letter again in 52.8% (App. E.1 ). The gaze heads do not read a written panel: patching their queries to point at an already written panel moves the answer there in 0.6% of cases, against 88.2% for an unwritten one (App. E.6 ).
blocks.zh: 通过匹配面板和光标在逗号符上,我们可以从模型中读取选择,而没有任何补丁,方法是将字母预先填充出顺序(附录图15). 由于只写了第二颗心,模型以92.8%的排行榜第三位给出答案,并以2.6%的排行榜回溯到第一位. 它只写了第三篇,以64.4%回答第四篇,以34.4%回溯第二篇. 以第三篇,然后是第一篇,以95.6%的成绩回答第二篇. 因此,选择从光标开始,取最近的未写面板,偏好右侧,然后在右侧什么都没有时返回. 书面的面板也算作做:用第二张,然后是第一张,模型在87.2%的列表中用第三张回答,当最后一个逗号符号不能处理第二封信时,它又用52.8%(App. E.1 )来写这封信. 凝视头不读书面面板:在已经写好的面板上补齐他们的询问将回答移到0.6%的面板上,而未写到的面板则占88.2%(App. E.6)。

blocks.en: To localize where the choice is made, we hide the next panel from every text token from layer l l on, and sweep l l (Appendix Figure 18 ). Hidden from the first layer, the model moves on to the following panel in 84.8% of cases, so the other matching panels are there to fall back on. Hidden from layer 20 on, it moves on in 72.2% of cases, from layer 21 on in 37.4%, and from layer 25 on in 2.8%. Probes on the comma token’s residual give the same window without any patch: the matching panels are readable with 95.9% accuracy per panel at layer 17 and 99.3% at layer 21, and the next panel with 98.0% at layer 18 and 100.0% at layer 20 (App. E.4 ). The comma token also finds the matching panels again by itself: a source’s set of matching panels patched into the shape token changes the next answer in only 21.0% of cases, and in 64.5% when the comma token keeps only the gaze heads’ view of the image (App. E.3 ). So the choice is made at the comma token in layers 20-25.
blocks.zh: 为了将选择地点本地化,我们将下一张面板从每个文本符号的ll层中隐藏起来,并扫描l(附录图18 ). 从第一层隐藏,模型在84.8%的案例中移动到下面的面板上,所以其他匹配面板会掉到后面. 从第20层到第27.2层,从第21层到第37.4%,从第25层到第2.8%。 逗号残留物上的探测器给同一窗口没有补丁:匹配面板在17层为95.9%,在21层为99.3%,在18层为98.0%,在20层为100.0%(App. E.4)。 逗号符号本身也再次发现了匹配面板:一个源的匹配面板补齐了形状面板,在只有21.0%的案例中修改了下一个答案,在64.5%中,逗号符号只保留图像的目光头像(App. E.3). 因此选择是在逗号上以20-25层进行.

blocks.en: The cursor acts on this choice through the comma token’s residual. We move the cursor by letting the 32 answer-token heads read the source image’s keys, and then hold the comma token’s residual at the target’s own values at one layer. Held at layer 23 or later, the target’s own answer comes back in 99.4% of cases, while held at layer 19 or earlier, the patch keeps its effect in 69.8%. Holding the gaze heads’ queries at the comma token instead brings the answer back in 99.8% (App. E.4 ). No small set of heads makes this choice: it is spread over layers 20-25, and the gaze heads read its result (App. E.7 ). The same step decides when to stop. At the last letter the model chooses between a comma and the end of its turn. Patching the outputs of the heads found there makes a finished list go on in 100.0% of cases and a continuing list stop in 96.8%, against 0.2% and 0.0% for the same number of random heads (App. E.1 ). On COCO images, when we block the comma token’s attention to the object already described, the model names that object again in 79.6% of cases (App. G.3.6 ).
blocks.zh: 光标通过逗号符号的剩余部分执行此选择 。 我们移动光标, 让32 个答题头读取源图像的密钥, 然后将逗号的剩余值放在目标本身的值上一层。 目标本身的答案在99.4%的案例中被保留在23层或以后,而在19层或更早的情况下被保留在69.8%。 将目光头像的询问放在逗号上, 没有一个小头组会做出这个选择:它分布在20-25层,目光头部会读到它的结果(App. E.7). 同一步骤决定何时停止。 在最后一个字母中,模型在逗号和转动结束之间选择. 将发现的头部的输出补齐后,在100.0%的病例中完成了清单,在96.8%的病例中连续停止了清单,而在同样数目的随机头部中则只有0.2%和0.0%(App.E.1)。 在COCO图像上,当我们封锁逗号对已经描述的对象的注意时,79.6%的案例中再次对对象的模型名称(App. G.3.6).

blocks.en:
We find one additional step in the plan when the prompt asks for a reading order. With List them from right to left. added to the question, 16 heads in layers 18-23 read this instruction. These heads act before the cursor forms, and the model uses what they read to set the direction of the cursor. Instead of taking the next panel to the right, the model takes the next panel to the left of the cursor. When we block these heads from the instruction, the list returns to left to right in 98.4% of cases.
Conversely, blocking every other head, the list stays right to left in 98.4% (App. G.3.5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们发现计划里还有一个步骤, 当及时要求阅读命令。 从右到左列出 加上这个问题,第18-23层的16个头读了这个指示. 这些头在光标形成之前行动,模型使用它们读到的东西来设定光标的方向. 模型不把下一个面板放在右边,而是把下一个面板放在光标左边. 当我们把这些头挡在指示之外时,清单在98.4%的案例中向左向右返回。
反之,封锁其他头部,名单在98.4%(App.G.3.5.)中保持右向左.

blocks.en: Figure 4: (a) Gaze heads exist after layer 20. Pointer logit gain when one head’s query at the colon token is patched. The 32 gaze heads are outlined, all in layers 19-34. (b) Our gaze heads vs. the published Gaze Heads ( Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) . Solid lines replace the queries and count the target’s letter at the source’s panel, K . Dashed lines let the heads read the source’s image values and count the source’s letter at the target’s panel, C . The vertical lines mark our 32 heads and the top 100 published heads. Our 32 heads beat the top 100 published heads, and random heads stay at or below 2.1 ± \pm 1.0%. (c) Language heads set the language. Scoring the language change of a word when patching attention head outputs from a source in a different language. The 16 language heads are outlined, in layers 19-35. The color scale is capped at 1.6; L24H27 scores 5.03.
blocks.zh: 图4:(a) 第20层后有盖兹头。 当一个头部在结号符上的查询被补齐时, 指向日志会增加 。 32个目光头被勾画出来,都是19-34层. (b) 我们的目光与已出版的Gaze Heads(Gandikota和Bau,2026年)相对应。 实线取代了询问,在消息来源的面板K点数目标的信。 低调的行让头部读取源图像值, 竖线标志着我们32个头部和100个出版的头部前列. 我们的32个头击败了前100个公布的头部,随机头部停留在2.1±\pm1.0%左右. (c) 语言主管确定语言。 在从不同语言的源头补上注意头输出时对一个词的语言变化进行校验. 16个语言头被概括为19-35层. 颜色尺度上限为1.6;L24H27得分5.03.

blocks.en: 6 Executing the Pointer: Visual Retrieval and Translation
blocks.zh: 6个 执行指针:视觉检索和翻译

blocks.en: Through binding, progress tracking, and selecting, VLMs resolve pointers to the image regions that contain the answer. In this section, we investigate how the model executes these pointers to retrieve the visual information and translate it into text.
blocks.zh: 通过绑定,进度跟踪和选择,VLMs解析指向包含答案的图像区域. 在本节中,我们调查模型如何执行这些指针来获取视觉信息并将其翻译为文本.

blocks.en: 6.1 Gaze Heads Read the Panel Referenced by the Pointer
blocks.zh: 6.1 盖兹头 读取指针引用的面板

blocks.en: The pointer is carried to the colon token, but the letter it points to is still in the image. Some attention heads at the colon token must build their queries using the pointer to be able to look back at the corresponding image region. We start by patching the queries of one attention head at a time at the colon token, from the source into the target, using the single-answer task setup from Section 3 . We rank the heads by how much each patch raises the logit of K , the target’s letter at the source’s panel. We find that the top 32 attention heads, in layers 19-34, execute the pointer: patching their queries moves the target to K in 74.0% of cases, while the same number of random heads from the same layers does so in 0.0% (Figure 4 a). We call them gaze heads .
blocks.zh: 指针被携带到结肠符上,但其指向的字母仍然在图像中. 结肠符上的一些注意头必须使用指针来构建他们的查询,以便能够回顾相应的图像区域. 我们首先用第3节的单答任务设置,从源头到目标,一次将一个注意头的询问补齐。 我们按每个补丁如何提高目标方在消息来源小组的字母K的登录量来排列头部。 我们发现,在19-34层中,最高的32个关注头执行指针:在74.0%的案例中,补齐他们的询问会将目标移动到K,而同一层中随机头的数量则以0.0%(图4 a)进行. 我们叫他们凝视头

blocks.en: We show that the gaze heads execute the pointer resolved by the binding heads, by testing whether the pointer acts through them and whether they are enough to read the image. First, we take the binding head patching experiment of Section 4.1 , which patches the source’s resolved pointer into the target at the shape token, but keep the gaze heads’ queries at the target’s original values. The target keeps its own answer T in 98.4% of cases, while keeping the same number of random heads lets the patched pointer through in 86.5%. So when the gaze heads’ queries are overwritten, the patched pointer has no effect, which shows that the pointer acts through them. Second, we block the attention to the image from every head at every token, except the shape token and the 32 gaze heads at the colon token. The target still answers T in 95.1% of cases, against 4.8% when random heads see the image in their place. So the image needs to be read at only few tokens: at the shape and answer tokens to resolve the pointer, and by the gaze heads at the colon token to execute it. The gaze heads’ queries carry the pointer, the image keys match it by place, and the image values bring the letter. When the gaze heads read the source’s image values instead, the target answers with the source’s letter at its own panel, C , in 93.7% of cases (App. F.3 ). When we block the gaze heads’ attention to the image, the target still answers T in 88.2% of cases. This is not because other heads at the colon token read the pointer in their place, but because the tokens between the shape token and the colon token also read the letter from the image. When we block both paths, only 2.6% of answers survive (App. C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们显示,目视头执行由绑定头解决的指针,通过测试指针是否通过它们行事,以及它们是否足以读取图像. 首先,我们将第4.1节的绑定头补丁实验,它将源的解析指针固定在形状指示符的目标上,但将目光头的询问保持在目标原始值上。 目标在98.4%的案例中保持自己的回答T,同时保持相同的随机头数让补丁指针通过86.5%. 因此,当凝视头的询问被覆盖时,补丁指针没有效果,这表明指针通过它们行事. 第二,我们阻止人们注意每个标志物的图像,除了形状标志物和32个凝视标志物。 目标在95.1%的案例中仍然回答T,而当随机头部看到影像的位置时则回答4.8%. 因此,图像只需要在几个符号上读取:在形状和回答符号上就可以解析指针,通过凝视头到结肠符号上就可以执行. 凝视头的询问带有指针,图像密钥逐处匹配,图像值则带来字母. 当凝视者头目读取来源的图像值时,目标在93.7%的案例中用来源的字母C来回答(App.F.3)。 目标仍在88.2%的病例中回答T。 这并不是因为其他在结肠符上的头在他们的位置上读指针,而是因为形状符与结肠符之间的指针也从图像上读到字母. 当我们阻挡两条路径时,只有2.6%的答案存活下来(App. C.3 .

blocks.en: Our gaze heads resemble the published Gaze Heads ( Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) . Unlike our gaze heads, which we find by patching, the published Gaze Heads were found by observing the attention patterns of a model describing comic book panels. Most of our gaze heads are among the published Gaze Heads (23 of 32 in the top 100), yet our smaller set is causally more effective. Patching the queries of the top 100 published heads moves the target to K in 64.2% of cases, against 74.0% for our 32 gaze heads, and letting them read the source’s image values gives C in 50.0%, against 93.7% (Figure 4 b). Our set is also smaller because our task is narrow: it retrieves text from images, while describing a comic panel draws on many types of visual content, such as color, objects, and mood. Gandikota and Bau (2026) show that individual Gaze Heads specialize in fetching these types of content. When we repeat the search on tasks that retrieve a shape or a drawn object instead of text, we find partly different heads (App. F.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的目光头像已出版的盖兹头像(Gandikota和Bau,2026年)。 与我们通过补丁找到的目光头不同的是,出版的Gaze头像是通过观察描述漫画面板的模型的注意模式而发现的. 我们大多数的目光头目都是出版的Gaze Heads(前100位的32位中的23位),然而我们的较小的镜头却因果效果更高. 在64.2%的病例中,将前100名公布的头部的询问补到K,而我们的32个目光头部则只有74.0%,让他们阅读源头的图像值以50.0%表示C,而93.7%表示(图4b)。 我们的设定也比较小,因为我们的任务很狭窄:它从图像中检索到文本,同时描述一个漫画面板借鉴了多种类型的视觉内容,如颜色,物品,和心情. Gandikota和Bau(2026年)显示,个人Gaze Head专门获取这些类型的内容. 当我们重复搜索获取形状或绘图对象而不是文本的任务时,我们会发现部分不同的头(App. F.5 ).

blocks.en: 6.2 Gaze Heads Return a Concept, Not a Word
blocks.zh: 6.2 盖兹头返回一个概念,而不是一个字

blocks.en: The gaze heads read the region at the pointer, but it is unclear whether they return the meaning of the visual concept or the textual representation for it. To test this, we use colored shapes without letter labels and ask “ What shape is the green marker? ” in English, German, French, or Chinese. The model answers with the right shape in the question’s language in 100.0% of cases (App. A.6 ). This setup lets us study the model when several answers are correct depending on the language of the question (e.g., circle vs. cercle ).
blocks.zh: 凝视头在指针处读出这个区域,但不清楚它们是否还原视觉概念的意义,还是其文字代表. 为了测试这一点,我们使用没有字母标签的彩色形状,并问“绿色标记是什么形状?” 英文、德文、法文或中文。 该模型在100.0%的案例中以问题语言正确的形式回答问题(App.A.6)。 这个设置让我们研究模型,当几个答案根据问题的语言(如圆圈 vs. cercle )而正确.

blocks.en: We take the collective LogitLens token distribution of the 32 gaze heads and find that it is nearly the same for one image under two languages, with a cosine of 0.95, and different for two images under one language, 0.50. The top logits of the gaze heads are always English or Chinese, irrespective of the question’s language. When we patch the outputs of the gaze heads from a source that asks in another language about another image, the target names the source’s shape in its own language in 82.0% of cases and never changes the language, against 0.0% for the same number of random heads. So the gaze heads return the concept, not the word (App. F.4 ). How does the concept become a word in the question’s language?
blocks.zh: 我们用LogitLens的32个目光头的标志性分布,发现在两种语言下一个图像几乎相同,其余弦为0.95,在一个语言下两个图像则不同,0.50。 观众头顶的对数总是英文或中文, 当我们从另一个语言中询问另一个图像的源头补上凝视头的输出时,目标以82.0%的病例来命名源头的形状,而同样数量的随机头则用0.0 % 来命名。 因此,目光头还原了这个概念,而不是这个词(App.F.4. 这一概念如何成为问题语言中的一个词?

blocks.en: The language is added by a different set of heads. We start by patching the output of one attention head at a time from a source that asks in another language. We rank the heads by how much each patch raises the logit of the target’s answer in the source’s language. We find that the top 16 attention heads, in layers 19-35, add the language: patching their outputs moves the language in 95.3% of cases without ever copying the source’s shape, while the same number of random heads does so in 0.0% (Figure 4 c). We call them language heads . The late MLPs then use them to write the word (App. F.6 ). So an answer ends with a translation step: the gaze heads return a concept, the language heads add the language of the question, and the late MLPs join the two into a word. On COCO images with natural list questions (“ What animals are in this image? ”), the gaze heads at the comma token attend more to the object named next than to the object just named in 83.6% of lists, and setting the language heads to their English averages turns 96.5% of non-english answers into English (App. G.3.6 ). They also generalize to scattered shapes on a blank canvas (App. G.3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 语言由不同的头组添加. 我们首先从另一个语言的源头中补齐一个注意头的输出。 我们按每个补丁如何用源语言对目标答案进行登录来排序。 我们发现,前16位的注意头,在19-35层中,添加语言:在95.3%的案例中,补丁输出会移动语言,而同样数量的随机头在0.0 % (图4 c)中会移动语言。 我们称他们为语言领袖。 后期的MLP随后使用它们来书写单词(App. F. 所以一个答案以一个翻译步骤结尾:瞪羚头还原了一个概念,语言头添加了问题的语言,而后期的MLP将两者合并为一个单词. 在有自然列表问题的COCO图像上(“这个图像中有哪些动物?”),在逗号标志上的目光头目比在83.6%的列表中刚刚命名的物体更关注旁边的物体,并将语言头目设定为他们的英语平均值将96.5%的非英语答案转化为英语(App. G.3.6)。 它们也会在空白画布上泛指散落的形状(App.G.3.2.)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We find a structured plan inside VLMs for describing images. The model recomputes this plan at every answer to decide which region to describe next, then reads that region and narrates what it sees. At the shape token, binding heads match the user-requested text against the image to resolve a pointer to every matching image region. Relay heads carry this pointer to the current token, where gaze heads execute it and retrieve the visual content. Language heads along with the late MLPs translate the retrieved visual content into the language of the question. When several regions match, the model tracks its progress with the same components. Binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, the comma token turns that region into a cursor, the place in the image up to which the list has been written, and the model selects the nearest unwritten region after the cursor.
blocks.zh: 我们在VLMs内部找到一个描述图像的结构化计划. 模型在每次回答时都会重新计算这个计划,以决定接下来要描述哪个区域,然后读出那个区域并叙述它所看到的. 在形状符号上,绑定头将用户请求的文本与图像匹配,以解析每个匹配图像区域的指针. 中继头将这个指针携带到当前符号上,在那里凝视头执行并检索视觉内容. 语言头和晚期的MLP将检索到的视觉内容翻译为问题的语言. 当几个区域相匹配时,模型会用相同的组件跟踪其进展. 绑定头将每个书面答复绑定在它来自的区域,逗号符号将那个区域变成光标,列表上方的图像位置,模型在光标后选择最近的未写区域.

blocks.en: The plan is structured and modular: each step can be isolated and edited, with a clear causal effect on what the model outputs. This makes it a tool to explain, audit, and debug model outputs. At the same time, isolating this plan lets us steer the model’s planning and its outputs. More broadly, our work offers a way to study how models plan over long, multi-step tasks and how they reason over what they see.
blocks.zh: 该计划是结构化和模块化的:每个步骤都可以被隔离和编辑,对模型输出什么有明显的因果关系. 这使得它成为解释,审计和调试模型输出的工具. 与此同时,孤立这个计划使我们能够指导模型的规划及其产出。 更广泛地说,我们的工作提供了一种方法来研究模式如何规划长期、多步骤的任务,以及它们如何解释它们所看到的。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: We used generative AI tools in four ways. First, to polish the writing and for spell check. Second, we used AI agents to scale up experiments that we designed and wrote ourselves, and to propose alternative hypotheses, which we then tested and ruled out in the paper. Third, we used them to search for related papers; we read the papers and wrote the related work ourselves. Fourth, we used them to clean up the structure of our codebase. We reviewed all AI-assisted work, and we take responsibility for the final content of this paper, including its text, claims, and code.
blocks.zh: 我们使用基因AI工具有四个方面. 首先,擦亮写作和咒语检查。 其次,我们用AI代理来扩大我们自己设计和写的实验,并提出替代假设,然后在论文中测试和排除. 第三,我们用它们来寻找相关文件;我们自己阅读这些文件并撰写相关工作。 第四,我们用它们来清理我们代码库的结构. 我们审查了大赦国际协助的所有工作,我们对本文件的最后内容负责,包括其案文、主张和守则。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: This appendix gives everything the experiments of the main paper share: the model and its settings, the images and prompts of the two tasks, the pairs and splits, how a patch is applied and how attention is blocked, how heads are chosen, the language tasks, and how reliable the model is with no patch.
blocks.zh: 本附录给出了主要纸张共享的实验内容:模型及其设置,两个任务的图像和提示,对接和拆分,一个补丁是如何应用的以及如何阻断注意力,头部如何选择,语言任务,模型没有补丁是多么可靠.

blocks.en: A.1 Model and Settings
blocks.zh: A.1 模型和设置

blocks.en: Unless stated otherwise, all experiments use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct at revision 0c351dd0 . Appendices G.1 and G.2 give the settings of the other models. We load it in 32-bit floating point with the eager attention implementation, so that we can read and patch every attention weight and every intermediate state. TensorFloat-32 is turned off. Decoding is greedy. The language model has 36 layers, a hidden size of 4,096, and 32 query heads of width 128 per layer. It has 8 key-value groups, so four query heads share each group of keys and values. We never change a weight, and we apply every patch during a forward pass. The vision encoder runs once per image, and we cache its output and never patch it.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,否则所有实验均使用Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct在0c351dd0修订中. 附录G.1和G.2给出了其他模型的设置. 我们把它装入32位的浮点 与急切的注意力执行, 这样我们可以读和补补 每一个注意力重量和每一个中间状态。 TensorFloat-32 关闭。 解脱贪着. 语言模型共有36层,隐藏大小4,096个,32个查询头每层128个宽度. 它有8个密钥值组,因此4个查询头共享每组密钥和值. 我们从不改变重量, 在前行时,我们应用每一个补丁。 视觉编码器每张图像运行一次,我们缓存其输出,永远不补补.

blocks.en: For each run we cache the keys and values of every token up to the last image token. We then recompute the text tokens after the image in one forward pass on top of this cache, and we apply every patch inside that pass. With no patch, this pass reproduces the letter scores of an ordinary forward pass to within 7 × 10 − 5 7\times 10^{-5} . We process several patched copies of one run as one batch.
blocks.zh: 每次运行时,我们都会缓存每个符号的键和值,直到最后一个图像符号。 然后我们重新计算图像之后的文本符号 在一个前方通过这个缓存, 我们应用了每一个补丁 在那个通过。 在没有补丁的情况下,此传承普通前传的字母分数在7×10−5 7\times 10×5}之内. 我们处理几个补丁副本 一个运行作为一个批。

blocks.en: A.2 The Single-Answer Task
blocks.zh: A.2 单一答复 任务

blocks.en: Each image is a strip of 1,536 by 384 pixels holding four square panels of 384 pixels, each with a 3-pixel gray border on a white background. Each panel holds one marker, a shape outline with a 6-pixel black stroke and white fill. The shape is about 106 pixels across (140 for the star, whose inside is smaller), and one bold capital letter in 48-point DejaVu Sans Bold sits at its center. We draw the center of the marker uniformly inside the panel, at least 78 pixels from each edge. The source and the target of a pair share marker positions. The shapes are star, square, circle, triangle, diamond, plus, and heart, and each image uses four different shapes. Letters come from a pool of 21 capital letters (Appendix A.7 ). The image becomes 576 image tokens, a grid of 48 by 12, so each panel is 12 tokens wide.
blocks.zh: 每个图像是1,536的条,由384像素组成,上面有4个方形面板,384像素,每个面板上有一个白色背景的3像素灰色边框. 每个面板各持有一个标记,一个形状轮廓,带有6像素的黑色中风和白色填充. 形状大约为106像素横跨(140为恒星,其内部较小),48分的DejaVu Sans Bold中有一个粗体大写字母坐落在其中心. 我们在面板内划出统一的标记中心,每个边缘至少有78像素. 一对共享标记位置的源头和目标. 形状为恒星,正方形,圆形,三角形,菱形,外加和心形,每个图像使用四个不同的形状. 字母来源于21个大写字母的集合(附录A.7). 图像变为576个图像符号,网格为48乘12,所以每个面板都是12个符号宽.

blocks.en: The user turn holds the image followed by the text Answer with the letter only. What is the letter inside the {shape}? There is no system prompt. After the chat template’s assistant tag we append Answer: , so the prompt ends with the colon token and the next token is the answer. Every shape name is one token, and every answer is the single token made of a space and the letter. The prompts of a source and a target have the same length and differ at exactly one position, the shape token. The image tokens sit at positions 4 to 579, the shape token at position 593, and the colon token at position 601. The tokens after the shape token are the question mark, the end-of-turn token, a newline, the assistant tag (two tokens), a newline, Answer , and the colon token.
blocks.zh: 用户转动时只持有图像,然后是文字回答。 {形状}里面的字母是什么? 没有系统提示。 在聊天模板的助手标记之后, 我们附加答: 因此, 提示结束为冒号, 下一个是答案 。 每个形状名称都是一个符号,每个答案都是由一个空间和字母制成的单个符号. 一个源和目标的提示具有相同的长度,并且完全在一个位置上不同,即形状符号. 图像符号坐落于第4-579位,形状符号坐落于第593位,结肠符号坐落于第601位. 形状令牌之后的标志有问号,转折令牌,新线,助手标记(两个令牌),新线,回答,以及结肠令牌.

blocks.en: In each pair, the source and the target use the same four shapes in different orders, ask for different shapes, and use eight different letters. We keep a pair only if the five outcome letters of Section 3 ( T , D , K , P , and R ) are all different in both directions. The model must also answer both of its questions correctly with no patch. We use one set of source-target pairs to rank heads (the discovery pairs), a second set to fix the number of heads (the validation pairs), and a third, held-out set to report every result.
blocks.zh: 每对中,源与目标使用相同的四个形状,顺序不同,要求不同的形状,并使用八个不同的字母. 只有第3节的五个结果字母(T、D、K、P和R)在两个方向上都不同,我们才保留一对。 模型还必须在没有补丁的情况下正确回答其两个问题. 我们使用一组源目标对头进行排名(发现对头),第二组确定头数(验证对头),第三组被搁置,报告每个结果。

blocks.en: After a patch, we take the most likely next token over the full vocabulary and score it as one of the outcome letters or as a miss. Some tables also report Gaze , the cases in which the published Gaze Heads ( Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) look at the expected panel. For each of the top 100 heads of that ranking, we sum its attention from the colon token over the image tokens of each panel. We add these sums over the 100 heads and take the panel with the largest total. We never refit that ranking.
blocks.zh: 在补丁之后,我们将最有可能的下一个符号放在完整的词汇上,并把它评为结果字母之一或误读. 一些表格还报道了Gaze, 出版的Gaze Heads(Gandikota和Bau, 2026年)考察了预期的面板。 对于排名前100名的每个头目, 我们将其注意力从结肠符中 相加于每个面板的图像符。 我们用100多个人头来加上这些钱,然后把小组的总数最多。 我们从不重排排名

blocks.en: A.3 The List Task
blocks.zh: A.3 清单任务

blocks.en: Each image is one row of six panels of 384 by 384 pixels. Every panel holds one marker drawn as in the single-answer task. The markers are larger, so that the letter sits clear of the outline: the circle has a radius of 72 pixels and the star of 100. Marker centers are uniform in 106 to 278 pixels on both axes and are shared by all images of a pair.
blocks.zh: 每个图像是一行6个面板384乘384像素. 每个面板都持有一个在单答任务中绘制的标记. 标记较大,使字母坐落在轮廓之外:圆形半径72像素,恒星100. 标记中心在两轴上的106到278像素中是统一的,并被一对的所有图像共享.

blocks.en: The user turn holds the image followed by Answer with the letters only, separated by a comma and a space. What is the letter inside each {shape}? The assistant turn starts with Answer: . The model writes K, U, E : a letter token, a comma token, a letter token. So the last comma token chooses the next letter, and the last letter chooses between a comma and the end of the turn. Letters that we write for the model are ordinary tokens of the assistant turn. Throughout the appendix we write r 1 < r 2 < r 3 < r 4 r_{1}<r_{2}<r_{3}<r_{4} for the target’s four matching panels.
blocks.zh: 用户转弯时只持有字母的Answer,然后用逗号和一个空格隔开。 每个{形状}里面的字母是什么? 助手转身先答:. 模特儿写K,U,E:一个字母符号,逗号符号,一个字母符号. 因此,最后一个逗号符号选择下一个字母,最后一个字母选择一个逗号与转弯结束. 我们为模型写的字母是助手转弯的普通符号. 在附录中,我们为目标的四个匹配面板写作r 1 < r 2 < r 3 < r 4 r r r_{1}<2}<r_{3}<r_{4}。

blocks.en: We ask for stars, hearts, or triangles, which the model lists reliably. It does not list squares and pluses reliably. The other panels hold any of the remaining shapes, except the ones the model confuses with the asked shape in a preliminary check. So there is no triangle or plus when we ask for stars, and no diamond or heart when we ask for triangles. In the same check, when the asked shape sat in five of six panels, the model often listed the sixth panel too, so we use four.
blocks.zh: 我们要求的是恒星, 心脏,或三角形, 模型列出了可靠的。 它没有可靠地列出方块和方块。 其他面板则持有任何剩余的形状,但模型在初步检查中与所询问的形状相混淆的形状除外。 所以,当我们要求星星时,没有三角形或附加形;当我们要求三角形时,没有钻石或心脏形. 在同一张支票中,当被询问的形状坐落在六个面板中的五个时,模型也经常列出第六面板,所以我们使用四个面板.

blocks.en: Each pair has one target and several sources that share the asked shape, the marker centers, and the written letter. The target has the asked shape in four panels, which cycle over all 15 choices of four panels out of six. The main source has the asked shape at r 2 r_{2} and r 4 r_{4} , and the target’s first letter written at r 2 r_{2} . All its other letters are new, so a source letter in the answer is a copied read. For the first answer the same source carries a new letter in place of the shared one. For stopping, a source has the asked shape at r 1 r_{1} only. The supporting experiments add sources with the asked shape at r 1 r_{1} and r 3 r_{3} (the moved set), at r 3 r_{3} and r 4 r_{4} , and at r 1 r_{1} and a panel that holds another shape in the target. The progress experiments of Section 5 draw their own pairs at random from the same shapes and letters, with the panels stated in each subsection. They keep a pair only if both unedited runs give the expected next letter.
blocks.zh: 每对都有一个目标 和几个来源 共享要求的形状,标记中心, 和书面信件。 目标以四个面板的形式提出,在六个面板中循环四个面板的所有15个选择。 主要来源有 r 2 r_{2} r 4 r_{4} 和目标的第一个字母 r 2 r_{2} 。 它的其他所有字母都是新字母,所以答案中的源字母就是被复制的读数. 对于第一个答案,同一个来源带了一个新的字母来代替共享的字母. 停止时, 源头只有 r 1 r_{1} 的形状 。 辅助实验在 r 1 r_{1} 和 r r r_{3} (移动的设定) 上, 在 r 3 r_{3} 和 r 4 r_{4} 和 r 1 r_{1} 上, 加上了 r r_{1} 和 一个在目标中具有另一个形状的面板 。 第5节的进度实验从相同的形状和字母中随机抽取自己的对子,每个小节中都注明了面板. 只有在两个未经编辑的运行给出预期的下一个字母时,它们才会保留一对.

blocks.en: The splits are those of the single-answer task: discovery, validation, and held-out pairs. We always test the head sets of Sections 4 and 6 first, unchanged, and only then search again. We count a case when the unedited runs it needs give the right next token. With no patch, the target’s second letter is right in 97.4 ± \pm 1.0% of candidate pairs and the source’s in 99.5 ± \pm 0.4%. The first letters are right in 95.9 ± \pm 1.2% and 99.2 ± \pm 0.5%. The source with one matching panel ends its turn in 96.1 ± \pm 1.2%.
blocks.zh: 拆分是单答任务的拆分:发现,验证,和搁置对. 我们总是先测试4号和6号机组的头部,没有改变,然后再搜索一次. 我们数一个案件,当未经编辑的运行 它需要给正确的下一个标志。 在没有补丁的情况下,目标第二个字母在97.4 ±\pm 1.0%的候选对中正确,而来源在99.5 ±\pm 0.4%。 最早的字母为右95.9±\pm 1.2%和99.2±\pm0.5%. 一个匹配面板的源头以96.1±\pm 1.2%结束其转折.

blocks.en: To hide a panel from a token we remove that token’s attention to the image tokens of the panel, in all heads of the chosen layers. The instruction tokens before the shape token also read the image, so “every text token” means every token after the image.
blocks.zh: 为了将面板从一个符号中隐藏起来,我们删除了该符号对面板的图像符号的注意,在所选各层的所有头部。 形状符号前的指示符号也读出图像,因此"每个文本符号"是指图像之后的每一个符号.

blocks.en: A.4 Patches, Blocked Attention, and How Heads Are Chosen
blocks.zh: A.4 补丁、阻碍注意和头部如何选择

blocks.en: Every patch acts while the target processes one token. We record source states from the source’s own unedited run at the same token position. This is possible because the two prompts align token by token. Everything that is not named stays the target’s own, and all later computation runs normally on the patched state.
blocks.zh: 每个补丁在目标处理一个符号时都行动. 我们记录了来源在相同位置上从来源本身未经编辑的运行情况。 这之所以可能,是因为两个提示按符号排列。 没有命名的一切都是目标自己的,所有后来的计算都正常运行在补丁状态上.

blocks.en: At layer l l we replace the residual vector of the token with the source’s vector at the same layer. A patch at layer l l replaces the input to layer l l , and layer 36 stands for the input to the final normalization.
blocks.zh: 在I层,我们用同一层的源矢量来取代信物的残余矢量。 一层的补丁l代替了一层的输入l,第36层代表了最终正常化的输入.

blocks.en: For one head we replace the query vector of the token, after the query normalization and the rotary position encoding, with the source’s. The two runs share positions, so the position encoding is identical.
blocks.zh: 在查询正常化和旋转位置编码之后,我们用源代码替换一个符号的查询矢量。 两者运行共享位置,因此位置编码相同.

blocks.en: For one head we recompute only its attention scores to the image tokens, using the target’s query and the source’s image keys from the key-value group that head reads. Its scores to the text tokens, its values, and all other heads are unchanged. Because four query heads share each group of keys, this patch changes what one head reads without changing the keys the other three heads see.
blocks.zh: 对于一个头来说,我们只用目标查询和源头读取的密钥值组的图像键来重算它对于图像符号的注意分数。 它对文本符号的分数,它的值,以及所有其他头都不变. 由于每组密钥共有四个查询头,这个补丁会改变一个头所读的而不改变另外三个头所看到的密钥.

blocks.en: For a head processing the colon token or a comma token, let α s \alpha_{s} be its attention weight on source token s s and v s v_{s} the value it reads there. We replace the head’s output o o with o + ∑ s ∈ S α s ​ ( v s new − v s ) o+\sum_{s\in S}\alpha_{s}(v_{s}^{\text{new}}-v_{s}) , where S S is the set of source tokens named in the experiment. The new values v new v^{\text{new}} come from the source, or from a run with the binding-head patch, which is the target with only the binding heads’ outputs patched from the source at the shape token (Appendix C.1 ). The attention weights are the target’s own. For the gaze heads, we apply the same patch to the image tokens.
blocks.zh: 对于处理结号符或逗号符的头部,请让α s\ alpha_{s}成为它在源号符S和v sv_{s}上面的注意重。 我们用 o + + → s → S → s (v s new - v s) o summ → s\\ in 替换头部输出 o , S}\alpha_{s}(v_{s}^{\text{new}}-v_{s}),其中SS是实验中命名的源符号集. 新的值 v new { text{ new}来自源代码,或来自绑定头补丁的运行,它是目标,只有绑定头的输出从源代码(Appendix C.1 )上补丁到形状符号上. 注意力的重量是目标自己的。 对于目光头来说,我们把同样的补丁应用到图像符号上.

blocks.en: We replace the output of a head at the token, taken before the layer’s shared output projection, with the source’s. An MLP patch replaces the output of one MLP at the token.
blocks.zh: 我们用源头来取代在层面共享输出投影之前的标点头输出。 一个MLP补丁取代一个MLP在符号上的输出.

blocks.en: To block the attention from a token to a set of source tokens, we set the chosen heads’ attention scores from that token to those source tokens to the most negative value before the softmax. The softmax then renormalizes the head’s remaining attention as usual. To hold a state at its own value we record it from the unedited target and write it back on top of the patch.
blocks.zh: 为了阻止人们从一个符号到一组源代码的注意力,我们把被选中的头的注意力分数从那个符号到那些源代码到软马克之前的最负值。 软放大器会像往常一样使头部的剩余注意力恢复正常. 为了保持状态的自身价值 我们从未经编辑的目标记录下来 并把它写回补丁上面

blocks.en: For each attention patch, we start by applying the patch to one head at a time, for all 1,152 heads, on the discovery pairs. We score each head by the change in the gap between the logit of the letter the patch should produce and the logit of the target’s own letter, averaged over cases and both directions. We then apply the patch to the top K K heads together on the validation pairs, for K K in 1, 2, 4, …, 128 (256 for the gaze heads). A rule fixed before these runs takes the smallest K K for which the patch moves the letter in at least 80% of cases, or the best K K if none does. On the single-answer task, the Gaze count must reach 80% as well. We then run the chosen heads once on the held-out pairs.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个注意力补丁,我们从一次将补丁应用到一个头,对于所有1,152个头,在发现对上. 我们根据补丁应生成的字母记录与目标本人的字母记录之间的空隙变化, 然后把补丁应用到 K K 头顶的验证对上, 用于 K K 在 1, 2, 4, ..., 128 ( 256 为目光头) 。 在这些运行前确定的规则需要最小的 K K , 而补丁在至少 80% 的案例中移动字母, 如果没有的话, 则需要最好的 K K K 。 在单答任务上,盖兹计数也必须达到80%. 然后,我们运行 选择的头一次 搁置对。

blocks.en: We repeat every patch on a random set of heads of the same size. Each random head comes from the same layer as the head it replaces and lies outside the selected set. We repeat every blocking experiment on matched random heads or on a neighboring token.
blocks.zh: 我们重复每个补丁 在随机的一组 大小相同的头。 每个随机头来自与它所替换的头的同一层,并位于所选集之外. 我们重复每个随机的 或相邻的标志上的阻断实验

blocks.en: A percentage written as x ± y x\pm y carries the half-width y y of its 95% interval. We resample the held-out pairs with replacement 2,000 times, keeping the two directions of a pair together, and take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles.
blocks.zh: 写为 x± y x\pm y 的百分比带有其95% 间隔的半宽 y 。 我们用两千倍的重置来重现被搁置的对子, 保持一个对子的两个方向, 然后取2.5和97.5百分位数。

blocks.en: A.5 Overview of the Main-Paper Experiments
blocks.zh: A.5 主页实验概览

blocks.en: Tables 1 to 3 list every experiment of the main paper in the order of the text. For each one, they give the token where we apply the patch, the activation taken from the source or the attention that we block, the answer that the tested hypothesis predicts, and the result.
blocks.zh: 表1至表3按文字顺序列出主纸的每个实验. 对于每一个,它们都给出我们应用补丁的标志, 从源或我们阻断的注意力中获取的激活, 被测试的假说预测的答案, 以及结果。

blocks.en: Table 1: The experiments of Section 4 , single-answer task. Token is the target token where the patch is applied. Patched or blocked is the only activation taken from the source, or the attention that is blocked; everything else is the target’s own (Appendix A.4 ). Target answers is the answer that the tested hypothesis predicts, in the letters of Section 3 : T is the target’s own letter, D the source’s letter, K the resolved pointer, P the request, and R the layout. Percent of cases as reported in the main text, with random heads from the same layers in parentheses.
blocks.zh: 表1:第4节的实验,单答任务. Token是应用补丁的目标符号. 补丁或阻塞是唯一来自源头的激活,或被阻断的注意力;其他一切都是目标自己的(附录A.4 ). 目标答案是被测试的假说预测的答案,在第3节的字母中:T是目标自己的字母,D是来源字母,K是解答指针,P是请求,R是布局. 占正文中报告的病例的百分比,括号中为同一层的随机头.

blocks.en: Table 2: The experiments of Section 5 , list task. Columns as in Table 1 . In the second and third rows the source’s comma-token residual is patched into the target’s colon token, where the target has written nothing. Rows marked no patch change only the prefilled answer.
blocks.zh: 表2:第5节的实验,列举任务. 如表1所示列。 在第二行和第三行中,来源的逗号剩余部分被补上目标的结肠符,目标没有写任何字。 仅标出预填的答案。

blocks.en: Table 3: The experiments of Section 6 . Columns as in Table 1 ; C is the source’s letter at the target’s panel. The language rows use colored shapes without letters and the question “ What shape is the green marker? ” in English, German, French, or Chinese. They have no prefilled answer, so their patches are applied at the last token and at every generated token.
blocks.zh: 表3:第6节的试验,表1中的列;C是来源在目标小组的信。 语言行使用无字母的彩色形状和“绿色标记是什么形状?” 的问题,用英语、德语、法语或中文写。 他们没有预先填充的答案,因此他们的补丁在最后一个符号以及每一个生成的符号都被应用.

blocks.en: A.6 The Language Tasks
blocks.zh: A.6 语言任务

blocks.en: Section 6.2 needs answers that differ between languages, which a letter does not. Images are strips of four panels as in the single-answer task. In the colored-shape task each panel holds one filled shape, all four shapes differ, and exactly one is cyan. The other three take distinct colors from orange, green, pink, yellow, red, and purple. The question asks for the shape of the cyan marker: in English What shape is the cyan marker? Reply with one shape word only. , in German Welche Form hat die cyanfarbene Markierung? Antworte nur mit einem Wort für die Form. , in French Quelle est la forme du marqueur cyan ? Réponds avec un seul mot de forme. , and in Chinese the direct translation. In the object task, each panel holds a shape outline with a small drawn object inside it, a color emoji from the Noto Color Emoji font at 96 pixels. The asked shape is always the circle, and the questions are What is inside the circle? Answer with one word only. and its translations. No prompt names a language, and the assistant turn is empty, so the last prompt token is the newline after the assistant tag. It is the same token in every language and every image, and all patches act there or at generated tokens. We generate answers greedily for up to eight tokens and match them against lists of accepted words per concept and language.
blocks.zh: 第6.2节需要不同语言之间不同的答案,而字母没有. 图像像单答任务一样是四个面板的条形. 在彩色形状的任务中,每个面板都有一个填充的形状,所有四个形状都不同,一个就是青色. 其他三种则从橙色,绿色,粉色,黄色,红色和紫色中取出不同的颜色. 问题问青色标记的形状:英语中青色标记是什么形状? 仅用一个形状单词回复 。 在德国的Welche Form 帽子会死吗? 使用法语《法国青铜器》? Réponds avec un seul mot de forme.),中文直译. 在对象任务中,每个面板都持有一个外形轮廓,内部有一个小的绘图对象,一个来自Noto Color Emoji字体的彩色emoji,以96像素. 被问的形状总是圆的,而问题就是圆的里面是什么? 答只用一个字. 及其翻译。 没有提示语言名称,而助手转弯是空的,所以最后一个提示是助手标签之后的新线. 它在每种语言和每个图像中都是一样的,所有补丁都在那里或按生成的代号行事. 我们贪得无厌地为多达8个符号生成答案,并把它们与每个概念和语言的公认词列表相匹配。

blocks.en: We started from 24 objects whose names differ in all four languages and kept an object only if the model named it correctly at all four panel positions in all four languages. Twenty-one passed. The crescent moon (read as a croissant in French), the top hat, and the sneaker failed. We use 16 of the 21.
blocks.zh: 我们从24个物体开始,它们的名字在所有四种语言中都不同,只有在所有四种语言的所有四个面板位置上的模型正确命名时,才保留一个物体。 二十一经. 月亮月亮(法语读作羊角面包),顶部帽子,运动鞋失败. 我们使用21型中的16型.

blocks.en: Each task has a set of discovery images and a separate set of held-out images. We use the discovery images to rank heads and to compute the per-language averages and vectors. Concepts and panel positions are balanced. Each held-out target is paired with three source images of a different concept. Targets ask in German, French, or Chinese and sources in any other language, which gives nine ordered language pairs per patch. We fixed the number of language heads, the layers of the held MLPs, and the layer and scale of the language vector in an earlier study on comic images (Appendix G.3.1 ), before any run on these tasks.
