We apply a patch at every generated token. When the patch uses a source, we advance the source run in step by feeding it the target’s generated tokens. To set a head to a language, we overwrite its output with the average of its output at the last prompt token under that language, over the discovery images. Nothing from the test image is involved.
blocks.zh: 每项任务都有一套发现图像和一套单独的悬浮图像. 我们用发现的图像来排列头和计算每个语言的平均值和矢量。 概念和小组职位是平衡的。 每个被搁置的目标与三个不同概念的源图像成对. 目标以德语,法语或汉语问及任何其他语言的來源,每个补丁给出9个订购语言对. 我们固定了语言头数,所持有的MLP的层数,以及早期关于漫画图像的研究(Appendix G.3.1 )中语言矢量的层数和尺度,然后再对这些任务进行任何运行. 我们在每个生成的符号上都应用一个补丁. 当补丁使用源头时,我们通过向源头输入目标生成的令牌来同步推进源头运行. 要设置一个头到一个语言,我们用它的输出平均值来覆盖它在该语言下的最后一个即时符号,在发现图像上. 测试图像上没有任何内容

blocks.en: In the color question each panel holds one shape in its own color, with no letter. We ask for the color of a named shape, so the shape name is again the shape token. The question, the shape name and the prefill are all written in one language, and the model answers with the color word in that language. For example, in French, , heart fr prefilled “ Réponse : ” → \to rouge .
blocks.zh: 在颜色问题中,每个面板在自己的颜色中都有一个形状,没有字母. 我们要求一个命名形状的颜色,所以形状名称又是形状符号. 问题,形状名称和预填都用一种语言写成,模型用该语言中的颜色词来回答. 例如,在法语中,心跳预注了“Réponse:” +\to rouge。

blocks.en: We document the prompts and color concepts used in each language in Table 4 and Table 5 respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们分别在表4和表5中记录每种语言所用的提示和颜色概念。

blocks.en: Table 4: The task instruction in each language. The user turn is the question followed by the single-word instruction, and the assistant turn is prefilled with the answer prefix.
blocks.zh: 表4:每种语言的任务指示。 用户转弯是单字指示之后的问题,助手转弯前加答前缀.

blocks.en: Table 5: The eight color concepts in each language. A readout counts the first token of the word. Forms in parentheses are also accepted in that language.
blocks.zh: 表5:每种语言的八种颜色概念. 读出数为词的第一个符号. 括号内的表格也以该语言接受。

blocks.en: Source: , heart fr prefilled “ Réponse : ” → \to rouge Target: , diamond de prefilled “ Antwort: ” → \to lila

We use the 32 gaze heads unchanged, at the last prompt token of the language tasks, which is the token that produces the first answer word. Their summed output is the sum over these heads of the head’s output after the output projection. We read it against the vocabulary by multiplying it with the output embedding, with no normalization. For the output patch of Section 6.2 , the target asks in language B B about image Y Y and the source asks in language A ≠ B A\neq B about one of three images X X with a different concept. We replace the outputs of a head set with the source’s at every generated token, with the source run advanced on the target’s tokens. The answer is scored as the source’s concept in the target’s language, the target’s concept in the source’s language, the source’s word, or no change, on the cases whose target asks in German, French, or Chinese.
blocks.zh: 我们使用32眼头 没有改变, 在语言任务的最后一个即时符号, 这是产生第一个答案词的符号。 它们的总产出是产出预测后头部产出的这些头部的总和. 我们对照词汇来读它, 用输出嵌入来乘以它, 没有正常化。 对于第6.2节的输出补丁,目标在语言B中询问图像Y Y,而来源在语言A QQ B A\neq B中询问三个图像X X中有一个具有不同概念. 我们用源的每个生成的符号替换一个头的输出,而源的运行在目标符号上。 答案被评为目标语言中的源概念,目标语言中的源概念,对目标用德语,法语或汉语询问的案件,源词或者没有变化.

blocks.en: A.7 How Reliable Is the Task?
blocks.zh: A.7 如何可靠 是任务吗?

blocks.en: Before any patch, we ask about every shape in every image. We read the answer in two ways: the next token after Answer: , and free generation with no prefix. With the final pool of 21 letters, the next token after Answer: is correct in 98.9 ± \pm 0.2% of questions, and free generation with no prefix in 98.9 ± \pm 0.3%. The published Gaze Heads look at the asked panel in 97.9 ± \pm 0.4%.
blocks.zh: 在任何补丁之前,我们询问每个图像的每个形状。 我们以两种方式阅读答案:Answer之后的下一个符号:和没有前缀的自由世代. 加上最后的集合21个字母,Answer后的下一个符号:在98.9±\pm 0.2%的问题中是正确的,在98.9±\pm 0.3%,没有前缀的自由生成. 出版的Gaze Heads以97.9±\pm 0.4%。

blocks.en: We first ran this check with all 26 letters. The next token was correct in 98.0% of questions when ignoring letter case. Of the errors, 61.0% were letters that do not appear in the image at all, led by Q read as O, J as A, L as I, and P as D. In 97.6% of these errors, the Gaze Heads were on the correct panel. The model was looking at the right place and misreading the letter. Only 0.8% of the answers were the letter of another panel. We removed Q, O, I, L, and J from the letter pool for every experiment in this paper. On the language tasks, the model answers the unedited colored-shape questions in the question’s language in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% of runs and the object questions in 99.0%.
blocks.zh: 我们先查了26封信 在98.0%的问题中,忽略字母大小写时,下一个符号是正确的. 在错误中,61.0%是完全没有出现在图像中的字母,由Q带领读作O,J读作A,L读作I,P读作D。 在97.6%的这些错误中,Gaze Heads出现在正确的面板上. 模特看对了地方,误读了信. 只有0.8%的答案是另一个面板的信. 我们把Q,O,I,L,和J从字母池中移除了,用于本文中的每一个实验. 在语言任务上,模型以1000.0±\pm 0.0%的运行和99.0%的对象问题回答问题语言中未经编辑的彩色形状问题.

blocks.en: Appendix B Binding: Details and Supporting Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录B 捆绑:详细情况和辅助实验

blocks.en: This appendix supports the binding heads of Section 4 , which resolve the pointer. It covers the residual patch at every token, the head searches behind the binding heads, the MLP that writes the request, what the binding heads add to the residual stream, which requests they bind, and how they behave on a list.
blocks.zh: 本附录支持解决指针的第4节的绑定头. 它涵盖了每个符号的剩余补丁,绑定头后面的头部搜索,写请求的MLP,绑定头部给剩余流添加什么,要求它们绑定,以及它们在列表中的表现.

blocks.en: B.1 The Residual Patch at Every Token
blocks.zh: B.1 每个托肯的残余补丁

blocks.en: Figure 5: At the shape token, the request comes before the pointer. We patch the shape token’s residual vector one layer at a time. The patch moves the request, P , up to layer 15, and the pointer, K , at layer 20, in 36.1 ± \pm 3.2% of the held-out cases.
blocks.zh: 图5:在形状符号上,请求出现在指针之前. 我们每次修补形状符号的残余矢量一层。 补丁将请求,P,上至第15层,指针,K,下至第20层,为36.1±\pm 3.2%。

blocks.en: Section 4.1 tracks the pointer by patching the residual vector at every token and every layer. Figure 6 shows this map for all five outcome letters of Section 3 . Patching any token before the shape token never changes the answer. After the shape token, no single token changes the answer until the colon token. So the state that travels between the two is spread over several tokens. This is why Section 4 patches the values of all of them together when it looks for the relay heads.
blocks.zh: 第4.1节通过在每个标志和每一层补丁剩余矢量来跟踪指针. 图6显示第3款所有五个结果字母的地图。 在形状符号之前补丁任何符号, 绝不改变答案 。 在形状令牌之后,没有一个单一的令牌会改变答案,直到结肠令牌. 因此,两人之间旅行的状态分布在几个符文上. 因此,第4节在寻找中继头时将所有它们的值拼凑在一起.

blocks.en: The shape token carries two things in turn (Figure 5 ). Up to layer 15, the patch moves the request: the target answers the source’s question on its own image, P . Around layer 20, the patch moves the pointer, K , in 36.1 ± \pm 3.2% of the held-out cases. The effect then fades, because the relay heads have already read the shape token by then. At the colon token, the pointer holds from layers 23-29 and peaks at 78.6 ± \pm 2.5% at layer 24. From layer 30 on, the patch copies the source’s letter.
blocks.zh: 形状符号依次携带两件东西(图5). 至第15层,补丁移动请求:目标在自己的图像上解答了来源的问题,P. 环绕第20层,补丁移动指针,K,在36.1 ±\pm 3.2%被搁置的情况下. 效果随即消退,因为继电器头已经读到形状符号了. 在结肠符上,指针从第23-29层起,最高点在第24层为78.6±\pm2.5%. 从第30层开始,补丁复制了消息来源的信。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Only the shape token and the colon token change the answer. Each cell patches the source’s residual vector into the target at one text token and one layer, and counts the cases that answer with one outcome letter of Section 3 . (a) T , the target’s own letter. (b) D , the source’s letter. (c) K , the target’s letter at the source’s panel. (d) P , the target’s letter inside the source’s shape. (e) R , the target’s letter where the source’s layout puts the asked shape. The shape token is shown in bold. The request, P , sits at the shape token up to layer 19. The pointer, K , sits at the shape token around layer 20 and at the colon token from layers 23-29. The source’s letter, D , comes through the colon token from layer 30. All panels use the 500 held-out pairs.
blocks.zh: 图6:只有形状符号和结肠符号改变答案. 每个单元格将源的剩余矢量以一个文本符号和一个层次补入目标,并用第3节的一个结果字母(a) T,即目标本身的字母进行计数。 (b) D,来文提交人的信。 (c) K, 目标者在消息来源小组的信。 (d) P,目标字母在来源形状内。 (e) R,目标字母,来源的布局将要求的形状置于其中。 形状符号以粗体显示。 请求P坐到19层 指针K坐在20层周围的形状标志,23-29层的结肠标志。 来源的D字母来自30层的结肠符号。 所有面板都使用500个被搁置的对.

blocks.en: B.2 Head Searches and the Number of Heads
blocks.zh: B.2 头搜索和头数

blocks.en: To choose the binding heads, we run three single-head searches at the shape token, one each for the query, key, and output patches. Figure 7 shows the score of every head over all 36 layers and 32 heads. The three searches pick out heads in the same band of middle layers, and many heads rank high in all three. Figure 8 reports every K K on the validation pairs. The query and key patches pass the selection rule of Appendix A.4 at 8 heads, and the output and relay patches pass it at 16. Beyond these sizes, the key, output, and relay patches stay flat, while adding more heads makes the query patch worse. The binding heads are the top 16 heads of the output search of Section 4.1 . The query and key searches select their own 8 query heads and 8 key heads, and we report each patch with its own heads. Together, the three sets form a union of 18 heads in layers 15-21, and the experiments that use this union say so. Table 6 gives every patch on the held-out cases, and Table 7 lists the selected heads.
blocks.zh: 为了选择绑定头,我们在形状符上进行三次单头搜索,每次一个用于查询,密钥,输出补丁. 图7显示了36层和32个头的每个头的得分. 三次搜索在同一个中层群中挑出头部,许多头部在所有三个群中排高. 图8按验证对每K报告一次。 查询和密钥补丁在8个头通过附录A.4的选择规则,输出和中继补丁在16个头通过. 在这些大小之外,密钥,输出,和继电器补丁保持平整,同时增加更多的头使查询补丁更糟糕. 装订头是第4.1节输出搜索的前16个头. 查询和密钥搜索会选择自己的8个查询头和8个密钥头,我们用自己的头报告每个补丁. 三套合在一起,组成了一层15-21的18个头的联盟,使用这个联盟的实验也这么说. 表6列出被搁置案件的每一个补丁,表7列出选定的头。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Queries carry the request, keys carry the layout, and outputs carry the pointer. Each cell patches one attention head at the shape token from the source on its own, averaged over the 200 discovery pairs. (a) We patch the head’s query and score the gain of P , the target’s letter inside the source’s shape, over T . (b) We let the head read the source’s image keys and score the gain of R , the target’s letter where the source’s layout puts the asked shape, over T . (c) We patch the head’s output and score the gain of K , the pointer, over T . The heads that each search selects are outlined: 8 query heads, 8 key heads, and 16 output heads, all in layers 15-21. The 16 output heads are the binding heads of the main text.
blocks.zh: 图7:查询带请求,按键带布局,输出带指针. 每个细胞单独从源头将一个注意头贴在形状符号上,平均超过200个发现对. (a) 我们补正头部的询问,并将目标字母P在来源形状内的增益评分超过T。 (b) 我们让头部读取源头的图像键,并得分R的得分,目标字母是源头布局将所询问的形状置于T之上的。 (c) 我们修补头部的输出,将指针K的得分比T的得分。 每个搜索所选择的首级被概括为:8个查询头,8个关键头,以及16个输出头,均为第15-21层. 16个输出头是主文本的装订头.

blocks.en: Table 6: Each patch moves one variable. Each row patches one kind of state from the source into the target, at the shape token or, for the relay values, at the colon token. Letter is the percent of cases whose next token is the letter that the moved variable predicts. Gaze is the percent of cases in which the published Gaze Heads, which we do not patch, move to the matching panel. All rows use the 500 held-out pairs.
blocks.zh: 表6:每个补丁移动一个变量. 每行从源头将一种状态补到目标,在形状符上,或者,对于继电器值,在结肠符上. 字母是移动变量预测的字母的下个符号的百分比。 盖兹是公布的盖兹头像(Gaze Heads),我们没有补丁,移动到匹配面板中的百分比. 所有行用五百持戒对.

blocks.en: Table 7: The selected heads. L and H give the layer and the head. The binding heads are the 16 heads that the output search selects. Eight of the 10 query and image-key heads are binding heads, so together they form a union of 18 heads, and the experiments that use this union name it.
blocks.zh: 表7: 选定的头。 L和H给层和头。 绑定头是输出搜索所选择的16个头. 10个查询和图像键头中的8个是捆绑头,所以它们共同组成了18个头的工会,以及使用这个工会名字的实验.

blocks.en: Figure 8: The selection rule fixes the number of heads. We patch the top K K heads of each single-head search together on the 100 validation pairs. These are the queries, image keys, and outputs at the shape token, and the values that the relay heads read at the colon token. (a) Cases whose next token is the letter the patch predicts. (b) Cases in which the published Gaze Heads look at the matching panel. The dotted line marks the 80% rule. The queries and the image keys first pass it on both readouts at 8 heads, with 83.5% and 80.5% for the queries and 85.0% and 84.5% for the image keys. The outputs and the relay values first pass it at 16 heads.
blocks.zh: 图 8:选择规则确定头数. 我们把每对单头搜索的 K K 头头 放在100对验证对上 这些都是在形状符号上的查询、图像键和输出,以及继电器头在冒号符号上读取的值。 (a) 下一个标志是补丁预测的字母。 (b) 出版的《盖兹头像》查看匹配面板的案例。 点线标志了80%的规则. 查询和图像密钥首先通过8个头的读出,83.5%和80.5%用于查询,85.0%和84.5%用于图像密钥。 产出和中继值首先通过16个头.

blocks.en: Figure 9: The first MLP writes the request. We patch the output of one MLP at a time at the shape token. Patching the first MLP moves the request, P , in 98.3 ± \pm 0.8% of the held-out cases, and patching any other MLP moves it in at most 6.1 ± \pm 1.4%.
blocks.zh: 图 9:第一个MLP写下请求. 我们在形状符号上一次补齐一个 MLP的输出. 补丁第一个 MLP 移动请求, P, 在98.3 ±\pm 0.8%被搁置的情况下, 并补丁其他 MLP 移动到最多 6.1 ±\pm 1.4% 。

blocks.en: The query patch is the least clean of the three. With the 8 selected heads, the target answers the source’s question on its own image in 81.0 ± \pm 2.5% of cases. But in 8.1 ± \pm 1.8% of cases, it answers at the source’s location . A query that moves the pointer must already say where to look, not only what to look for. The pointer forms inside the shape token while these heads run (Figure 5 ), so the queries of some of them carry part of it. When we patch one head at a time, two heads in layer 19, L19H24 and L19H27, move the request almost alone. Heads in layers 15, 17, 18, and 21 (L15H9, L15H10, L17H4, L18H15, L21H11) move the pointer about as much as the request. We then rank the heads by how much a query moves the request minus how much it moves the pointer. With this ranking, the patch needs 128 heads to pass the rule, and it then moves the request in 94.5% of cases and the pointer in 0.0%. So once the heads that mix in the pointer are ranked low, the queries carry the request alone.
blocks.zh: 查询补丁是三个中最不干净的. 目标以81.0 ±\pm 2.5%的病例来回答消息来源的问题。 但是在8.1%的案例中, 一个将指针移动的查询必须已经说到哪里去寻找,而不仅仅是找什么. 指针在这些头运行时在形状符号内部形成(图5),因此其中一些头的询问会携带部分内容. 当我们一次补一个头,两个头在19层,L19H24和L19H27,几乎单独移动请求. 正面分为第15,17,18层和21层(L15H9,L15H10,L17H4,L18H15,L21H11),移动指针大致与请求相同. 然后,我们按查询移动请求多少减去指示器移动多少来排序。 凭借这一排名,补丁需要128个头来通过规则,然后在94.5%的案例中移动请求,在0.0 %中移动指针. 因此,一旦在指针中混合的头被排在低位,询问就会单独携带请求.

blocks.en: B.3 The First MLP Writes the Request
blocks.zh: B.3 第一份MLP 编写请求

blocks.en: The queries of the query heads carry the request, so something must write the request into the shape token before the binding layers. To find it, we patch the output of one MLP at a time at the shape token, for all 36 layers. Only the first MLP moves the request. Patching its output makes the target answer the source’s question in 98.3 ± \pm 0.8% of cases, and no other MLP does so in more than 6.1 ± \pm 1.4% (Figure 9 ). The shape name is one token, so the first MLP is where this token’s identity becomes a state that the binding heads can use.
blocks.zh: 查询头的查询会携带请求,所以在绑定层之前,一定有东西将请求写入形状符号. 为了找到它,我们把一个MLP的输出一次在形状符号上补上,所有36层. 只有第一个 MLP 移动请求 。 在98.3 ±\pm 0.8%的案例中, 形状名称是一个符号,所以第一个MLP是这个符号的身份成为绑定头可以使用的状态.

blocks.en: B.4 What the Binding Heads Write
blocks.zh: B.4 装订头写什么

blocks.en: The binding heads could add a code for the panel, or the content of that panel. To tell these apart, we patch the queries, keys, and values of the heads one part at a time. When the 10 query and key heads, 8 of which are binding heads, keep their own queries and keys but read the source’s image values, the answer is unchanged in 96.8 ± \pm 1.0% of the held-out cases. The same patch on the 16 binding heads leaves it unchanged in 95.4 ± \pm 1.2%. When we patch the queries, image keys, and values of these 10 heads together, the pointer moves in 82.6 ± \pm 2.4%. Random heads change the answer in at most 0.1% of cases under any of these patches. So the binding heads add to the residual stream a code for where the answer is, not for what is there. The gaze heads do the opposite: their image values carry the letter (Appendix F.3 ).
blocks.zh: 绑定头可以添加面板的代码,或者面板的内容. 要分解这些,我们一次补齐头的询问、键和值。 当10个查询和密钥头(其中8个是绑定头)保留自己的查询和密钥但读取源的图像值时,答案在被搁置的案例中的96.8±\pm 1.0%不变. 16个捆绑头部的相同补丁使它以95.4±\pm 1.2%不变. 当我们补齐这10个头的查询、图像密钥和值时,指针以82.6±\pm 2.4%移动。 在这些补丁下,随机头最多在0.1%。 因此,绑定头在剩余流中增加了一个代码,用于答案所在,而不是用于答案所在. 凝视头做相反的:它们的图像值带有字母(Appendix F.3 .

blocks.en: B.5 Binding Heads Bind Any Request Word
blocks.zh: B.5 捆绑头绑住任何请求字

blocks.en: Every test of Section 4 names a shape. To test whether the binding heads bind shape words or any request, we change what the question names and keep the head sets of the main text unchanged. These are the same binding heads, relay heads, and gaze heads, with no new search. We use four variants of the four-panel task. In the color variant, every panel holds a circle filled with a distinct color, and the question is “ What is the letter inside the red circle? ”, so the shape token is the color word. In the category variant, each panel holds a small drawn object with a letter next to it, and the question is “ What is the letter next to the cat? ”. In the two-attribute variant, the panels hold colored shapes, with a red circle and a blue star as distractors for “ the red star ”, so the request spans two words. In the word-label variant, the panels hold the paper’s shapes with a three-letter word in place of the letter. We score it on the word’s initial under the paper’s question, and on the word under a question that asks for the word. With no patch, the model answers all four variants in 100.0% of cases, and in 95.4 ± \pm 1.3% for word labels. Table 8 repeats the patches of Sections 4 and 6 on each variant.
blocks.zh: 每次测试第4节 都命名了一个形状。 为了测试绑定头是绑定形状的单词还是任何请求,我们改变问题名称,使主文本的头集保持不变. 这些是相同的捆绑头,中继头, 和凝视头, 没有新的搜索。 我们使用四个变体 四小组的任务。 在颜色变体中,每个面板都抱着一个充满鲜明颜色的圆圈,问题在于“红圆圈内部的字母是什么?” ,所以形状符号是颜色词。 在类别变体中,每个面板都持有一个小绘图对象,旁边有一个字母,问题是“猫旁边是什么字母?” 在双属性变体中,面板握有彩色的形状,以红圆和蓝星作为“红星”的分心器,因此请求跨越两个字。 在文字标签的变体中,面板以三个字母的字来代替字母的形状. 我们根据文件问题开头的词来评分,并根据一个要求该词的问题来评分。 在没有补丁的情况下,模型在100.0%的病例中解答了所有四个变体,在95.4±\pm中解答了单词标签的1.3%。 表8重复了第4节和第6节在每个变体上的补丁.

blocks.en: Table 8: The paper’s heads work on other requests. We use the head sets exactly as found on the shape task, with no new search. Each cell is the percent of held-out cases whose next token is the expected letter, and the first column repeats the paper’s row images. We score word labels on the initial under the paper’s question (“words”) and on the word under a question that asks for the word (“word asked”). Random heads from the same layers reach at most 4.0% in any cell.
blocks.zh: 表8:该文件的负责人处理其他要求。 我们使用头套 与形状任务完全一样, 没有新的搜索。 每个单元格是被搁置案件的百分比,其中下一个符号是预期的字母,第一栏重复纸张的行图像。 我们在文件问题( " 字 " )的开头加上一个问题( " 问 " )下的单词。 同一层的随机头在任何细胞中最多达到4.0%.

blocks.en: The chain is the same in every variant. The binding heads’ queries move the request, and their image keys move the layout. Their queries and keys together, and their outputs, move the pointer. The relay values carry the pointer, and restoring them restores the answer. These patches work in 75 to 100% of cases, against at most 0.7% for random heads. With two attributes, the two words divide the request. The queries at the color word alone move the color part: the target names the item with the source’s color and its own shape in 78.6 ± \pm 2.5% of cases. The queries at the shape word alone move the shape part, in 85.9 ± \pm 2.1%. The outputs move the pointer mainly at the second word: in 72.4 ± \pm 2.9% of cases at the shape word, 23.8 ± \pm 3.3% at the color word, and 93.8 ± \pm 1.5% at both. With word labels, the binding and relay chain is unchanged, but the 32 gaze heads bring back only a letter’s worth of content. When the model must write the word, the gaze heads’ image values give the source’s word in 1.4 ± \pm 0.8% of cases, and its initial in 15.8 ± \pm 2.2% more. When only the shape token and the gaze heads see the image, the model writes its own word in 16.1 ± \pm 2.3% of cases and its initial in 79.9 ± \pm 2.4%. So the binding heads bind whatever the question names to the image, while the gaze heads read one letter.
blocks.zh: 链条在每个变体中都是相同的. 绑定头的查询会移动请求, 其图像键会移动布局 。 他们的询问和密钥,以及他们的输出,一起移动指针. 中继值带有指针,恢复它们恢复答案. 这些补丁在75%到100%的案例中有效,随机头顶最多为0.7%. 有两个属性,两个单词将请求分割. 仅彩色单词的查询会移动彩色部分:目标以78.6 ±\pm 2.5%的病例中来源的颜色和自身形状来命名项目. 单字形状的查询会移动形状部分,以85.9 ±\pm 2.1%计. 输出主要在第二字移动指针:在72.4±\pm2.9%的病例中,在形状单词中,在23.8±\pm3.3%的病例中,在色单词中,在两者中,在93.8±\pm1.5%. 加上文字标签,绑定和中继链没有变化,但32眼头只带回一个字母的内容价值. 当模型必须写出这个词时,凝视头的图像值给出了1.4±\pm0.8%的病例中的源词,其初始值为15.8±\pm2.2%以上. 当只有形状符号和凝视头看到图像时,模型在16.1 ±\pm 2.3%的病例中写出自己的单词,在79.9 ±\pm 2.4%的病例中写出自己的单词. 所以,绑着的头将任何问号都绑在图像上, 而瞪眼头则读一个字母。

blocks.en: B.6 Binding on a List
blocks.zh: B.6 装订清单

blocks.en: With four panels holding the asked shape, the 16 binding heads and the 2 query and key heads outside them at the shape token spread their image attention over all of them. Of this attention, 79.6 ± \pm 0.2% falls on the four matching panels, and 27.4 ± \pm 0.8% of that falls on the panel the model answers from first. To read what these heads write, we take their summed contribution to the residual stream at the shape token on the held-out pairs of the list task. We fit a ridge probe on half of the pairs and read it on the other half. A probe for “panel p p has the asked shape” reads each panel with 97.7 ± \pm 0.9% accuracy. A probe for “which panel is first” reads it in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% of pairs. But a probe that sees only the six matching-panel scores already reads it in 92.8 ± \pm 3.2%, so the first panel is the leftmost matching panel and not a separate signal. In the matching-panel directions, centered, the first matching panel scores + 0.31 +0.31 , the other matching panels + 0.28 +0.28 , and the non-matching panels − 0.58 -0.58 . So the set is written flat, and Appendix E.3 follows it to the answer token.
blocks.zh: 四个面板握着要求的形状,16个捆绑头和2个查询以及外侧在形状符号上的钥匙头,将图像注意力分散到所有面板上. 其中79.6±\pm 0.2%落到4个匹配面板上,27.4±\pm 0.8%落到面板上 模型答案从第一. 为了读读这些头所写的,我们把他们对剩余流的总结贡献放在列表任务中被搁置的对子的形状符号上. 我们把一个山脊探测器装在一半的对子上 然后在另一半读出来 “pp小组有要求的形状”的探测器可读取每个面板,精确度为97.7±\pm 0.9%。 “哪一个面板是第一”的探测器以1000.0±\pm0.0%的对读。 但是,一个只看到6个匹配小板分数的探测器已经用92.8 ±\pm 3.2%读取,所以第一个面板是最左匹配小板,而不是单独的信号. 在配对-座板方向中,居中,第一配对面板得分+0.31+0.31,其他配对面板得分+0.28+0.28,非配对面板得分−0.58–0.58. 因此该集是写平的,附录E.3跟着它到答号.

blocks.en: Appendix C Relay: Details and Supporting Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录C 中继器:细节和支持实验

blocks.en: This appendix supports the relay heads of Section 4 , which carry the resolved pointer. We show which tokens they read, how their queries, keys, and values divide the work, what they carry on a list, and every blocking experiment on the way from the shape token to the colon token.
blocks.zh: 本附录支持第4节的中继主管,该节载有解析的指针. 我们显示他们读到的符号,他们的查询,键和值如何划分工作,他们在列表中携带什么,以及每一个从形状符号到结肠符号途中的阻断实验.

blocks.en: C.1 Which Tokens Carry the Pointer to the Colon Token
blocks.zh: C.1 哪些托肯语 将指针带到科隆托肯

blocks.en: We first check that the relay heads move the pointer resolved at the shape token, and not something else in the source’s prompt. To do this, we build a run with the binding-head patch : the target with only the binding heads’ outputs patched from the source at the shape token, and nothing else. Its prompt, its image, and every other state are the target’s own. We then let the relay heads of an unedited target read the values of this run. The pointer moves in 89.0 ± \pm 2.1% of cases, as often as when they read the source’s own values (87.5 ± \pm 2.0%). Conversely, if we keep the binding patch but let the relay heads read the target’s original values, the target’s answer comes back in 99.8 ± \pm 0.2%. So the relay heads carry the pointer resolved at the shape token. Figure 10 a shows the single-head search that found the 16 relay heads.
blocks.zh: 我们首先检查中继头是否移动指针, 为了做到这一点,我们用绑头补丁构建一个运行:目标只有绑头输出从源头中补到形状符上,而别无其他。 它的迅速性,它的形象,以及所有其他国家都是目标所在。 然后,我们让一个未经编辑的目标的中继头读取这次运行的值。 指针在89.0±\pm 2.1%的病例中移动,与读取源自身值(87.5±\pm 2.0%)一样频繁. 反之,如果我们保留绑定的补丁,但让中继头读取目标原值,目标答案则以99.8±\pm 0.2 %回. 因此继电器头携带指针在形状符上解析. 图10 a显示了找到16个中继头的单头搜索.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Relay heads carry the pointer from the shape token to the colon token. (a) At the colon token, we let one attention head at a time read the source’s values from the shape token and the tokens after it, while its own query and keys stay unchanged. Each cell is the mean gain of K over T on the 200 discovery pairs. The 16 relay heads that the search selects are outlined, in layers 19-35. (b) Each relay head alone reads the source’s value at one text token only, while its query, keys, and attention stay unchanged. Each cell is the mean gain of K over T on the held-out pairs. When all 16 relay heads read only the shape token, the target answers K in 47.3 ± \pm 3.1% of cases, and when they read only the “ ? ”, it does so in 9.9 ± \pm 1.8%.
blocks.zh: 图10: 中继头将指针从形状符号到结肠符号. (a) 在结号牌上,我们让一个注意头一次从形状牌和后面的牌上读出来源的值,而它自己的查询和密钥保持不变。 每个细胞都是K在200个发现对上超过T的平均收益. 搜索所选择的16个中继头被概括为19-35层. (b) 每个中继头只用一个文本符号读出来源的价值,而其查询、钥匙和注意力保持不变。 每个细胞都是K在被搁置的对子上超过T的平均收益. 当所有16个中继头只读到形状符时,目标在47.3 ±\pm 3.1%的病例中回答K,当他们只读到“?”,则在9.9 ±\pm 1.8%中回答K.

blocks.en: Figure 3 a and Figure 10 b use the source’s own values. To find which token the relay heads read the pointer from, we let one relay head at a time, at the colon token, read the source’s value at a single text token after the image. Its query, keys, and attention weights stay the target’s own. We repeat this for every text token before the colon token. Each cell is the mean gain of the logit of K over T , relative to the unedited target, on the held-out pairs. We draw the shape token and the question mark after it as one column, the sum of their two gains. When all 16 relay heads read the source’s value at the shape token alone, the target answers K in 47.3 ± \pm 3.1% of cases. At the question mark alone it does so in 9.9 ± \pm 1.8%, and at every other token in at most 0.2 ± \pm 0.2%. So the relay heads read the pointer mostly from the shape token.
blocks.zh: 图3a和图10b使用来源本身的数值。 为了找到哪个接力头读出指针,我们让一个接力头在冒号上,在图像后用一个文本符号读出源值。 其查询、钥匙和注意力权重是目标自己的。 在结肠符之前,我们重复一遍。 相对于未经编辑的目标来说,每个单元格是 K 超过 T 的登录值在被搁置的对上的平均收益。 我们画的形状标志 和后面的问号 是一个柱子, 他们的两个收益的总和。 当所有16个中继头只读到形状符号的源值时,目标在47.3±\pm 3.1%的病例中回答K. 单在问号上,它就以9.9 ±\pm 1.8%为单位,其他每个信物最多以0.2 ±\pm 0.2%为单位。 所以继电器头主要从形状符号读取指针.

blocks.en: C.2 Relay Heads: Further Checks
blocks.zh: C.2 中继头:进一步检查

blocks.en: To see which part of the relay heads carries the pointer, we patch their queries, keys, and values at the colon token one at a time. Patching their values moves the pointer in 87.5 ± \pm 2.0% of cases. Patching their queries with the source’s leaves the answer unchanged in 86.9 ± \pm 2.1% of cases, and patching the keys of the text they read leaves it unchanged in 99.2 ± \pm 0.6%. Patching the queries and keys together leaves it unchanged in 98.4 ± \pm 0.9%. So the queries and keys only route the read, and the values carry the pointer. The queries are the least clean of the three, because the late relay heads build their queries from a residual stream that already holds the pointer.
blocks.zh: 要看到继电器头的哪个部分带有指针,我们一次在结号符上补上他们的查询,键和值. 补丁它们的值在87.5 ±\pm 2.0%的案例中移动指针. 将他们的询问和消息来源的询问补上,86.9 ±\pm 2.1%的案件的答案保持不变,他们读出的文本的密钥补上,99.2 ±\pm 0.6%的答案保持不变。 将询问和密钥补齐后,它以98.4 ±\pm 0.9%。 因此,查询和密钥只路径读取,而数值则带有指针. 查询是三个中最不干净的,因为后继头从一个已经持有指针的剩余流中构建他们的查询.

blocks.en: On the list task, the relay heads could carry the source’s first panel or the whole set of the source’s panels. When the relay heads at the colon token read the source’s values, the first answer moves to the source’s first panel in 78.5% of cases, against 0.0% for random heads. To test whether they carry one panel or the set, we hide the source’s first panel from every text token in every layer. If the set had traveled, the target would go on to the source’s other panel. It does so in only 8.4% of cases. It falls back to its own first panel in 31.9%, and it goes to the panel after the hidden one in 14.7%. It still reads the hidden panel in 30.9%, since hiding a panel from the text is never complete. When every head reads the source’s values instead, the counts are 48.7%, 22.5%, and 4.7%. So the relay heads carry one panel, the first.
blocks.zh: 在列表任务中,中继头可以搭载源的第一个面板或源的整组面板. 当中继头在冒号上读取源值时,第一个答案会移动到源头第一个面板的78.5%的案例中,随机头为0.0 %. 为了测试它们是否携带一个面板或套件,我们从每一层的每个文本符号中隐藏源代码的第一个面板. 如果该套设备已经出行,目标将前往消息来源的另一个小组。 只有8.4%的案件属于这种情况。 它在31.9%中回落到自己的第一个面板上,在14.7%的隐藏面板后,它会转到面板上. 它仍然以30.9%的速度读取隐藏的面板,因为从文本中隐藏一个面板永远不会完成. 当每个头都读到来源值时,计数是48.7%、22.5%和4.7%。 因此继电器头携带一个面板,第一个面板.

blocks.en: C.3 Blocked Attention: All Conditions
blocks.zh: C.3 阻碍注意:所有条件

blocks.en: Table 9 reports every blocking experiment in the target’s own run, each with its control.
blocks.zh: 表9汇报了目标自身运行中的每一次屏蔽实验,每一个实验都有其控制.

blocks.en: The pointer reaches the colon token by two routes. When we block only the colon token’s attention to the shape token, the answer is kept in 99.7 ± \pm 0.4% of cases. When we block only the attention of the tokens in between to the shape token, it is kept in 90.6 ± \pm 1.8%. When we block both, it is kept in only 25.3 ± \pm 2.5%. So the pointer reaches the colon token both directly and through the tokens in between.
blocks.zh: 指针通过两条路线到达结肠符. 当我们只阻止结肠符对形状符的注意时,答案被保留在99.7±\pm 0.4%。 当我们把信物的注意力挡在形状信物之间时, 它被保存在90.6±\pm 1.8%. 当我们屏蔽两个, 它只保存在25.3±\pm2.5%。 因此指针直接和通过介于中间的指针到达结肠符.

blocks.en: Binding is spread over more heads than the smallest set that can move the pointer. When we block the 16 binding heads and the 2 query and key heads outside them at the shape token from the image, the answer is kept in 84.9 ± \pm 2.1% of cases. When we block every head there from the image, it is kept in 40.4 ± \pm 3.1%. When we block the shape token and every later token from the image, 32.6 ± \pm 2.8% of answers survive, because the instruction tokens before the shape token also read the image.
blocks.zh: 捆绑在头部的分布比能够移动指针的最小集还要多. 当我们屏蔽16个捆绑头和2个查询和外侧的关键头在图像的形状符号时,答案被保存在84.9±\pm 2.1%的病例中. 当我们把每个头从图像上挡住时, 它被保存在40.4±\pm 3.1%. 当我们屏蔽形状符号和图像中每一个后来的符号时,32.6±\pm 2.8%的答案存活下来,因为形状符号之前的指示符号也读了图像.

blocks.en: When blocking breaks the pointer, the wrong answers lean toward the leftmost panel. In the two experiments that block the pointer, 39.8 ± \pm 2.3% of the wrong answers are the letter of the leftmost panel, against one in four by chance.
blocks.zh: 当阻断指针时,错误的答案会向最左边的面板倾斜. 在阻断指针的两个实验中,39.8 ±\pm 2.3%的错误答案是最左面板的字母,对四分之一偶然.

blocks.en: Table 9: Every blocking experiment on the single-answer task. Letter is the percent of cases that keep the target’s correct answer. Gaze is the percent of cases in which the published Gaze Heads stay on the correct panel. All values are on the 500 held-out pairs.
blocks.zh: 表9:单答任务的每一个阻断实验. 信件是保持目标正确答案的案例的百分比。 盖兹是出版的盖兹头像留在正确的面板上的案例的百分比. 所有值都在500个被搁置的对上。

blocks.en: The tokens between the shape token and the colon token also carry the letter itself. This shows when we block the gaze heads of Section 6 from the image.
blocks.zh: 形状符号和结肠符号之间的符号也携带字母本身. 这显示我们从画面中 屏蔽了六区的目视头

blocks.en: When the gaze heads cannot see the image, another set of heads might read the letter in their place. To look for them, we block the 32 gaze heads from the image at the colon token and run the single-head query-patch search again over all 1,152 heads. We then patch the top K K heads together, for K K from 1 to 256. No set moves the answer to the source’s panel. They reach 0.0% on the validation pairs at every K K , and 3.1% (top 32) and 5.6% (top 128) on held-out cases, against 74.0 ± \pm 2.9% for the 32 gaze heads with nothing blocked. Blocking these heads from the image, on top of the 32 gaze heads, lowers the answer only from 88.2 ± \pm 2.0% to 82.1% to 86.2%. Blocking random heads instead gives the same (87.8% to 92.9%). So the backup is not another set of heads that read the image at the colon token.
blocks.zh: 当凝视者头目无法看到图像时,另一组头目可能会代替目光阅读该字母. 为了寻找他们,我们封锁了32个望头 从图像在结肠符 并运行单头 查询-patch搜索 在所有1,152头。 然后我们把KK头顶合起来,从1到256 没有设定移动源面板的答案 。 每KK的验证对数达到0.0 %,被搁置的个案为3.1%(前32位)和5.6%(前128位),而32个望头没有被堵塞的个案为74.0±\pm2.9%。 从图像上封锁这些头,在32个凝视头顶,只将答案从88.2±\pm2.0%降低到82.1%至86.2%. 挡住随机头则给予相同(87.8%至92.9%). 因此备份不是另一组在结肠符上读取图像的头.

blocks.en: The backup is an earlier read. The tokens between the shape token and the colon token read the letter from the image, and the colon token takes it from them. When we block every head at the colon token from the image, the answer survives in 98.5% of cases. When we block the tokens between the shape token and the colon token from the image, it survives in 96.4%. When we block both the 32 gaze heads at the colon token and these tokens from the image, it survives in only 2.6%. Either route alone is enough. This is why the gaze heads are sufficient but not necessary.
blocks.zh: 备份是较早读到的. 形状符号和结肠符号之间的符号从图像中读取字母,结肠符号从它们中取出. 当我们把每个头都挡在结肠符上 从图像上,答案存活在98.5%的病例中. 当我们从图像中阻断形状标志和结肠标志之间的标志时,它以96.4%存活. 当我们把32只眼睛望向结肠的标志物 和图像上的这些标志物挡住时 它只存活了2.6% 任何一条路线都够了 这就是为什么眼角是足够的,但并不必要。

blocks.en: Appendix D Progress: Details and Supporting Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录D 进展:详细情况和辅助实验

blocks.en: This appendix supports Section 5 . We describe the pairs of the progress experiments, the state the comma token holds before the cursor forms, and the heads that set the cursor at the answer token. We then show the two routes from the answer token to the comma token, and we write the cursor with no source as a small subspace. Appendix E gives the details of select. Figure 11 draws the whole mechanism on a list with two answers.
blocks.zh: 本附录支持第5节。 我们描述进步实验的对数,在光标表单前的逗号符号所持有的状态,以及将光标设置在答号上的头. 然后我们显示从答案符到逗号符的两条路线,我们把无源光标写成一个小的子空间. 附 录 E给出了选择的细节. 图11在列表中绘制了整个机制,有两个答案.

blocks.en: Figure 11: The mechanism on a list with two answers. The image has stars in panels 1 and 3, and the model answers W, L . At the shape token star , binding heads write pointers to panels 1 and 3, and relay heads carry them to the colon token. There, select picks panel 1, and gaze heads read its letter, W . At the answer token W , progress records that the list is done up to panel 1. A matching panel is left, so the list continues. At the comma token, relay heads bring the pointers to panels 1 and 3 again, select uses the progress to pick panel 3, and gaze heads read L . At the answer token L , progress is done up to panel 3. No matching panel is left, so the model stops.
blocks.zh: 图11:列表中包含两个答案的机制. 图像在1和3面板中有恒星,模型则回答W,L. 在形状标志星,绑头写指针到1号和3号面板,继电器头将指针带到结肠标志. 在那里,选择选题板1,并凝视头部读取其字母,W. 在回答符号W中,进度记录显示,名单是按面板完成的 一、导 言 左侧是匹配面板,所以列表继续. 在逗号符上,中继头将指针再次带到1和3面板上,选择使用进度来选择3面板,并凝视头部读 L. 在回答符号 L 中,进展由小组完成 3个 没有匹配面板,所以模型停止.

blocks.en: D.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: D.1 执行细节

blocks.en: The three experiments of Sections 5.1 to 5.3 use their own pairs. We draw them at random with the images and prompt of Appendix A.3 . The source and the target ask for different shapes, drawn from star, heart, and triangle. The non-matching panels hold shapes the model does not confuse with the asked one, and the twelve letters of a pair are all different. The design fixes the matching panels of each experiment. In the skip experiment, the source’s written panel is the target’s first matching panel, drawn from panels 1, 2, or 3. In the cursor experiment, the source has its shape at panels 2, 4, and 5 and has written panels 2 and 4, and the target has its shape at panels 1, 2, 3, and 6. In the rebind experiment, the target has its shape at panels 1, 3, 4, and 6 and has written panels 1 and 3. We keep a pair only if both unedited runs give the expected next letter, and we run each experiment on held-out pairs. The residual patch copies the source’s comma-token residual into the target’s colon token at one layer, for every layer from 0 to 36, and reads the target’s next token. The rebind patch is the key patch of Appendix A.4 , applied at an answer token with the source image’s keys.
blocks.zh: 第5.1节至第5.3节的三项实验使用各自的对子. 我们随机绘制图像,并迅速绘制附录A.3。 源与目标要求不同的形状,从恒星,心脏,和三角形中抽取. 非对称面板持有模型的形状不会与被问到的一模混淆,一对的十二个字母都是不同的. 设计会修正每个实验的匹配面板. 在跳过实验中,来源的书面面板是目标的第一个匹配面板,从1,2或3面板中抽取. 在光标实验中,源头在2,4和5面板上有形状,并写有2和4面板,目标在1,2,3和6面板上有形状. 在重组实验中,目标在1,3,4和6面板上具有形状,并写有1和3面板. 我们只保留一对 如果两个未经编辑的运行 给出预期的下一个字母, 而我们运行每个实验 在搁置的对。 剩余补丁将来源的逗号残片复制到目标标语的一层,每一层从0到36,并读出目标的下一个标语。 重置补丁是附录 A.4 的密钥补丁, 用源图像的密钥在答号上应用 。

blocks.en: D.2 The State Before the Cursor
blocks.zh: D.2 诅咒之前的国家

blocks.en: Section 5.2 finds that a comma token’s residual copied into a colon token changes the target in three stages. In the early layers the target skips one matching panel. In the middle layers it counts the written letters. From layer 20 it starts after the last written panel. We use three runs to ask what the early state holds.
blocks.zh: 第5.2节发现,一个逗号的残余复制成一个结号,分三个阶段改变目标。 在早期的层中,目标跳过一个匹配面板. 在中间层,它计算出书面字母。 从第20层开始,它从最后一个写面板开始。 我们用三个跑步来问早期的州里有什么

blocks.en: We take the held-out targets of the list task and run each image twice more, once with r 1 r_{1} written and once with r 2 r_{2} written. We then copy the residual of that comma token, at one layer, into the colon token of the run with nothing written (Figure 12 a). With the source that wrote r 1 r_{1} , the target answers r 2 r_{2} in 65.8% of cases already at layer 14, and in 96.4% at layer 21. With the source that wrote r 2 r_{2} , the target also answers r 2 r_{2} in 75.1% of cases at layer 19, and r 3 r_{3} in only 2.1%. From layer 23 it answers r 3 r_{3} in 82.4% of cases, rising to 92.7% at 32. So up to layer 19 the copied state says only that one letter has been written, and the target skips its first matching panel whichever letter that was. From layer 20 the state says which panel was written, and the target starts after it.
blocks.zh: 我们把列表任务中被搁置的目标,再运行两次,一次用r 1 r_{1}写,一次用r 2 r_{2}写. 然后,我们将该逗号的剩余部分在一层上复制到运行的结肠符号中,没有写字(图12a)。 目标回答r 2 r_{2}65.8%的病例已经排在第14层,96.4%排在第21层。 目标只回答2.1%的病例, 从第23层,它回答r 3 r_{3}在82.4%的病例,上升至92.7%的32. 所以直到第19层, 复制状态只说一个字母已经写了, 目标跳过它的第一个匹配面板 无论哪个字母。 从第20层开始,状态说明哪个面板被写入,目标从它之后开始.

blocks.en: In the skip experiment of Section 5.1 , the source’s written panel is the target’s first matching panel, and it is panel 1, 2, or 3. We split the pairs by that panel (Figure 12 b). In the early layers, the target skips its first matching panel in 80.6 ± \pm 4.5% of pairs when the shared panel is panel 1, in 8.6 ± \pm 3.3% when it is panel 2, and in 4.7 ± \pm 2.4% when it is panel 3. At layer 20 the three groups skip in 99.5 ± \pm 0.8%, 97.5 ± \pm 2.2%, and 74.2 ± \pm 7.1% of pairs. At layer 21 they skip in 53.2 ± \pm 6.7%, 72.0 ± \pm 7.4%, and 88.4 ± \pm 5.1%. So the early lean falls on panel 1 and not on a count of matching panels. The cursor forms at layer 20 for panels 1 and 2, and one layer later for panel 3.
blocks.zh: 在5.1节的跳伞实验中,源头的书面面板是目标的第一个匹配面板,它是1,2或3面板. 我们用那个面板来拆对(图12b)。 在早期的层中,目标跳过其首个匹配面板,在共享面板为1面板时为80.6±\pm 4.5%,在8.6±\pm 3.3%,在2面板时为4.7±\pm 2.4% 3. 第20层,三组跳跃率在99.5 ±\pm 0.8%,97.5 ±\pm 2.2%,74.2 ±\pm 7.1%。 在21层,它们跳过53.2±\pm 6.7%,72.0±\pm 7.4%,88.4±\pm 5.1%. 因此早期的倾斜落在1号面板上,而不是数到匹配面板上. 光标为第1和2面板的第20层,稍后为第3面板的第一层。

blocks.en: We use the standard source of Appendix A.3 , which has the asked shape at r 2 r_{2} and r 4 r_{4} and has written the target’s first letter at r 2 r_{2} . Here a count predicts r 2 r_{2} , the written panel predicts r 3 r_{3} , and the source’s own next panel predicts r 4 r_{4} (Figure 12 c). The target answers r 2 r_{2} in 86.5% of cases at layer 19. It answers r 3 r_{3} in 68.4% at layer 20 and 53.9% at 21, and r 4 r_{4} in 77.7% at layer 22 and 87.6% at 24. At layer 30 it answers with the source’s letter in 99.5%. This is the same order as in the cursor experiment, on a pair whose source has written one letter.
blocks.zh: 我们使用附录A.3的标准来源,该附录的形状为r 2 r_{2}r 4 r_{4},并且将目标的第一个字母写在r 2 r_{2}。 这里有一个计数预测r 2 r_{2} 书面面板预测r 3 r_{3} 源头自己的下一个面板预测r 4 r_{4} (图12 c). 目标回答r 2r_{2}86.5%的19层病例. 它回答r 3 r_{3}在68.4%的20层和53.9%的21层和r 4 r_{4}在77.7%的22层和87.6%的24层. 在第30层,它用99.5%的报案人的信回答。 这与光标实验中的顺序相同,对一对其来源写了一封信.

blocks.en: Figure 12: The state the comma token holds before the cursor forms. We copy the residual of a comma token, at one layer, into a colon token that has written nothing, and read the target’s next letter. (a) The same image, with r 1 r_{1} written (top) and with r 2 r_{2} written (bottom), on the held-out targets. With r 1 r_{1} written the target answers r 2 r_{2} in 65.8% of cases at layer 14 and 96.4% at layer 21. With r 2 r_{2} written it also answers r 2 r_{2} , in 75.1% at layer 19, and answers r 3 r_{3} from layer 23 (82.4%). Up to layer 19 the copied state says only that one letter was written. From layer 20 the target starts after the written panel. (b) The skip experiment of Section 5.1 , split by the shared first matching panel. Averaged over layers 0-17, the target skips it in 80.6 ± \pm 4.5% of pairs when the shared panel is panel 1, 8.6 ± \pm 3.3% for panel 2, and 4.7 ± \pm 2.4% for panel 3. At layer 20 it skips in 99.5 ± \pm 0.8%, 97.5 ± \pm 2.2%, and 74.2 ± \pm 7.1%, and at layer 21 in 53.2 ± \pm 6.7%, 72.0 ± \pm 7.4%, and 88.4 ± \pm 5.1%. (c) The standard source, which has written the target’s first letter at r 2 r_{2} and has its own next matching panel at r 4 r_{4} . The target answers with a count, r 2 r_{2} , at layer 19 (86.5%), with the panel after the written one, r 3 r_{3} , at layer 20 (68.4%), with the source’s own choice, r 4 r_{4} , at layer 24 (87.6%), and with the source’s letter from layer 30. The shaded band marks layers 20-21.
blocks.zh: 图12:光标表格前的逗号符号所在的状态。 我们把一个逗号的剩余部分, 复制成一个没有写字的结肠符号, (a) 同样的形象,上面写着r 1 r_{1}上面写着r 2 r_{2}下面写着r r_{2}被搁置的目标。 用r 1 r_{1}写目标答案r 2 r_{2}65.8%的病例在14层,96.4%在21层. 用r 2 r r r r =2 } 也写了 r 2 r r =2 } 以 75.1% 的 19 级 和 r 3 r = 3 } 从 23 级 (82.4%) 的 答案 。 至19层 复制状态只说写了一封信 从第20层开始,目标从书面面板开始。 (b) 第5.1节的跳伞实验,由共享的第一个比对面板拆分。 平均在0-17层上,当共享面板为1面板时,目标跳过80.6±\pm4.5%,2面板为8.6±\pm3.3%,2面板为4.7±\pm2.4%. 3. 第20层跳跃率为99.5±\pm 0.8%,97.5±\pm 2.2%,74.2±\pm 7.1%,第21层跳跃率为53.2±\pm 6.7%,72.0±\pm 7.4%,88.4±\pm 5.1%. (c) 标准来源,它将目标的第一个字母写在r 2 r_{2}并且拥有自己的下一个匹配面板在r 4 r_{4}。 目标答案为:数,r 2 r_{2},第19层(86.5%),写完后面板,r r_{3},第20层(68.4%),来源自己的选择,r 4 r_{4},第24层(87.6%),来源的信从第30层。 阴影带标记20-21层.

blocks.en: We run two controls on the skip design. First, we copy the colon token of a source that has written nothing into the target’s colon token. The target keeps its own answer in 98.6 to 100.0% of pairs at every layer through 29, so patching a comma-token residual into a colon token is not by itself what moves the answer. Second, we prefill the source with a letter that is drawn in neither image. This source makes the target skip the shared panel in 53.8 ± \pm 4.4% of pairs at layer 20, against 91.0 ± \pm 2.4% for the real source on the same pairs. The skip happens mostly when the shared panel is panel 1 (96.8 ± \pm 2.4%), and less for panel 2 (27.6 ± \pm 7.6%) and panel 3 (29.0 ± \pm 6.8%). So this source carries only the early lean, not a panel. The cursor needs a letter that is in the image.
blocks.zh: 我们运行两个控制 跳伞设计。 首先,我们复制一个来源的结肠标志,该来源没有在目标结肠标志上写字。 目标在每层98.6%到100.0%的对数中保持自己的回答,通过29,所以将一个逗号的残基补上结肠符,本身并不是移动答案的本身. 第二,我们预先给源头填上一个在两个图像中都没有绘制的字母. 此源使目标跳过共享面板在第20层的53.8 ±\pm 4.4%的对子中,对同一对子上的真实源进行91.0 ±\pm 2.4%. 当共享面板是第1面板(96.8 ±\pm 2.4%)时,跳跃多发生,而第2面板(27.6 ±\pm 7.6%)和第3面板(29.0 ±\pm 6.8%)则较少发生. 所以这个来源只携带早期的精度,而不是一个面板. 光标需要图像中的字母 。

blocks.en: D.3 Other Searches and Patches at the Answer Token
blocks.zh: D.3 答题中的其他搜索和补丁

blocks.en: We search over every head at the answer token, as we do at the shape token (Figure 13 ). We score each of the 1,152 heads on the discovery pairs of the list task in three ways. The first score is the gain in progress when the head reads the source’s image keys. The second is the gain when the head’s output is the source’s. The third, in the target’s own run, is the gain toward repeating the written letter when the head’s output is set to zero. The heads that move progress sit in the layers of the binding heads. Zeroing single heads at the answer token pushes the model toward writing the letter again, and the top heads of that search sit in layers 15-34. The same zeroing search at the comma token finds only late heads, in layers 19-35, and none of them is a binding head. So the comma token reads the cursor and does not write it.
blocks.zh: 就像我们在形状标志上一样(图13), 我们以三种方式在清单任务的发现对上 给1 152个头每人打分 第一个分数是当头部读取源头的图像密钥时的进取. 第二是当头部输出是源头时的收益. 第三,在目标自身运行中,当头部输出被设定为零时,重复书面信件的好处。 推动进步的头坐在捆绑头的两层。 答案符号上的零头将模型推向再写字母,搜索的顶部则坐落在15-34层. 在逗号上同样的零化搜索只发现后头,分19-35层,没有一个是绑定头. 因此逗号读取光标而不写.

blocks.en: Figure 13: The heads that set the cursor at the answer token sit in the layers of the binding heads. We patch one head at a time at the answer token of the list task. In (a), the head reads the source’s image keys, and in (b), we replace the head’s output with the source’s. Each cell is the mean gain of the cursor’s letter on the discovery pairs. In (c), we set the head’s output to zero in the target’s own run. Each cell is the mean gain toward repeating the written letter on the discovery pairs. The 16 binding heads are outlined.
blocks.zh: 图13:将光标设置在答号上的头坐在绑定头的层中. 我们一次补一个头 在列表任务的答案符号。 在(a)中,头部读取来源的图像密钥,在(b)中,我们用来源的输出取代头部的输出。 每个单元格是光标字母在发现对上的平均值。 在(c)中,我们规定目标本身的产出为零。 每个细胞都是重复发现对子上的书面信的利得。 16个捆绑头被概括.

blocks.en: We let the 32 heads that the key-patch search selects at the answer token read the source’s image keys. The next answer then moves to the letter after the source’s panel in 73.8 ± \pm 3.8% of held-out cases, against 0.0 ± \pm 0.0% for random heads. Every new search on the list task finds mostly heads of the matching set of Sections 4 and 6 (Table 10 ). Of the 32 heads found at the shape token, 15 are binding heads. Of the 16 found at the colon token, 10 are relay heads, and of the 16 found at the comma token, 15 are gaze heads. The 64 heads found at the last letter mix 1 binding, 10 relay, 6 gaze, and 0 language heads.
blocks.zh: 我们让按键搜索时选择的32个头读取源头的图像密钥。 接下来的答案是,73.8 ±\pm 3.8%被搁置的个案中,在来源面板之后的字母上,随机头数为0.0 ±\pm 0.0。 对列表任务的每次新搜索都发现大部分对应的第4节和第6节的套头(表10). 在形状标志上发现的32个头中,有15个是装订头. 在结肠标志物发现的16个中,有10个是中继头,在逗号标志物发现的16个中,有15个是凝视头. 在上个字母中发现的64个头,混合了1个绑定,10个接力,6个凝视,和0个语言头.

blocks.en: Table 10: Each patch on the list task, with the heads of Sections 4 and 6 and with the heads a new search finds. Each row is one patch on the list task. Each cell is the percent of held-out list cases in which the patch moves the expected variable.
blocks.zh: 表10:列表任务的每个补丁,第4节和第6节的负责人和负责人都有新的搜索发现. 每行都是列表任务中的一个补丁. 每个单元格是补丁移动预期变量的被搁置列表案例的百分比。

blocks.en: Figure 14 gives every condition of the rebind in Section 5.3 . Rebinding the last answer token to panel 4 moves the next answer past panel 4 with the 32 answer-token heads (88.0 ± \pm 2.8%), the 16 binding heads (84.2 ± \pm 3.2%), and all 1,152 heads (62.2 ± \pm 4.4%). It never does so with 16 random heads from the binding heads’ layers. In the rest of the pairs the target still answers from panel 4 (9.8 ± \pm 2.6%, 13.4 ± \pm 3.0%, and 35.6 ± \pm 4.2%). In any condition, the target repeats a written letter in at most 2.4 ± \pm 1.3% of pairs. Conversely, rebinding the first answer token moves the answer in at most 3.6 ± \pm 1.6% of pairs, and leaves it at panel 4 in 96.4 ± \pm 1.6% to 98.8 ± \pm 0.9%.
blocks.zh: 图14列出了第5.3节中重组的每个条件。 将最后一个答题符重新绑定到第4面板上,将下一个答题符移动到第4面板上,上面有32个答题头(88.0±\pm 2.8%),16个绑题头(84.2±\pm 3.2%),以及所有1,152个头(62.2±\pm 4.4%). 它从来没有用16个随机头从捆绑的头层来做。 在其余的对子中,目标仍然从4号面板(9.8 ±\pm 2.6%,13.4 ±\pm 3.0%,35.6 ±\pm 4.2%)得到答案. 无论如何,目标在最多2.4±\pm 1.3%的对数中重复一个书面字母. 反之,将第一个答案符重新绑定在最多3.6±\pm 1.6%的对中移动答案,将其留在96.4±\pm 1.6%到98.8±\pm 0.9%。

blocks.en: Figure 14: The cursor is set by the last answer token. Pairs that skip the rebound panel, for each head set. We test the random heads at the last answer token only.
blocks.zh: 图14:光标由最后一个回答符号设置。 跳过反弹面板的对价 每套头都一样 我们只测试最后一个答录符上的随机头.

blocks.en: If the cursor were the written letter rather than its panel, the model would also skip a second copy of that letter in the image. To test this, we put the written letter into r 3 r_{3} as well, so that after “ W W , r 2 r_{2} ,” the next matching panel holds W W again. The model writes W W again in 95.8 ± \pm 1.7% of lists, against 96.6 ± \pm 1.6% when r 3 r_{3} holds a new letter. The letter adds only a weak pull. What the model crosses off is the panel.
blocks.zh: 如果光标是书面信件而不是其面板,模型也会跳过图像中该信件的第二个副本. 为了测试这一点,我们也把书面信件放入r 3 r_{3},这样,在“W W, r 2 r_{2} ” 之后,下一个匹配的面板再次持有W W. 该模型在95.8±\pm1.7%的列表中再次写作WW,而当r 3 r_{3}持有新信件时,则写作为96.6±\pm 1.6%. 信只增加了微弱的拉力. 模型所交叉的是面板。

blocks.en: When we block the answer token’s attention to the shape token, the answer token still sets the cursor: the next answer is unchanged in 98.0 ± \pm 1.2% of cases. When we block the comma token’s attention to the shape token instead, 73.2 ± \pm 3.8% of answers survive. The comma token also uses the shape token to find the matching panels (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 当我们屏蔽答案符对形状符的注意时,答案符仍然设置光标:下一个答案在98.0±\pm 1.2%的情况下没有变化. 当我们阻止逗号对形状的注意时, 逗号符号还使用形状符号来寻找匹配的面板(Appendix E.3 .

blocks.en: D.4 Two Routes From the Answer Token to the Comma Token
blocks.zh: D.4 从回答托肯到逗号的两条路线

blocks.en: The comma token needs the cursor. When we block the last comma token’s attention to the answer token, the model writes the letter again in 67.8 ± \pm 4.0% of cases. Blocking its attention to the colon token instead leaves 99.8 ± \pm 0.3% of answers unchanged (Table 11 ). The comma token can learn where the last letter came from in two ways. It can read the answer token, which has bound the letter to its panel, or it can find the letter in the image itself. Either way is enough on its own. With the answer token blocked from the image, the next answer is kept in 91.4 ± \pm 2.4% of cases. With the comma token blocked from the image, it is kept in 98.6 ± \pm 1.0%. With both blocked from the image, it is kept in only 18.2 ± \pm 3.4%.
blocks.zh: 逗号符号需要光标 。 当我们阻止最后一个逗号对答号的注意时,模型再次用67.8 ±\pm 4.0%的个案来写这封信. 将注意力挡在结肠符上,反而留下99.8±\pm0.3%的答案不变(表11). 逗号符号可以从两个方面得知上一封信来自何处. 它可以读取解答符,将字母绑在它的面板上,也可以在图像本身中找到字母. 无论哪种方式都足够了 随解答符被图像屏蔽,下一个解答被保存在91.4±\pm 2.4%的病例中. 随着逗号符号从图像中被屏蔽,它被保存在98.6±\pm 1.0%. 两者均被屏蔽在图像中,只保存在18.2±\pm 3.4%.

blocks.en: The first route carries the cursor, and it is spread over many heads. We patch the source’s values of the answer token, as every head at the comma token reads them. While the comma token can still look at the image, this moves the next letter in only 17.0% of cases. Once we block the comma token from the image, except through the gaze heads, the same patch moves the answer off the target’s own panel in 99.0% of cases. It goes to the source’s cursor in 40.7% and to the source’s own next panel in 58.2%. Giving the comma token the source’s image keys instead moves it in 10.8%. The comma token reads the answer token in two ranges of layers, and either range is enough. With this attention blocked in layers 0-24 the answer survives in 96.9% of cases, and with it blocked in layers 20-35 it also survives in 96.9%. Blocking the attention of the 64 highest-ranked heads to the answer token gives 16.5% repeats, against 0.0% for 64 random heads. We also run a single-head search for this value patch, scored with the comma token blocked from the image in the same way. It selects 8 heads that do not reach the 80% rule. On the held-out cases, these heads move the cursor in 63.9% with the comma token blocked (random heads 11.9%), and in 5.7% without. Two of the eight are relay heads, and none is a gaze head. So this value patch finds no small set of heads.
blocks.zh: 第一条路线带有光标,它分布在许多头部. 我们修补源代码的值, 正如每个数字符号头所读的。 虽然逗号符号仍然可以查看图像,但这只会在17.0%的情况下移动下一个字母. 一旦我们从图像中封锁逗号符号,除了通过凝视头,同一补丁会在99.0%的案例中将答案从目标自己的面板上移动。 它以40.7%的速度进入消息来源的光标,以58.2%的速度进入消息来源自己的下一个光标。 给逗号符号 源的图像密钥将它移动到 10.8% 。 逗号符号按两层来读答号,任意一个范围都足够. 由于这种注意力被阻塞在0-24层中,因此96.9%的病例能够幸存下来,而20-35层被阻塞,这也存活了96.9%。 将64个排名最高的头部的注意力挡在答题符上,重复率达到16.5%,64个随机头部的重复率为0.0%. 我们还对这个值补丁进行单头搜索,得分与以同样方式屏蔽在图像上的逗号符号. 它选择8个没有达到80%规则的头. 在被搁置的情况下,这些头移动光标的占63.9%,逗号被屏蔽(随机头部占11.9%),5.7%没有。 八人之中有两个是中继头,没有一个是望头. 因此这个值补丁找不到小的一组头.

blocks.en: Table 11: Blocking attention in the target’s own run, at the second answer. We block the attention in each row and read the next letter. Percent of held-out cases with one letter written.
blocks.zh: 表11:第二次答复时,将注意力集中在目标本身。 我们屏蔽每行的注意力,读下一封信。 持一封信被搁置的案件百分比。

blocks.en: A target that has written only r 3 r_{3} answers r 2 r_{2} in 34.4 ± \pm 4.2% of cases and r 4 r_{4} in most of the rest. We take a run on the same image that wrote r 1 r_{1} , r 2 r_{2} , r 3 r_{3} . Copying the residual of its comma token at layer 22 makes the target answer r 4 r_{4} in 98.5% of cases. Letting the relay heads read the values of its third letter does the same in 89.3% (all heads 81.2%). So the last written token carries the earlier panels, because it read the earlier answer tokens.
blocks.zh: 在34.4 ±\pm 4.2%的病例 和 r 4 r_{4} 大部分的病例中, 我们跑在同一个图像上写 r 1 r r r r r r r 3 r 3 } 在22层复制其逗号符号的剩余部分使得目标答案r 4 r_{4}在98.5%的情况下. 让中继头读取其第三个字母的值在89.3%(所有头81.2%)中也一样. 因此,最后一个书面的符号带有早期的面板,因为它读了早期的答案符号.

blocks.en: D.5 The Cursor Is a Small, Writable Subspace
blocks.zh: D.5 光标是一个小的、可写入的子空间

blocks.en: Section 5.2 shows the cursor by copying a source’s comma token. Here we write the cursor with no source, and ask how many dimensions it takes.
blocks.zh: 第5.2节通过复制来源的逗号来显示光标。 在这里,我们用没有来源的光标来写,并询问它需要多少维度.

blocks.en: On development images we prefill the model’s own letters up to a matching panel p p , for every p p , and record the residual of the last comma token at layers 19 to 22. The direction for p p is the mean of these residuals minus the mean over all p p . The six directions have rank 5 at every layer. Neighboring p p are similar and distant p p are opposed (cosine 0.67 between panels 1 and 2, − 0.73 -0.73 between 1 and 5). We also record the mean comma-token residual and the mean colon-token residual with nothing written. Their difference, the “comma offset”, has norm 53 at layer 20, larger than any direction.
blocks.zh: 在开发图像上,我们预先将模型自己的字母填充到一个匹配的面板p,每个pp,并将最后一个逗号符号的剩余部分记录在19至22层. p的方向是这些残基的平均值减去所有p的平均值。 六个方向每层都有5级. 邻接p是相似的,遥远的p是对立的(1和2面板之间为0.67次,1和5之间为0.73-0.73次). 我们还记录了中间逗号的剩余部分和没有文字记录的中间结肠的剩余部分。 它们的区别,即“comma 抵消”在20层有规范53,比任何方向都大。

blocks.en: On fresh images with nothing written, we add the direction for p p to the colon-token residual at layer 21 and read the next token. An image counts for p p when a matching panel lies after p p . The direction alone does nothing: 0.0 to 2.2% of images start after p p , the same as with a random direction. The colon token is missing the comma state. Adding the comma offset alone moves every target to a fixed position near panel 4 (mean chosen panel 4.2 to 4.6 for every p p ). Adding the offset plus the direction for p p tracks p p . The target then starts at the first matching panel after p p in 97.7 ± \pm 1.6%, 96.3 ± \pm 1.7%, 96.8 ± \pm 1.5%, 96.1 ± \pm 1.8%, and 96.5 ± \pm 1.9% of images for p = 1 p=1 to 5, with the mean chosen panel at 2.49, 3.42, 4.38, 5.26, and 5.95. The offset plus a random direction of the same norm gives 8.8%, 38.0%, 63.3%, 48.3%, and 15.7% (mean of five draws). Replacing the colon-token residual by the mean comma state for p p gives the same numbers. A direction taken from layer 10 does nothing, and one from layer 30 overshoots.
blocks.zh: 在没有书写的新图像上,我们在第21层的结肠结肠残基上添加 p 的方向,并读取下一个符号. 当匹配面板位于 p 之后时, 图像数为 p 。 单是方向没有做任何事情: 0.0到2.2%的图像从p 开始,与随机方向相同. 结肠符号缺少逗号状态. 仅添加逗号抵消即可将每个目标移动到靠近第4面板的固定位置(每页平均选择4.2至4.6面板)。 添加偏移加上 p p 音轨的方向 p. 然后目标从p之后的第一个匹配面板开始,在p=1=1至5的p中,平均选择面板为:97.7 ±\pm 1.6%,96.3 ±\pm 1.7%,96.8 ±\pm 1.5%,96.1 ±\pm 1.8%,以及96.5 ±\pm 1.9%,平均选择面板为:2.49, 3.42, 4.38, 5.26和5.95. 抵消加上同一规范的随机方向给出了8.8%、38.0%、63.3%、48.3%和15.7%(5个图中的平均值)。 用 p 的平均值逗号状态取代结肠结肠残基给出相同的数字. 从第10层取走的方向毫无作用,从第30层取出的方向则没有作用。

blocks.en: Let S S be the span of the six directions. We use the cursor design of Section 5.2 and a second design in which the source has written panel 2 only, so that the cursor predicts panel 3 while the mean comma state predicts panel 6. On both, we patch only the component of the source’s comma token inside S S , only its complement, or both. The S S component alone, written into a colon token, changes nothing (the own answer in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0%), because the comma offset lies mostly outside S S . Once the rest of the residual is comma-like, S S decides the target. The source’s S S part with the mean’s complement gives the source’s cursor in 68.8 ± \pm 4.0% of cases at layer 21. Conversely, the source’s complement with the mean’s S S part gives the mean’s target in 96.0 ± \pm 1.7%. The full patch gives the source’s cursor in 87.4 ± \pm 2.8 to 96.6 ± \pm 1.5%. A random five-dimensional subspace moves nothing (0.0%). So the cursor is a five-dimensional code inside the comma-token residual, and the rest of that residual says only that the token is a comma. Appendix G.3.8 tests these directions on other layouts.
blocks.zh: 让S成为六个方向的跨度. 我们使用第5.2节的光标设计,以及仅由来源写入第2面板的第二个设计,这样光标就可以预测第3面板,而平均逗号状态则预测面板 6个 在两者中,我们只给SS内部的源逗号部分补上,只有其补充,或者两者兼而有之。 S S 组件单独写成一个冒号,不会改变任何东西(自己的答案在 1000.0 ±\pm 0.0%),因为逗号抵消大多位于 S S 之外. 一旦剩余部分为逗号状,S S决定目标. 来文方的S部分与平均值互补,在68.8 ±\pm 4.0%的21级病例中给出了来文方的光标。 反之,来源与平均SS部分的互补使得平均目标达到96.0±\pm 1.7%. 全补丁给出了87.4±\pm 2.8到96.6±\pm1.5%的源光标. 一个随机的五维子空间不移动(0.0%). 所以光标是逗号残基内部的五维码,其余的残基只说符是逗号. 附录G.3.8在其他布局上测试这些方向.

blocks.en: Appendix E Select: Details and Supporting Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录E 选择:细节和支持实验

blocks.en: This appendix supports Section 5.4 . We give the rule that select follows and show how the model stops. We then show how the colon and comma tokens find the matching panels again, and what we can read from the comma token’s residual with no patch. Finally, we hide a panel from a layer on, test the read that refuses a written panel, and describe the searches for selection heads.
blocks.zh: 本附录支持科 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 我们给出规则 选择以下 并显示如何停止模型。 然后我们展示结肠和逗号如何再次找到匹配的面板,以及我们能够从逗号的剩余部分读到哪些内容而无补丁. 最后,我们从一层上隐藏一个面板,测试拒绝书面面板的读数,并描述对选择头的搜索.

blocks.en: E.1 The Rule Select Follows, and Stopping
blocks.zh: E.1 规则选择

blocks.en: Figure 15: Select starts at the last written panel. We write letters out of order, with no patch. Each row is a prefix of written letters. Each cell is the percent of held-out targets whose next letter comes from that matching panel.
blocks.zh: 图15: 选择开始于最后一个写面板。 我们写字母有问题,没有补丁。 每行都是书面字母的前缀. 每个单元格都是被搁置目标的百分比, 下一封信来自匹配面板。

blocks.en: To see which panel select picks, we write letters out of order, with no patch, and read the next letter of the held-out targets (Figure 15 ). With only the second heart written, the model answers with the third in 92.8% of lists, and goes back to the first in 2.6%. With the third written, it answers with the fourth in 64.4% and goes back to the second in 34.4%. With the third and then the first written, it answers with the second in 95.6%. With the second and then the first written, it answers with the third in 87.2%. Next, we block the comma token’s attention to one of the written letters, on the lists whose next letter is right with nothing blocked (Table 12 ). When the comma token cannot attend to an earlier written letter, that panel is written again in 52.8 ± \pm 4.6% of cases after “ r 2 r_{2} , r 1 r_{1} ”, and in 57.0 ± \pm 4.5% after “ r 3 r_{3} , r 2 r_{2} , r 1 r_{1} ”. The rest still skip it, so the later answer tokens carry part of the record forward. Select starts at the cursor and takes the nearest unwritten panel, preferring the right. Every answer token contributes to what counts as done.
blocks.zh: 要看到哪个面板选择选择,我们写字母顺序不正常,没有补丁,并读取被搁置目标的下一个字母(图15). 只有第二颗心写着,模型以92.8%的排行榜第三位回答,并以2.6%的排行榜回溯到第一位. 以第三篇写成,以64.4%为第四篇回答,以34.4%为第二篇. 以第三篇,然后是第一篇,以95.6%的成绩回答第二篇. 以第二,然后第一篇写成,以87.2%的第三篇回答. 接下来我们阻止逗号的注意, 当逗号不能处理早先的一封信时,该面板在“r 2 r_{2}r 1 r_{1}”之后的52.8 ±\pm 4.6%的案例中再次写成,在“r 3 r_{3}, r 2 r_{2}, r 1 r_{1}”之后的57.0 ±\pm 4.5%中再次写成。 其余部分仍然跳过,因此后期的答录符将部分记录带往前. 选择从光标开始并选择最近的未写入面板,偏好右侧。 每一个回答符号都有助于所做的事情。

blocks.en: Table 12: Letters written out of order, with attention blocked. We block the comma token’s attention to one of the written letters, and read which panel the next letter comes from. Each cell is a percent of targets. The rows use the lists whose next letter is right with nothing blocked: 87.2% of the lists after “ r 2 r_{2} , r 1 r_{1} ” and 92.6% after “ r 3 r_{3} , r 2 r_{2} , r 1 r_{1} ”.
blocks.zh: 表12 失序的字母,注意受阻. 我们屏蔽逗号的注意力, 每个细胞都是目标的百分比。 各行使用下个字母正确的列表:87.2%在“r 2 r_{2}r 1 r_{1}”之后,92.6%在“r 3 r_{3}r 2 r_{2}r 1 r_{1}”之后。

blocks.en: At the last letter, the model chooses between a comma and the end of its turn. A source that has written its only matching panel stops, and a target with matching panels left goes on. We patch the outputs of the 64 heads found at the last letter. This makes a finished list go on in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% of cases, and a continuing list stop in 96.8 ± \pm 1.5%, against 0.2 ± \pm 0.3% and 0.0 ± \pm 0.0% for the same number of random heads. The values these heads read make a continuing list stop in 88.2 ± \pm 2.8%. The binding heads’ outputs from a run that still has matching panels make a finished list go on in 95.9% of cases, and the relay heads’ values do so in 84.5%. No small set of the earlier heads makes a continuing list stop. In the target’s own run, a finished list goes on when the later tokens cannot attend to the shape token (99.8 ± \pm 0.3%). It also goes on when the relay heads cannot attend to the text at the last letter (69.2 ± \pm 4.1%, random heads 0.0 ± \pm 0.0%). A continuing list never stops, whichever attention we block. After it goes on, a finished list adds only letters of its own image. The 64 heads found at the comma token for the next panel (Appendix E.7 ) make a finished list go on in 99.5% of cases, but random heads do so in 29.5%. These heads make a continuing list stop in 33.7%, against 0.0% for random heads. On the single-answer task, with the letter written after Answer: , the model ends its turn in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% of runs, whichever attention we block. There, the instruction decides the stop. Only the list task makes the model decide from the image and its own words.
blocks.zh: 在最后一个字母中,模型在逗号和转弯结束之间选择. 一个已经写入其唯一匹配面板停止的源,一个带有匹配面板左侧的目标继续. 我们补补上一封信中发现的64个头的输出. 这使得完成的列表在100.0±\pm 0.0%的病例中继续,96.8±\pm 1.5%的连续列表停止,而0.2±\pm 0.3%和 0.0±\pm 0.0的随机头数相同. 这些头读的值在88.2 ±\\pm 2.8%中持续列表停止. 在95.9%的案例中, 没有一小组前头会继续停留名单。 在目标自己的运行中,当后期的令牌无法处理形状令牌(99.8 ±\pm 0.3%)时,完成的列表继续. 当中继头无法在最后一个字母(69.2±\pm 4.1%,随机头 0.0±\pm 0.0%)处理文本时,它也继续. 连续的列表从不停止,无论我们阻止的注意。 之后,一个完成的列表只添加了自己形象的字母. 在逗号上为下一个面板发现的64个头(Appendix E.7 )使得一个完成的列表在99.5%的案例中继续,但随机头在29.5%中继续. 这些头在33.7%的时间内持续停止列表,随机头则在0.0 %. 在单答任务上,用Answer之后的字母: ,模型以1000.0±\pm 0.0%的运行结束其转折,无论我们阻断的注意力如何. 在那里,指令决定停止。 只有列表任务让模型从图像和自己的单词决定.

blocks.en: E.2 When the Model Skips a Panel, the Last Pointer Is Still Right
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 当模型跳过面板时, 最后的指针仍然正确

blocks.en: The model makes few errors on six panels. So we let it write whole lists on longer strips, with ten panels and seven matching panels, and read its states without any patch. It writes 75.8% of these lists without an error. The most common error is a skip: the model passes over the next matching panel and answers from a later one. 3.2% of answers are skips, and 86.5% of the skips pass over a single matching panel. The other errors are rare. The model answers from a non-matching panel in 1.3% of answers, goes back to an earlier unwritten panel in 0.5%, repeats a written letter in 0.1%, and never stops early.
blocks.zh: 该模型在六个面板上很少出错. 所以我们让它用更长的条块来写完整的列表, 上面有10块面板和7块匹配面板, 并读取它没有任何补丁的状态。 它写了75.8%的这些清单,没有错误。 最常见的错误是跳过:模型通过下一个匹配面板,并从后一个面板中解答. 3.2%的答案是跳过,86.5%的跳过单个匹配面板. 其他错误是罕见的。 模型在1.3%的答案中从一个非匹配面板中解答,以0.5%回溯到一个更早的未写面板,以0.1%重复一个书面信件,并且从未提前停止.

blocks.en: We compare the skips that follow at least one written letter with correct answers at the same position in the list. At a skip, the earlier steps of the mechanism are intact. The binding heads at the last answer token put their strongest attention on the panel of the written letter in 100.0% of skips, as in correct answers. A probe on the residual at layer 21 and the comma token reads the last written panel in 92.1% of skips, against 97.5% of correct answers. The error comes at select. At a skip, the gaze heads at the comma token put their strongest attention on the correct next panel in only 25.4% of cases, against 95.6% for correct answers. In 68.3% of skips, they look at the panel the model then writes. A non-matching panel lies between the last written panel and the correct next one in 71.4% of skips, against 28.2% of correct answers. So at a skip, the pointer is right and the choice is wrong. Skips happen most often when the next matching panel is not the neighbor of the last one. These are the model’s own errors on our synthetic list task. We do not test repetition or early stopping on natural images and leave it for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了在列表中至少一个书面字母之后的跳过和在相同位置正确答案的跳过. 一个跳跃,机制的早期步骤是完好无损的. 最后一个回答符号的绑定头像正确的回答一样,将最强烈的注意力放在字母跳过率的100.0%的字面板上. 21层残骸的探测器和逗号符号读取了92.1%跳跃中最后一个写板,对97.5%的正确答案. 选择时出现错误 。 仅25.4%的个案中, 在68.3%的跳过中, 他们看板 模型然后写。 在71.4%的跳过中,有一个不匹配的面板位于最后一个书面面板和下一个正确的面板之间,而正确答案的28.2%. 因此在跳跃时,指针是正确的,选择是错误的. 当下一个匹配面板不是最后一个面板的邻居时,跳过最经常发生. 这些是模型本身在我们综合清单任务上的错误。 我们不测试重复或及早停止自然图像,而把它留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: E.3 The Answer Token Finds the Candidates Again
blocks.zh: E.3 答复再次找到候选人

blocks.en: The colon and comma tokens do not only take the matching panels from the shape token. Each of them also binds the question to the image again by itself.
blocks.zh: 结肠和逗号符号不仅从形状符号中取出匹配面板. 每一个都把问题再次单独地与图像联系在一起。

blocks.en: On the list task, the relay heads are not the only path. We patch the target’s residual vector at one token and one layer, for every token after the image. This finds the same two tokens as on the single-answer task, the shape token and the colon token. When the relay heads cannot attend to the text at the colon token, the first answer survives in 66.8 ± \pm 4.1% of cases, against 7.8 ± \pm 1.6% on the single-answer task. The colon token of the list prompt binds the question to the image itself. With the shape token blocked from the image, the first answer survives in 67.2 ± \pm 4.1% of cases. With the colon token blocked from the image, it survives in 99.4 ± \pm 0.7%. So either token can bind the question on its own, and the shape token’s route is the stronger one.
blocks.zh: 在列表任务中,继电器头不是唯一的路径. 我们把目标残留的矢量固定在一面一面, 这与单答任务,形状符号和结号符号相同. 当中继头无法在冒号上关注文本时,第一个答案存活在66.8 ±\pm 4.1%的病例中,而在单答任务上则维持7.8 ±\pm 1.6%. 列表的冒号提示将问题绑定在图像本身上 。 随着形状符号被图像屏蔽,第一个答案在67.2±\pm 4.1%的病例中存活下来. 随着结肠符与图像的阻断,它以99.4±\pm 0.7%存活下来. 因此,无论哪一种标志都能够单独约束问题,而形状标志的路线是更强的。

blocks.en: We build a source with the asked shape at r 1 r_{1} and r 3 r_{3} and the same written letter at r 1 r_{1} . It differs from the target only in the set of matching panels, and this moved set makes the target skip r 2 r_{2} . Patching the source’s residual vector into the shape token, at the best layer, does this in 14.8 ± \pm 3.0% of cases. Patching it into the comma token does so in 78.4%. Replacing the outputs of the 32 heads found at the shape token does so in 21.0 ± \pm 3.4% of cases, against 0.0 ± \pm 0.0% for random heads. The same patch does so in 64.5 ± \pm 4.1% when the comma token keeps only the gaze heads’ view of the image. It does so in 96.8 ± \pm 1.5% when the answer token and the comma token also read the source’s image keys. So the comma token’s fresh look usually wins. In the target’s own run, blocking the comma token from the image keeps 91.8 ± \pm 2.4% of answers right. Blocking every later token’s attention to the shape token keeps 66.5 ± \pm 4.0%.
blocks.zh: 我们在r 1 r_{1}和r 3 r_{3} 和 r 1 r r_{1} 和 同一 个 书面 字母 r r_{1} 构建一个源头。 它与目标仅在匹配面板集中有所区别,这个移动的设定使得目标跳过r 2 r_{2}. 在14.8 ±\pm 3.0%的病例中, 将源的剩余矢量插入到形状符号中, 在最好的层层中, 在逗号上补上78.4% 取代在形状符上发现的32个头的输出,在21.0±\pm3.4%的病例中是这样做的,随机头的输出为0.0±\pm0.0%. 当逗号只保留图像的凝视头像时, 当回答符号和逗号也读取源头的图像密钥时, 因此,逗号的新表情通常会获胜。 在目标自己的运行中,从图像中屏蔽逗号令牌保留了91.8±\pm 2.4%的答案正确. 将每个后期的符号都挡住,

blocks.en: The fresh look already knows what is done. We use the panel directions learned at the shape token (Appendix B.6 ). In these directions, the binding heads’ contribution at the answer token scores the written panel at + 0.50 +0.50 and the next panel at − 0.09 -0.09 . The next panel scores below the written panel in 85.6 ± \pm 4.4% of held-out pairs, so a written panel has the sign of a matching panel when it is recorded. The same directions score the comma token’s contribution to the written panel at − 0.33 -0.33 and to the next panel at + 0.20 +0.20 . The written panel scores below the non-matching panels in 66.0 ± \pm 5.6% of pairs, and below the other matching panels in 89.2 ± \pm 4.0%. So the answer token records the panel, and the comma token subtracts it.
blocks.zh: 新的表情已经知道该怎么做了 我们使用在形状符号上学到的面板指示(附录B.6 ). 在这些方向上,在答题符上绑定头部的贡献以+0.50+0.50的成绩评出书面面板,下一个面板则以−0.09-0.09的成绩评出. 接下来的面板在85.6±\pm4.4%的被搁置对面中得分低于书面面板,所以书面面板在被记录时有匹配面板的标志. 同样,逗号对书面面板的贡献为−0.33-0.33,对下一个面板的贡献为+0.20+0.20。 书面面板的得分低于非匹配面板的66.0±\pm5.6%的对数,其他匹配面板的得分低于89.2±\pm4.0%. 所以答案符记录了面板,而逗号符则减去.

blocks.en: E.4 Reading the Comma Token’s State
blocks.zh: E.4 联合国 读取逗号的状态

blocks.en: We ask what the comma token’s residual holds with no patch. On the held-out pairs of the list task, we record the residual of the last comma token at every layer, fit a ridge probe on half of them, and read it on the other half (Figure 17 a). A probe for “panel p p has the asked shape” reads each panel with 95.9 ± \pm 1.0% accuracy at layer 17 and 99.3 ± \pm 0.5% at 21, from a chance level of two thirds. A probe for “which panel was written” names the written panel in 94.0 ± \pm 2.8% of pairs at layer 12 and 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% at 18. A probe for “which panel is next” names the next panel in 98.0 ± \pm 1.8% at layer 18 and 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% at 20. In its centered scores, the written panel sits below the other matching panels at every layer. The flat starts of the curves are the majority baselines, since the first panels of a list are usually the leftmost ones. The colon token behaves the same way with nothing written, and its matching-panel probe peaks at layers 20-23.
blocks.zh: 我们问该逗号的剩余值是多少,没有补丁。 在被搁置的对列表任务上,我们记录每层最后一个逗号符号的剩余部分,在其中一半上安装一个山脊探测器,在另一半上读(图17 a). “pp小组有要求的形状”探测器从2/3的概率水平看每个面板,17层的精度为95.9 ±\pm 1.0%,21层的精度为99.3 ±\pm 0.5%。 对“哪些面板是写成的”的探测器将书面面板命名为94.0 ±\pm 2.8%的12层和100.0 ±\pm 0.0%的18层。 一个“下一个是哪个面板”的探测器将下一个面板命名为98.0 ±\pm 1.8%的第18层和100.0 ±\pm 0.0%的第20层。 在其中心分数中,书面面板坐落在每层其他匹配面板下方. 曲线的平面起点是多数基线,因为列表中的第一个面板通常是最左边的. 结肠符的行为方式与无书写相同,其匹配的座板探测器在20-23层达到顶峰.

blocks.en: Figure 16: The cursor acts through the comma token’s residual up to layer 23. Pairs that still answer from the moved cursor when we hold the comma token’s residual at one layer. Dotted lines show the patch alone.
blocks.zh: 图16:光标通过逗号符号的残余作用到第23层。 当我们把逗号的剩余部分放在一层上时, 仍然从移动光标中解答的对等 。 虚线单独显示补丁.

blocks.en: We read the recorded attention of the same runs. At layer 21, the binding heads at the comma token put 51.6 ± \pm 1.9% of their image attention on the next panel and 3.9 ± \pm 0.2% on the written panel. At layers 15-19, their shares on the written panel, the next panel, and the other matching panels are all small and alike. At layer 20, the gaze heads give 22.3 ± \pm 0.6% to the next panel and 23.0 ± \pm 0.7% to each other matching panel. By layer 23, these shares are 61.9 ± \pm 1.4% and 7.4 ± \pm 0.4% (Figure 17 b). At the shape token, the binding heads put 79.6 ± \pm 0.2% of their image attention on the matching panels, and 27.4 ± \pm 0.8% of that on the one chosen first. At the colon and comma tokens, the gaze heads put 43.8 ± \pm 0.7% of their attention to matching panels on the chosen one for the first answer, and 65.9 ± \pm 0.6% for the second.
blocks.zh: 我们读到记录的注意 相同的跑。 在第21层,逗号上的绑定头将51.6±\pm的图像注意力的1.9%放在下一个面板上,将3.9±\pm的0.2%放在书面面板上. 在15-19层中,他们在书面面板上的股份,下一个面板,以及其他匹配面板都是小而相似的. 在第20层,凝视头将22.3±\pm 0.6%给下一个面板,23.0±\pm 0.7%给对方匹配面板. 按第23层划分,这些股份为61.9±\pm 1.4%和7.4±\pm 0.4%。 在形状标志上,捆绑头把79.6±\pm的图像注意力的0.2%放在匹配面板上,把27.4±\pm的0.8%放在第一个选择的面板上. 在结肠和逗号上,凝视头将43.8 ±\pm 0.7%的注意力放在第一个答案被选中的面板上的匹配面板上,第二个答案为65.9 ±\pm 0.6%.

blocks.en: Figure 17: What the comma token’s residual holds, with no patch. (a) We train ridge probes on the residual of the last comma token on half of the held-out pairs of the list task, and read them on the other half. The written panel is named in 94.0 ± \pm 2.8% of pairs at layer 12 and 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% at 18. The probes read whether each panel is a matching panel with 95.9 ± \pm 1.0% accuracy at layer 17 and 99.3 ± \pm 0.5% at 21, from a chance level of two thirds. The next panel is named in 98.0 ± \pm 1.8% at layer 18 and 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% at 20. (b) Image attention of the binding heads at the comma token, by layer. At layer 21 they put 51.6 ± \pm 1.9% of it on the next panel and 3.9 ± \pm 0.2% on the written panel. (c) Image attention of the gaze heads at the comma token, by layer. At layer 20 they give 22.3 ± \pm 0.6% to the next panel and 23.0 ± \pm 0.7% to each other matching panel, and by layer 23 they give 61.9 ± \pm 1.4% and 7.4 ± \pm 0.4%.
blocks.zh: 图17:逗号的剩余部分是什么,没有补丁。 (a) 在清单任务的一半被搁置的对子上,对最后一个逗号的剩余部分进行山脊探测,并在另一半上阅读。 书面面板命名于第12层的94.0±\pm 2.8%对,第18层的100.0±\pm0.0%对. 探测器读到每个面板是否为匹配面板,17层的精度为95.9 ±\pm 1.0%,21层的精度为99.3 ±\pm 0.5%,概率为三分之二. 下一个面板命名于98.0±\pm 1.8%的第18层,100.0±\pm0.0%的第20层. (b) 标点符号上装订头的图像注意度。 在第21层,他们把51.6 ±\pm的1.9%放在下一个面板上,把3.9 ±\pm的0.2%放在写板上. (c) 视线头部的图像注意,按层排列。 在第20层,它们给下一个面板22.3 ±\pm 0.6%,23.0 ±\pm 0.7%给对方匹配面板,按第23层,它们给61.9 ±\pm 1.4%和7.4 ±\pm 0.4%。

blocks.en: We take the held-out pairs with one letter written and let the 32 answer-token heads read the source’s image keys at the answer token. This moves the cursor: the target answers r 3 r_{3} in 73.8 ± \pm 3.8% of cases (the 16 binding heads and the 2 query and key heads outside them: 48.2 ± \pm 4.4%). We then hold the comma token’s residual at one layer at the target’s own values, on top of the patch (Figure 16 ). Held at layer 19 or earlier, the patch keeps its effect in 69.8 ± \pm 3.9% of cases. Held at layer 23 or later, the target answers its own r 2 r_{2} again in 99.4 ± \pm 0.7% (binding heads 99.0 ± \pm 0.9%). The hold alone changes nothing, with the target’s own answer in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% of cases at every layer tried. Holding the gaze heads’ queries at the comma token instead of the residual brings the answer back in 99.8 ± \pm 0.3%. So the cursor set at the answer token acts through the comma token’s residual up to layer 23, and through what the gaze heads read from it.
blocks.zh: 并让32个答题头在答题符上读取源头的图像键。 移动光标:目标在73.8 ±\pm 3.8%的案例中(16个绑定头和2个查询和2个门外的密钥头:48.2 ±\pm 4.4%)回答r 3 r_{3}。 然后,我们将逗号符号的剩余部分放在目标本身值的一层,放在补丁的顶部(图16)。 在19层或更早时,补丁在69.8 ±\pm 3.9%的案例中保持其效果. 在23层或以后,目标再次以99.4±\pm 0.7%(装订头99.0±\pm 0.9%)来回答它自己的r 2 r_{2}. 单是持有就没有什么改变,目标本身的答案在每层所审理的案件的100.0%左右。 将目光头像的询问放在逗号上, 因此,在答题符号上设置的光标通过逗号符号的剩余部分(直到第23层)和凝视头部从中读到的东西来操作。

blocks.en: E.5 Hiding a Panel From a Layer On
blocks.zh: E.5 从一层上隐藏一个面板

blocks.en: Figure 18: The next panel is chosen in layers 20-25. Lists that move on to the following matching panel when we hide the next panel from layer l l on. Hiding a non-matching panel moves at most 0.2 ± \pm 0.3% of lists.
blocks.zh: 图18:下一个面板按20-25层选择. 列出当我们从一层 l 上隐藏下一个面板时移动到以下匹配面板的列表 。 隐藏一个非匹配面板移动到最多0.2±\pm 0.3%的列表 。

blocks.en: To find the layers where the choice happens, we hide the next matching panel from every text token from layer l l on (Figure 18 ). Hidden from the first layer, the model moves on to the following matching panel in 84.8% of cases, so the other matching panels are there to fall back on. Hidden from layer 20 on, it moves on in 72.2%. Hidden from layer 21 on, it moves on in 37.4%, and from layer 25 on, in 2.8%. So the choice happens at the comma token in layers 20-25. Hiding a non-matching panel, from every text token except the shape token, moves the answer to the following matching panel in at most 0.2 ± \pm 0.3% of cases at any layer. Two more results support this reading. Hiding the first matching panel the same way makes the model start from r 2 r_{2} in 43.6 ± \pm 4.3% of cases when it is hidden from the first layer, and in 18.4 ± \pm 3.4% when it is hidden from layer 22 on, with the fall in layers 16-22. The first panel is harder to hide than the second, because it is the leftmost and its content also reaches the text through the image tokens of later panels. A copied pointer holds one panel. We copy the colon state of a source whose matching panels are r 2 r_{2} and r 4 r_{4} into the target at layer 24, and hide r 2 r_{2} from the colon token from that layer on. The target goes back to its own first matching panel in 76.6 ± \pm 3.7% of cases, and to the source’s other matching panel in only 3.2 ± \pm 1.5%.
blocks.zh: 为了找到选择所在的层,我们从第l层的每个文本符号中隐藏下一个匹配面板(图18)。 从第一层隐藏,该模型在84.8%的案例中移动到下面的匹配面板,所以其他匹配面板都会出现回落. 从第20层开始,它以72.2%的速度移动。 从第21层到第25层 以37.4%的速度前进 从第25层到第2.8% 因此选择发生在20-25层的逗号上. 隐藏一个非匹配面板,从除形状面板以外的每个文本面板中,将答案移动到下面的匹配面板中,在任何层中最多为0.2±\pm 0.3%。 还有两项结果支持这一解读。 隐藏第一个匹配面板的方式相同,使模型从r 2 r_{2}开始,43.6 ±\pm 4.3%的病例从第一层隐藏时开始,18.4 ±\pm 3.4%的病例从22层上隐藏时开始,秋季为16-22层. 第一个面板比第二个面板更难隐藏,因为它是最左边的,其内容也通过后来面板的图像符号到达文本. 复制的指针持有一个面板 。 我们复制一个源的结肠状态,它的匹配面板是r 2 r_{2}和r 4 r_{4}进入第24层的目标,并将r 2 r_{2}从第24层的结肠符中隐藏起来。 在76.6 ±\pm 3.7%的病例中,目标回到了自己的第一个匹配面板,而在只有3.2 ±\pm 1.5%的病例中,目标回到了源头的另一个匹配面板.

blocks.en: E.6 The Read Refuses a Written Panel and a Wrong Shape
blocks.zh: E.6 读取拒绝一个书面面板和一个错误形状

blocks.en: We point the gaze heads, with the source’s queries, at a panel the target should not read. When the panel holds the asked shape and is not yet written, the answer goes there in 88.2 ± \pm 2.8% of cases. When the panel holds another shape, the answer goes there in 22.4 ± \pm 3.8% of cases. It goes there in 85.1 ± \pm 3.1% when the gaze heads also read the source’s image keys for that panel, so the shape check runs through the image keys the gaze heads see. When the panel is already written, the answer goes there in 0.6 ± \pm 1.0% of cases, and in 22.0 ± \pm 6.2% when the gaze heads also read the source’s image keys for that panel. The refusal of a written panel goes through the answer token. When the comma token cannot attend to that answer token, the gaze heads are followed in 97.6 ± \pm 2.2% of these cases, and in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% with the source’s image keys as well. When we block the answer token itself from the image, the refusal stands (6.1 ± \pm 3.7%), because the comma token can bind the letter to the image by itself (Appendix D.4 ). So the cursor also stops the gaze heads from reading a written panel.
blocks.zh: 我们用消息来源的询问,将目光指向一个不应读取的面板。 当面板持有被询问的形状而尚未写入时,答案会以88.2 ±\\pm 2.8%的个案进行. 当面板有另一种形状时,答案会出现在22.4±\pm3.8%的病例中. 当凝视头也读到源头对面板的图像密钥时, 当面板已经写完时,答案会出现在0.6 ±\pm 1.0%的病例中,而在22.0 ±\pm 6.2%的目光头部也读到源头对面板的图像密钥时。 书面面板的拒绝通过答案符号。 当逗号无法处理该答题时, 视线头被跟踪到其中的97.6 ±\pm 2.2%, 当我们从图像中屏蔽答案符号本身时,拒绝是站立的(6.1 ±\pm 3.7%),因为逗号符号可以自己将字母绑定在图像上(附录D.4 ). 因此光标也阻止了凝视头部读取书面面板.

blocks.en: E.7 The Searches for Selection Heads
blocks.zh: E.7 搜索选择标题

blocks.en: We searched three times for heads that make the choice. In the first search, we start by replacing the output of one head at a time at the last comma token with the source’s, for every head in layers 20-25. We rank the heads on the discovery pairs, scored for the next panel and for the cursor, and sweep the top sets on the validation pairs. No size reaches the 80% rule for either outcome. The best size for the next panel, 64 heads, reaches 44% there. On the held-out pairs, those heads move the next panel in 61.9% of cases (random heads 0.0%). Their queries move it in 40.7%, and the cursor in 21.6%. Their image keys move it in 0.0%, and their text values in 5.7%. Fourteen of the 64 are gaze heads. With the gaze heads’ queries held at the target’s values, the output patch moves nothing (0.0%), so these heads act by writing what the gaze heads read. Replacing the outputs of the gaze heads themselves copies the source’s letter in 100.0% of cases, which is the read and not the choice.
blocks.zh: 我们搜了三遍 寻找做出选择的脑袋 在第一次搜索中,我们首先将最后一个逗号时一个头的输出替换为源头的输出,每层20-25。 我们把头排在发现的对子上, 给下一个面板和光标打分, 在验证对子上扫清顶部的对子. 两种结果都没有达到80%的大小。 下一个面板的最好尺寸,64个头,达到44%。 在被搁置的对子上,这些头部移动了61.9%的下一组面板(随机头部0.0%)。 他们的查询以40.7%移动,光标以21.6%移动. 他们的图像密钥以0.0%移动,他们的文本值以5.7%移动. 64人中,有14人目瞪口呆。 随着目视头的询问被控制在目标值上,输出补丁不会移动任何东西(0.0 %),所以这些目视头通过写出目视头所读的东西来行动. 以100.0%的病例来取代凝视结果,

blocks.en: The two other searches need no source. We rank the heads of layers 16-25 at the comma token in two ways. The first is the drop in the margin between the next letter and the best other matching panel’s letter when the head’s output is zeroed. The second is the shift of the head’s image attention from the other matching panels onto the next panel. The top heads of the two rankings overlap (L21H11, L20H29, L20H30, L21H18, L23H26 in both). On the held-out pairs, zeroing the top 4, 8, 16, 32, or 64 heads of either ranking leaves the next letter unchanged in 87.1% to 99.0% of cases.
