Copying their outputs from the source moves the next panel in at most 33.5% (the top 64 by margin drop), against at most 0.5% for the same number of random heads. With the gaze heads’ queries held, every such patch leaves the answer unchanged in 97.9% or more. So select is spread over many heads of layers 20-25, whose joint result the gaze heads read.
blocks.zh: 另外两次搜索不需要来源. 我们在逗号上对16 -25层的头排列了两种方式 第一个是当头部输出为零时,下一个字母和最佳其他匹配面板字母之间的差值下降。 第二,头部的图像注意力从其他匹配面板转移到下一个面板。 两个排名的顶级头目重叠(L21H11,L20H29,L20H30,L21H18,L23H26在两者中). 在被搁置的对阵中,将排名前4,8,16,32或64位的头目零位化,在87.1%到99.0%的情况下,下一个字母不变. 复制来自源的输出最多移动33.5%的下一个面板(比值下降前64位),而相同数量的随机头最多移动0.5%。 每一个这样的补丁都以97.9%或更高的比例不变。 因此,选择被分布在许多 20 -25层的头部, 它们的联合结果 凝视头读。

blocks.en: Appendix F Reading and Language: Details and Supporting Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录F 阅读和语言:详细情况和辅助实验

blocks.en: This appendix supports Section 6 . It covers the two searches for the heads that execute the pointer, the comparison with the published Gaze Heads, the checks on the gaze heads’ keys and values, the read on a list, what the gaze heads bring back, the object task, and every language experiment.
blocks.zh: 本附录支持第6节。 它涵盖了对执行指针的头的两次搜索,与公布的Gaze头的比较,对瞪头的键和值的检查,列表上的读数,瞪头带回的东西,对象任务,以及每一种语言的实验.

blocks.en: F.1 The Two Searches, and Which Heads They Select
blocks.zh: F.1 两项搜索及其选择的标题

blocks.en: A head that reads the pointer must build its query from it, so the main text ranks every head by a query patch at the colon token. To check whether other heads also read the image, we run a second search. We block one head at a time from every image token, and score the drop in the margin of the target’s own letter over the best of the other letters in its image. Figure 19 b reports both searches for every K K on the validation pairs. The query-patch search rises steeply up to eight heads and stays flat from 16 to 256. So the part of the pointer’s effect that it does not move is not a matter of missing heads. The blocking search finds no set of heads whose blocking breaks the answer. Even 256 blocked heads leave the answer intact in almost every case, and the heads this search ranks highest have no effect in any held-out test (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 读取指针的头必须从它中构建它的查询,所以正文通过在冒号符上的查询补丁来排列每个头. 为了检查其他头部是否也读过图像,我们进行第二次搜索. 我们从每个图像符号上一次堵住一个头,将目标自己字母的比值下降得分高于其图像中其他最优秀的字母。 图19b报告在验证对上对每K K进行搜索。 查询-patch搜索陡升至8个头,并保持平整,从16个到256个. 因此,指针效果中它不动的部分并不是头部缺失的问题. 屏蔽搜索没有找到任何一组被屏蔽的人解答. 甚至256个被封锁的头部几乎在每一个案例中都留下了完整的答案,而这次搜索的最高头部在任何搁置测试中都没有效果(表13.

blocks.en: The read at the colon token has many possible routes, and removing a large share of them is not enough to stop it. When we block the 32 gaze heads from the image, the target still gives the right answer in 88.2 ± \pm 2.0% of the held-out cases. When we block the top 200 published Gaze Heads from the image, it does so in 98.9 ± \pm 0.8%. With the gaze heads blocked, the letter is read earlier, by the tokens between the shape token and the colon token (Appendix C.3 ). So the gaze heads are sufficient, and the pointer acts only through their queries, but they are not the only heads that can read.
blocks.zh: 在结肠符上的读物有许多可能的路线,去掉其中的一大部分不足以阻止它. 当我们把32个目光头从图像上挡住时,目标仍然给出了88.2±\pm2.0%的被搁置案件的正确答案. 当我们屏蔽前200名的Gaze头像时,它以98.9 ±\pm 0.8%的速度发布. 随着凝视头部被堵塞,字母的读数更早,通过形状符号和结肠符号之间的符号(Appendix C.3 . 所以凝视头已经足够了,而指针只能通过他们的询问来行动,但是它们并不是唯一能读到的头.

blocks.en: Figure 19: Finding the gaze heads, and how they compare with the published ranking. (a) The number of heads shared in the top K K of three rankings of all 1,152 heads: our query-patch search, the Gaze score measured on our task, and the published Gaze Heads ranking. From K = 16 K=16 to 128, our ranking shares more heads with the Gaze score on this task than with the published ranking, 20 against 10 in the top 32. (b) The top K K heads of the two searches, patched together at the colon token on the 100 validation pairs. Patching their queries moves the answer to the source’s panel in 68.5% of cases at K = 8 K=8 , and in 73.5% to 76.5% from 16 to 256 heads. This stays below the 80% rule, so the rule takes its best size, 32 heads. Blocking up to 256 heads from the image loses the target’s answer in at most 2.5%.
blocks.zh: 图19:寻找凝视头,如何与公布的排名进行比较. (a) 在所有1 152个头的3个排名中,在K K最高排名中共享的头数:我们的查询-patch搜索、根据我们的任务测量的Gaze分数以及公布的Gaze Heads排名。 从K = 16 K = 16 至 128,我们的排名在这项任务上与Gaze的得分相比,与公布的排名相比,分享了更多的头数,20胜10负,排在前32位. (b) 两次搜索的顶端K K头,在100对验证对上的结肠符上拼接在一起。 在68.5%的K = 8 K = 8个案件中,在73.5%到76.5%的案例中,从16个头到256个头将答复移到来文方的面板上。 这一直低于80%的规则,所以规则的尺寸最好,有32个头. 将256个头从图像上挡住,

blocks.en: Table 13: The heads that read the pointer, found by patching, against the published Gaze Heads and the blocking search. Every patch acts at the colon token only. Percent of the 500 held-out pairs. The published ranking plays no part in our search.
blocks.zh: 表13 读取指针的头,通过补丁找到,与公布的Gaze头和屏蔽搜索相对. 每个补丁都只在结肠符上出现 占五百持戒对中. 公布的排名在我们的搜索中没有作用.

blocks.en: F.2 Our Gaze Heads and the Published Gaze Heads
blocks.zh: F.2 我们的盖兹头像和出版的盖兹头像

blocks.en: Table 13 already places the published top 100 and top 200 next to our gaze heads. Here we compare the rankings themselves, the effect against the number of heads, and the same ranking measured on our own task.
blocks.zh: 表13已经把公布的前100名和前200名放在我们眼前的旁边。 在这里,我们比较了排名本身,效果与头数,以及根据我们自己的任务衡量的相同排名.

blocks.en: Figure 19 a compares three rankings of all 1,152 heads. The first is our query-patch search. The second is the Gaze score of Gandikota and Bau (2026) measured on our task: the attention a head places, from the colon token, on the image tokens of the asked panel, averaged over every question of Appendix A.7 . The third is the original Gaze ranking from comic strips. Our gaze heads agree best with the Gaze score measured on the same task. The original and re-measured rankings share 57 of their top 100 heads, so the ranking itself shifts somewhat with the task. Of the 32 gaze heads, 23 are in the original top 100.
blocks.zh: 图19a比较了所有1 152个头的3个排名。 首先是我们的查询搜索 第二个是Gandikota和Bau的Gaze得分(2026年),用我们的任务来衡量:从结肠符号看,头部在被询问面板上的形象符号上的注意力,平均在附录A.7的每个问题上. 第三部是从连环画开始的最初Gaze排名. 我们的目光头目们最同意 同一任务衡量的盖兹分数 最初和重新测量的排名分享了他们前100个头中的57个,因此排名本身随着任务有所转变. 在32个凝视头目中,有23个在原来的前100名.

blocks.en: To compare the rankings by their causal effect, we patch the top K K heads of each ranking together at the colon token, for K K in 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 100, 128, 200, and 256, on the held-out pairs (Figure 4 b). We use three rankings of all 1,152 heads: our query-patch search, the published Gaze Heads ranking of Gandikota and Bau (2026) as published, and a random order of all heads, drawn anew for every pair and direction. Each K K gets two patches in separate runs. In the query patch, we replace the heads’ queries with the source’s, and a case counts when the target answers with its own letter at the source’s panel. In the value patch, the heads keep their own queries and keys but read the source’s image values, and a case counts when the target answers with the source’s letter at the target’s asked panel. Our 32 gaze heads reach 74.0 ± \pm 2.9% with the query patch and 93.7 ± \pm 1.6% with the value patch. The top 100 published heads reach 64.2 ± \pm 2.9% and 50.0 ± \pm 3.3%. The top 256 published heads reach 63.8 ± \pm 2.9% and 89.1 ± \pm 2.0%. Random heads stay at or below 2.1 ± \pm 1.0% at every K K .
blocks.zh: 为了按其因果效应来比较排名,我们将每个排名中排名最高的K K头在结肠符上拼接在一起,为K K在被搁置的对上1,2,4,8,16,32,64,100,128,200和256对(图4b). 我们使用所有1,152个头的3个排名:我们的查询-patch搜索,公布的Gandikota和Bau的Gaze Heads排名(2026),以及所有头的随机顺序,为每对头和方向重新绘制. 每个 K K 在不同的运行中得到两个补丁. 在查询补丁中,我们用消息来源的询问取代头部的询问,当目标在消息来源的面板上用自己的信件回答时,一个案例就算数了. 在值补丁中,头部保留自己的查询和密钥,但读取了源的图像值,当目标在目标被询问的面板上用源的字母回答时,一个案例算数. 我们的32只目光头用查询补丁达到74.0±\pm2.9%,用值补丁达到93.7±\pm1.6%. 排名前100位的公布头像达到64.2±\pm2.9%和50.0±\pm3.3%. 前256位公布的头像达到63.8±\pm2.9%,89.1±\pm2.0%. 随机头保持在或低于2.1±\pm1.0%,每KK.

blocks.en: The comparison with the published Gaze Heads in Section 6 changes two things at once: how the heads were chosen, by patching or by attention, and where, on our task or on comic strips. Table 14 removes the second difference. We rank all 1,152 heads by the Gaze score measured on our own task, and patch its top 32 and top 100 on held-out cases, next to our 32 gaze heads and the published top 100. On the query patch, the heads ranked by where they look on this task read the pointer less well than the 32 heads chosen by patching: 63.3% and 65.3%, against 74.0 ± \pm 2.9%. On the value patch, the re-measured top 100 reaches 93.4%, close to our 93.7 ± \pm 1.6%, but with three times as many heads. Its top 32 gives 64.8%.
blocks.zh: 与第6节中公布的Gaze Heads的比较,一时改变两件事:头是怎样选择的,通过补丁还是通过注意,以及在哪里,在我们的任务或连环画上. 表14消除了第二个差别. 我们用我们自己的任务衡量的Gaze分数来排列所有1 152个头,并在被搁置的案例中补上前32名和前100名,旁边是我们的32个目光头和公布的前100名。 在查询补丁上,头部按查看此任务的位置排列,读取指针比补丁选择的32个头要差:63.3%和65.3%,对74.0±\pm2.9%. 在值补丁上,重新测量的100头达到93.4%,接近我们的93.7±\pm 1.6%,但头数是三倍. 其前32位给出64.8%.

blocks.en: Table 14: Attention-ranked heads on the same task. We rank all 1,152 heads by the Gaze score of Gandikota and Bau (2026) measured on our task, the attention a head places from the colon token on the asked panel. Percent of held-out cases. Query patch: the target answers from the source’s panel. Image values: the target gives the source’s letter at its own panel.
blocks.zh: 表14:同一任务的注意级别负责人。 我们用Gandikota和Bau(2026年)的 Gaze 得分来排名所有1 152个头, 被搁置案件的百分比。 查询补丁:来自源面板的目标答案. 图像值:目标在自己的面板上给出来源的字母.

blocks.en: The published list was made by observing where heads look while the model describes comic strips, with no patch and no task of ours. Table 15 counts how many heads of each set in this paper are in it. The published list is close to a superset of our gaze heads: 23 of the 32 are in its top 100, and 29 in its top 200. It holds almost none of our other heads. Of the 16 binding heads and the 2 query and key heads outside them, 3 are in the top 100, which is what chance gives. Of the 16 relay heads, 4 are, and of the 16 language heads, 0. The searches on the list task show the same pattern. The heads found at the last comma token, where the next panel is read, are published Gaze Heads, with 11 of 16 in the top 100. The heads found at the shape token and at the answer token mostly are not. When we measure the Gaze score again on our task, it ranks more of the binding, query, and key heads highly, 6 of 18 in its top 100, because on these images a binding head also looks at the shape that will be read. So the published Gaze Heads are the heads of one step, the read. Other heads do the binding, the relay, and the choice of language, and attention to the described region does not reveal them.
blocks.zh: 公布的列表是通过观察头部的外观,而模型则描述了连环画,没有补丁和我们的任务. 表15列出本文中每组人头数。 公布的列表接近于我们超群的凝视头:32人中有23人位居前100,29人位居前200. 它几乎没有我们其他的头。 在16个捆绑头和2个查询和它们外的钥匙头中,3个在前100名,这是机会给予的. 在16个接力主管中,4个是,在16个语言主管中, 0. 列表任务上的搜索显示相同的模式。 在最后一个逗号符牌上发现的头,即下一个面板被读取的地方,都会发表"盖兹头"(Gaze Heads),前100位有11位16位. 在形状符号和答案符号上发现的头部大多不是. 当我们在任务上再次测量Gaze的得分时,它会把更多的绑定,查询,和关键头排在高位,在它的前100位中排在18位中的6位,因为在这些图像上,绑定头也查看了将要读取的形状. 因此出版的"盖兹头像"是一步之首,读本. 其他头负责绑定,接力,以及语言的选择,对所描述区域的关注并没有揭示它们.

blocks.en: Table 15: The published Gaze Heads are the heads of the read step. The number of heads of each set that are in the published ranking of Gaze Heads, and in the Gaze score measured again on our task. The last column gives the number expected if the set were drawn at random from the 1,152 heads.
blocks.zh: 表15:已公布的盖兹头目是读取的步目头目. 每一集的负责人数量,在公布的"盖兹头"排名中,以及在"盖兹分数"中,我们的任务再次衡量. 最后一栏给出了如果集从1,152头中随机抽取的预期数字.

blocks.en: F.3 Gaze Heads: Keys, Values, and the Read on a List
blocks.zh: F.3 盖兹头:钥匙, 数值和列表中的读取

blocks.en: To see which part of the gaze heads does what, we patch their image keys and image values separately. When the gaze heads read the source’s image keys with their own queries and values, the target keeps its answer in 93.2 ± \pm 1.6% of the held-out cases. When they read the source’s image values, the target answers with the source’s letter at its own panel in 93.7 ± \pm 1.6%. When they read both, it does so in 87.9 ± \pm 1.9%. So the queries carry the pointer, the keys on the image tokens match it by place, and the values bring the letter.
blocks.zh: 要看到哪个部分的目光头做什么, 我们把它们的图像键和图像值分开。 当目击头目用自己的询问和价值阅读了源头的图像密钥时,目标保留了93.2±\pm 1.6%的搁置案例的答案. 当他们读取来源的图像值时,目标在93.7±\pm 1.6%中用来源在自己的面板上的信回答. 当他们都读到时,它以87.9 ±\pm 1.9%来读。 因此,查询会携带指针,图像符号上的密钥逐处匹配,值会带字母.

blocks.en: In the list task, the pointer to the next panel forms at the last comma token, and the same 32 gaze heads read it. When we patch their queries from the source, the second answer moves to the source’s next panel in 88.2 ± \pm 2.8% of cases, against 0.0 ± \pm 0.0% for random heads. Conversely, when we hold their queries at the target’s values, a moved cursor changes the answer in only 2.1%. At the colon token of the list task, patching the queries of the 32 gaze heads moves the first answer in 46.1% of cases. A new search there selects 128 heads, which move it in 57.8 ± \pm 4.2% (Table 10 ). The colon token of the list prompt has more than one panel to choose from, so fewer of its answers follow the patched queries.
blocks.zh: 在列表任务中,指向最后一个逗号符号的下一个面板表单的指针,同样的32个凝视头读它. 当我们从源头补齐他们的询问时,第二个答案在88.2 ±\pm 2.8%的案例中移动到源头的下一个面板上,随机头部则移动0.0±\pm 0.0%. 反之,当我们按目标值进行询问时,一个移动的光标只改变2.1%的答案。 在列表任务的冒号中, 补齐32个凝视头的询问会移动46.1%案件中的第一个答案 。 这里的新搜索选择了128个头,以57.8±\pm 4.2%移动(表10). 列表提示的冒号有多个面板可供选择,因此其答案中遵循补丁查询的更少.

blocks.en: When we point the gaze heads at a panel already written, or at a panel of another shape, the model does not follow them. Appendix E.6 gives this test together with select.
blocks.zh: 当我们将目光指向一个已经写好的面板,或者另一个形状的面板时,模型不会跟随它们. 附录E.6将这一测试与选定的测试一并进行。

blocks.en: F.4 What the Gaze Heads Bring Back
blocks.zh: F.4 盖兹头带回的是什么

blocks.en: Appendix A.6 defines the readout of the gaze heads’ summed output and the cross-language patch.
blocks.zh: 附录A.6定义了凝视头总和输出的读出和跨语言补丁。

blocks.en: We found the gaze heads on the letter task, with another prompt and another answer token. To check whether the same heads read the colored-shape task, we repeat a single-head search on its discovery images. We patch the output of one head at a time from the source, and score the gain of the source’s concept word over the target’s, both in the target’s language. This search ranks 14 of the 32 gaze heads in its top 32, and 25 in its top 128.
blocks.zh: 我们发现凝视着字母任务, 还有一个即时和另一个回答符号。 为了检查同一头是否读取了彩色形状的任务,我们重复了对其发现图像的单头搜索. 我们从源头上补齐一个头的输出,并将源头概念词的得分比目标语言的得分. 这次搜索在其前32名的32名和前128名的25名中排名第14位。

blocks.en: The summed output of the gaze heads is nearly the same for one image under two languages, with a cosine of 0.95, and differs between two images under one language, 0.50. Read against the output vocabulary, its top word is the English name of the shape in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% of images when the question is German, and in 84.2 ± \pm 3.2% when it is French. Otherwise it is the Chinese name. It is never the German or French name.
blocks.zh: 凝视头的汇总输出在两种语言下一个图像几乎相同,同位素为0.95,在一种语言下两个图像相差0.50. 对照输出词汇读取,它的顶部词是当问题为德语时,形状的英文名称为1000.0±\pm 0.0%,当问题为法语时为84.2±\pm 3.2%. 否则就是中文名. 它从来不是德国或法国的名字。

blocks.en: When we patch the outputs of the 32 gaze heads from the source, the target names the source’s shape in its own language in 82.0 ± \pm 1.3% of cases. It changes the language in 0.0 ± \pm 0.0%, and keeps its own answer in 13.8 ± \pm 1.4%. Patching the 16 language heads moves the language in 95.3 ± \pm 0.5% and the shape in 0.0 ± \pm 0.0%. Patching 32 random heads moves the shape in 0.0 ± \pm 0.0% and the language in 0.3 ± \pm 0.2%. So the gaze heads move the concept and never the language, and the language heads of Section 6.2 do the opposite. The top 32 heads of the search on this task move the concept in every case. So the gaze heads found on the letter task are most, but not all, of what carries the concept here. With a source in the target’s own language, the gaze heads move the concept in 86.8 ± \pm 1.2% of cases. Patching them at the first generated token only moves it in 67.7%.
blocks.zh: 当我们从源头修补32个凝视头的输出时,目标以82.0±\pm 1.3%的病例以自己的语言命名源的形状. 它以 0.0 ±\pm 0.0%修改语言,并保留自己的答案以 13.8 ±\pm 1.4%. 补丁十六种语言头将语言以95.3±\pm 0.5%移动,形状以0.0±\pm 0.0%移动. 修补32个随机头以 0.0±\pm 0.0%移动形状,语言以 0.3±\pm 0.2%移动形状. 因此凝视头会移动概念,从不移动语言,6.2节的语言头会做相反的事情. 搜索这一任务的前32位头目在每一个案例中都会移动这个概念. 因此,在信件任务上发现的目光头部是这个概念中最重要的,但不是全部。 视线头在86.8 ±\pm 1.2%的案例中移动这个概念。 在第一次生成时补丁它们只以67.7%的速度移动.

blocks.en: F.5 The Object Task
blocks.zh: F.5 对象任务

blocks.en: With four shapes, a readout that names the shape could be a coincidence of a small vocabulary. To rule this out, we use the object task, which has sixteen concepts. With no patch, the model answers its questions in the right language with the right object in 99.0% of runs. The summed output of the same 32 gaze heads has a cosine of 0.96 for one image under two languages, and 0.36 for two images under one language. Across readouts, its top word is the English name of the object in the circle in 48.8% of them, and the start of that English name in 33.0%. It is the Chinese name in 2.0%, and the German or French name in 0.0%. Patching the 16 language heads moves the language in 87.6% of cases and the object in 0.0%. So the separation of concept and language holds on both tasks.
blocks.zh: 有了四个形状,读出这个形状的名称可能是小词汇的巧合. 排除这种情况,我们使用物体任务,它有16个概念。 在没有补丁的情况下,模型在99.0%的运行中用正确的对象用正确的语言解答自己的问题. 相同32个凝视头的汇总输出在两种语言下一个图像的余弦为0.96,在一个语言下两个图像的余弦为0.36. 在整个读取中,它的顶部词是48.8%的圆形物体的英文名称,33.0%的英文名称开始. 其中文名称为2.0%,德语或法语名称为0.0%. 补丁十六种语言头在87.6%的案例中移动语言,对象在0.0 %. 因此,概念和语言的分离是两个任务。

blocks.en: What changes is which heads carry the concept. When we patch the outputs of the 32 gaze heads from a source that asks in another language about another object, the target names the source’s object in only 9.8% of cases. In 15.5%, the target names the object that its own image holds at the source’s asked panel. So part of what these heads pass on is still the pointer, which later heads use to read the image again. The heads that the single-head search of Appendix F.4 finds on this task do carry the object. Patching its top 32 heads moves the object in 86.1% of cases and the language in 0.0%, against 0.0% for random heads. This search ranks 14 of the 32 gaze heads in its top 32, and 28 in its top 128. Of its top 32 heads, 21 are also in the top 32 of the search on the colored-shape task. So the heads that read the pointer also read a letter or a plain shape, but a drawn object needs further heads after them.
blocks.zh: 改变之处是,哪个标题带有这个概念。 当我们从一个以另一种语言询问另一个对象的源头补上32个凝视头的输出时,目标只将源对象命名为9.8%。 在15.5%中,目标点命名了它自己在消息来源询问的面板上持有的物体。 因此,这些头所传递的部分仍然是指针,后来的头部用来再次读取图像. 附录F.4的单头搜索在此任务上发现的标头确实带有对象. 补丁其前32个头将对象移动到86.1%的案例中,语言移动到0.0%,随机头则移动0.0%. 这次搜索在其前32名的32名和前128名的28名中排名第14位。 在它的前32个头部中,21个头部也处于搜索彩色形状任务的前32名. 因此,读取指针的头部也读取一个字母或一个平面形状,但画出的物体在它们之后需要更多的头部.

blocks.en: F.6 Language Heads: All Conditions, Both Tasks
blocks.zh: F.6 语文主管:所有条件,两项任务

blocks.en: To find the component that adds the language, we take a source that asks in language A A about image X X and a target that asks in language B B about image Y Y . We track the token of the target’s answer in the source’s language A A , a word that neither run produces. We start by patching the output of one attention head at a time from the source. We rank the heads by this score on the discovery images. We keep the top 16 heads of this search, in layers 19-35 (Figure 4 c).
blocks.zh: 为了找到添加语言的组件,我们取一个来源,在语言A中询问图像X X,在语言B中询问图像Y Y 的目标. 我们用来源语言AA追踪目标答案的象征, 我们从源头开始一次补补一个注意力头的输出. 我们在发现的图像上按这个分数对头进行排名. 我们保留了这次搜索的前16个头,分为19-35层(图4 c).

blocks.en: Table 16 reports every language experiment on both tasks. The two tasks select largely the same heads: 10 of the 16 are shared, and the two strongest heads are the same in both. The object task is the harder one for almost every patch, because its answers are often several tokens long. Patching the heads at the first generated token only gives 78.4% on this task, against 87.6% at every token. To find what writes the word, we hold parts of the model at the target’s values while patching the heads. Holding the last three MLPs, layers 33-35, keeps the language in place on both tasks, with 0.9 ± \pm 0.2% and 5.0% moved. Holding MLPs 28-32 leaves 10.7% and 4.4% moved. Holding the other attention heads of layers 33-35 barely matters, with 91.3% and 79.7% moved. So the late MLPs, and not other late heads, write the word.
blocks.zh: 表16报告关于这两项任务的每一种语文试验。 两个任务选择了大体相同的头:16个中共有10个,两个最强的头都是一样的. 对象任务对几乎每个补丁来说都是较难完成的,因为它的答案常常是数个符号长. 在第一个生成的代号上补头只给78.4%的任务,而每个代号为87.6%。 为了找到写这个词的东西,我们把模型的部分内容放在目标值上,同时补补头。 持有最后三个MLP,层33-35,使两种任务的语言都保持了原位,0.9±\pm0.2%和5.0%移动. 持有MLPs 28-32叶10.7%,移动4.4%. 持有33-35层的其他注意力头几乎不重要,移动率为91.3%,移动率为79.7%. 所以,晚期的MLPs,而不是其他晚期的头,写这个词.

blocks.en: We take the mean difference between the summed outputs of the 16 heads under a language and under English, and add it to the residual at layer 24. This single vector does the same job as the per-head averages. On held-out images of the colored-shape task, it switches English runs to French in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0% of cases, to Chinese in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0%, and to German in 75.0 ± \pm 3.8%. Subtracted from German and French runs, it returns English in 100.0 ± \pm 0.0%. It also works on text-only prompts with no image, whose nouns never appear in any image. There it switches runs to French in 65.0%, to Chinese in 100.0%, and to German in 60.0%.
blocks.zh: 我们把16个头在一种语言下与英语下的总产出之间的平均差别,加到第24层的剩余产出中。 此单向量与人均平均值相同. 在被搁置的彩色形状任务图像上,它将英语在100.0%的病例中切换为法语,在100.0%的病例中切换为汉语,在75.0%的病例中切换为德语,在3.8%). 从德语和法语运行中减去,它以1000.0±\pm 0.0%返回英语. 它还在无图像的仅文本提示上工作,其名词从未出现在任何图像中. 其开关为65.0%的法语、100.0%的中文和60.0%的德语。

blocks.en: To test whether the translation step depends on the visual read, we add the vocabulary direction of a new English noun to the residual at layer 26 of a German, French, or Chinese run. The model then produces that noun in the question’s language in 74.6 ± \pm 0.7% of cases on the colored-shape task, and in 67.0% on the object task. It gives the English word in 4.6 ± \pm 0.2%. When we add the same direction late, after the language heads have acted, the model gives the English word instead, in 69.2 ± \pm 0.2%, and the translated word in 3.8 ± \pm 0.1%. So the translation step at the end of an answer takes any concept that reaches it.
blocks.zh: 为了检验翻译步骤是否取决于所读的视觉,我们将一个新的英文名词的词汇方向加到德语,法语或中文运行的第26层的剩余部分. 该模型随后在74.6 ±\pm 0.7%的有色人种任务和67.0%的物体任务中生成问题语言中的名词。 它给出了4.6±\pm0.2%的英语单词. 当我们晚些添加同样的方向时,在语言头像行动后,模型给出了英文单词,在69.2±\pm 0.2%中,翻译的单词在3.8±\pm 0.1%中. 因此,一个答案结尾处的翻译步骤会采纳任何达到它的概念.

blocks.en: Table 16: Every language experiment on both tasks. Held-out images, with cross-image cases. A case succeeds when the target names its own concept in the source’s or the target’s language.
blocks.zh: 表16 两种任务的每一种语言实验. 挂断图像,有交叉图像病例. 当目标在源语言或目标语言中指定了自己的概念时,案件就成功。

blocks.en: F.7 The Color Question: Language Heads and MLPs
blocks.zh: F.7 彩色问题:语言头和MLP

blocks.en: Here we study further how the late layers turn the visual concept from the gaze heads into a word, on the color question of Appendix A.6 . This extends Section 6.2 .
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们进一步研究后层如何将视觉概念从目光头部变成一个字,关于附录A.6的颜色问题。 这扩展了第6.2节。

blocks.en: Figure 20: Without the late MLPs, German and French answers fall back to English. We set the outputs of the top MLPs at the colon token to their mean over prompts in all languages, with no source. We then read the probability of the correct color word in the target language, which is the language of the question (solid), and in English and Chinese (dashed).

blocks.en: We patch one component at a time from a source into a target that ask the question in two different languages about two different images. The two images show the same four shapes in different panels, colored with eight different colors. The source and the target ask about different shapes, so the target’s concept, the source’s concept, and the target’s concept at the source’s panel are three different words. The pairs cover all 12 ordered pairs of English, French, Chinese, and German, balanced over markers, concepts, and panels. We apply every patch at the colon token of the prefill, and compute scores from the logits of the patched target.

blocks.zh: 图21显示了对这一问题的头部搜索。

We then patch the top k k MLPs together (Figure 22 b). Ranked over all languages and both questions, the top 4 MLPs are layers 32-35, and the top 8 are layers 28-35. These late MLPs are also needed without any source. When we set their outputs to their mean over prompts in all languages, German and French answers fall back to English (Figure 20 ).
